section: 第十一章　我们应该怎样定义”生命发生了”？ / Chapter 11. How Should We Define “Life Has Occurred”?
text:
第十一章　我们应该怎样定义”生命发生了”？ / Chapter 11. How Should We Define “Life Has Occurred”?

11.1 从清单到维度 / 11.1 From Checklist to Dimensions
前面各章反复出现一个困境：任何”清单式定义”都会被边界案例击穿。可行的替代方案，是把生命性分解为若干可独立测量的维度：
A dilemma recurs throughout the preceding chapters: any “checklist definition” is punctured by boundary cases. A workable alternative is to decompose aliveness into a number of independently measurable dimensions:









维度
可操作判据
测量方法
备注




D1 物质与能量流
与环境交换物质，维持非平衡
代谢通量、热耗散
火焰也满足


D2 自我维持
去除外部扰动后恢复组织
扰动—恢复实验
区分结构与组织


D3 边界
存在选择性通透的界面
膜电位、渗透实验
凝聚体是弱边界


D4 信息存储
存在可被读取的亚稳态结构
序列/组成分析
需有解码机制


D5 复制
产生与自身相似的实体
代际追踪
需区分模板与非模板


D6 可遗传变异
子代差异可稳定传递
亲子相关性
遗传力


D7 选择
差异适应度导致频率变化
群体时间序列
需排除漂变


D8 自主性
系统自身设定行为规范
扰动下的目标维持
哲学争议大


D9 开放式创新
持续产生新组织层次
长期演化实验
最难测量



English









Dimension
Operational criterion
Measurement method
Note




D1 Matter and energy flow
Exchanges matter with the environment, maintains non-equilibrium
Metabolic flux, heat dissipation
Flames also satisfy this


D2 Self-maintenance
Restores organisation after external perturbation is removed
Perturbation–recovery experiments
Distinguishes structure from organisation


D3 Boundary
Presence of a selectively permeable interface
Membrane potential, osmotic experiments
Condensates are weak boundaries


D4 Information storage
Presence of a metastable structure that can be read
Sequence/composition analysis
Requires a decoding mechanism


D5 Replication
Produces entities similar to itself
Generation tracking
Must distinguish templated from non-templated


D6 Heritable variation
Offspring differences can be transmitted stably
Parent–offspring correlation
Heritability


D7 Selection
Differential fitness leads to frequency change
Population time series
Must rule out drift


D8 Autonomy
The system sets its own norms of behaviour
Goal maintenance under perturbation
Highly contested philosophically


D9 Open-ended innovation
Continuously generates new levels of organisation
Long-term evolution experiments
Hardest to measure





11.2 三种定义策略的比较 / 11.2 Comparing Three Definitional Strategies

属性清单式：列出必要属性，满足即算生命。优点是易操作；缺点是边界模糊，且不同清单互相矛盾。
Property checklists: list the necessary properties, and whatever satisfies them counts as life. The advantage is ease of use; the disadvantage is that the boundaries are fuzzy and different checklists contradict one another.
动力系统式：把生命定义为某种吸引子或状态空间结构（如”自我维持的远离平衡态”）。优点是数学清晰；缺点是把许多非生命系统也包含进来。
Dynamical-systems definitions: define life as a kind of attractor or structure in state space (for example, “a self-maintaining state far from equilibrium”). The advantage is mathematical clarity; the disadvantage is that many non-living systems are included.
因果组织式：把生命定义为约束闭合的因果结构（自创生、自主性）。优点是抓住了”关于自身”这一核心；缺点是难以量化。
Causal-organisation definitions: define life as a constraint-closed causal structure (autopoiesis, autonomy). The advantage is that it captures the core notion of “being about oneself”; the disadvantage is that it is hard to quantify.

本文倾向于第三种为主、第一种为辅：用因果组织给出”什么是生命”的定性回答，用属性清单给出”有多像生命”的定量回答。
This article favours the third as primary and the first as auxiliary: causal organisation gives the qualitative answer to “what life is,” while the property checklist gives the quantitative answer to “how much like life something is.”


11.3 一个渐进式评价框架（作者提议，非共识） / 11.3 A Graduated Assessment Framework (a Proposal, Not a Consensus)
下面这个框架是本文提出的操作性建议，不是学术界的共识。它的目的是让不同实验之间的结果可以比较。
The framework below is an operational proposal advanced by this article, not a consensus of the field. Its purpose is to make results from different experiments comparable.
评分规则：每个维度 0–3 分。
Scoring rule: each dimension is scored from 0 to 3.

0：完全缺失；
0: entirely absent;
1：被动出现，依赖外部维持；
1: present passively and dependent on external maintenance;
2：系统自身参与维持，但需要频繁干预；
2: the system participates in its own maintenance, but frequent intervention is required;
3：系统自主维持，且能抵抗中等扰动。
3: the system maintains itself autonomously and can resist moderate perturbations.

分级建议（仅为工作性阈值）：
Suggested bands (working thresholds only):








总分
类别
典型例子




0–5
非生命复杂系统
火焰、BZ 反应、晶体


6–10
前生命系统
自催化网络、脂质囊泡


11–16
原始生命候选
能生长分裂并复制的囊泡系统


17–21
生命
细菌（应有尽有）


22–27
开放式生命
具有开放式演化的系统（目前只有地球生物圈）



English








Total
Category
Typical example




0–5
Non-living complex systems
Flames, BZ reactions, crystals


6–10
Pre-life systems
Autocatalytic networks, lipid vesicles


11–16
Protocell candidates
Vesicle systems that can grow, divide, and replicate


17–21
Life
Bacteria (everything one could ask for)


22–27
Open-ended life
Systems with open-ended evolution (currently only the terrestrial biosphere)



使用这个框架时必须同时报告：
Use of this framework must be accompanied by reporting:

每个维度的测量方法与不确定度；
the measurement method and uncertainty for each dimension;
系统在去除研究者干预后的维持时间；
how long the system persists once researcher intervention is withdrawn;
观察到的代数与选择单位；
the observed number of generations and the unit of selection;
哪些维度是”设计进去的”，哪些是”涌现出来的”。
which dimensions were “designed in” and which “emerged.”

最后一点尤其重要。一个由研究者精心组装、每个部件都为特定功能设计的系统，即使得分很高，也不能说明”生命可以自发出现”——它说明的是”生命可以被工程化”。
The last point is especially important. A system painstakingly assembled by researchers, with every component designed for a specific function, does not show that “life can arise spontaneously” even if it scores highly—it shows that “life can be engineered.”


11.4 可证伪的预测 / 11.4 Falsifiable Predictions
一个好的框架应该产生可被推翻的预测。本文提出三条：
A good framework should generate predictions that can be overturned. This article offers three:

扰动恢复预测：在同等条件下，得分 ≥ 11 的系统在渗透压扰动后的恢复时间应显著短于得分 ≤ 10 的系统。
Perturbation-recovery prediction: under otherwise equal conditions, systems scoring ≥ 11 should recover significantly faster after osmotic perturbation than systems scoring ≤ 10.
代际稳定性预测：具备 D5 + D6 的系统，其子代分布应随代数收敛（而不是发散）。
Generational-stability prediction: in systems possessing D5 + D6, the distribution of progeny should converge (not diverge) with successive generations.
开放式创新预测：只有具备 D8 + D9 的系统，才能在长期培养中持续产生”新类型”，而不仅仅是参数漂移。
Open-ended innovation prediction: only systems possessing D8 + D9 should continue to produce “new types” in long-term culture, rather than merely drifting in parameter space.

如果这些预测在实验中失败，框架就需要修正——这正是它区别于纯哲学分类的地方。
If these predictions fail experimentally, the framework must be revised—and that is precisely what distinguishes it from a purely philosophical taxonomy.


11.5 本章结论 / 11.5 Chapter Conclusion

已知：属性清单、动力系统、因果组织三种定义各有优劣；目前没有公认的定量框架。 未决：维度之间是否独立？是否存在”必要组合”？ 可验证方向：用同一套扰动协议测试 5–10 种人工系统（囊泡、凝聚体、自催化网络、最小细胞），比较它们的恢复曲线。


Known: the checklist, dynamical-systems, and causal-organisation definitions each have strengths and weaknesses; there is no accepted quantitative framework. Open: are the dimensions independent of one another? Is there a “necessary combination”? Testable direction: test 5–10 artificial systems (vesicles, coacervates, autocatalytic networks, minimal cells) with the same perturbation protocol and compare their recovery curves.

title: From Non-Life to Life: Philosophy, Self-Organization, Information, and the Emergence of Living Systems
section: 第十二章　生命的第二次起源 / Chapter 12. The Second Origin of Life
text:
第十二章　生命的第二次起源 / Chapter 12. The Second Origin of Life
第一次生命起源于地球化学。今天，人类开始尝试第二次——不是等待化学偶然，而是有意识地设计。
The first origin of life arose from geochemistry. Today humanity is attempting a second—not by waiting for chemical accident but by deliberate design.
这带来三个问题。
This raises three questions.

12.1 我们能在实验室里造出可演化的系统吗？ / 12.1 Can We Build Evolvable Systems in the Laboratory?
目前最接近的答案是：能造出部分，不能造出整体。
The most nearly correct answer at present is: we can build the parts, but not the whole.
复制、分裂、区室化、自催化、化学记忆都已分别实现；把它们耦合起来，并维持多代稳定性，仍是未完成的任务。最可能的突破口不是”再合成一个更复杂的分子”，而是工程化的耦合：把已知模块放进同一个物理系统，让它们彼此约束。
Replication, division, compartmentalisation, autocatalysis, and chemical memory have each been realised separately; coupling them together while maintaining multi-generational stability remains an unfinished task. The most likely breakthrough is not “synthesising yet another, more complex molecule” but engineered coupling: placing known modules in the same physical system and letting them constrain one another.


12.2 我们能在计算世界里造出数字生命吗？ / 12.2 Can We Build Digital Life in the Computational World?
如果”生命”要求物理层面的能量代谢与化学组织，那么答案可能是”不能”。如果”生命”只要求组织与演化，那么答案可能是”已经部分实现”。
If “life” requires energy metabolism and chemical organisation at the physical level, the answer may be “no.” If “life” requires only organisation and evolution, the answer may be “already partly achieved.”
关键不在于定义之争，而在于我们想用数字生命做什么：如果目标是研究演化的普遍规律，数字系统已经足够；如果目标是创造”真正活着的”实体，那么我们需要说明”活着”在计算基质上意味着什么。
The crux is not the dispute over definitions but what we want digital life for: if the goal is to study the general laws of evolution, digital systems already suffice; if the goal is to create entities that are “genuinely alive,” then we must specify what “alive” means on a computational substrate.


12.3 被创造的生命与自然生命有何不同？ / 12.3 How Does Created Life Differ from Natural Life?
这是三个问题中最哲学的。至少有三点差异：
This is the most philosophical of the three questions. There are at least three differences:

起源方式：自然生命没有设计者；被创造的生命有。这不影响它”是否活着”，但影响我们如何理解它的地位。
Mode of origin: natural life has no designer; created life does. This does not affect whether it is “alive,” but it affects how we understand its status.
目的性：自然生命的目的（如果有）是内生的、演化的；被创造的生命的目的可能部分由设计者设定。
Teleology: the purposes of natural life (if any) are endogenous and evolved; the purposes of created life may be partly set by its designer.
依赖性：被创造的生命依赖于维持它的技术系统；一旦技术系统消失，它也随之消失。这是一种”浅层自主性”。
Dependence: created life depends on the technological system that sustains it; once that system disappears, so does it. This is a kind of “shallow autonomy.”

这三点不构成”被创造的生命不是生命”的论证，但它们说明：创造生命并不等于理解生命。我们可能造出一个能自我维持、能演化的系统，却仍然不知道它是如何”成为”生命的。
These three points do not amount to an argument that “created life is not life,” but they show that creating life is not the same as understanding life. We might build a system that maintains itself and evolves, and still not know how it “became” alive.


12.4 回到开头 / 12.4 Returning to the Beginning
回到那块岩石、那团火焰、那杯振荡的反应液和那个细菌。
Return to the rock, the flame, the cup of oscillating reaction liquid, and the bacterium.
岩石没有组织；火焰有耗散结构但没有记忆；振荡反应有记忆但没有边界；细菌有全部，但它的”全部”是四十亿年演化的产物，而不是一次相变的瞬间结果。
The rock has no organisation; the flame has a dissipative structure but no memory; the oscillating reaction has memory but no boundary; the bacterium has everything—but its “everything” is the product of four billion years of evolution, not the instantaneous result of a single phase transition.
所以，本文的结论既不是”生命是偶然的”，也不是”生命是必然的”，而是：
The conclusion of this article is therefore neither “life is contingent” nor “life is necessary,” but rather:

生命是物质在特定组织条件下反复出现的一种可能性；这种可能性是否被实现，取决于历史的偶然；但它一旦被实现，就会自我放大、自我维持，并打开新的可能性空间。


Life is a possibility that matter repeatedly offers under particular conditions of organisation; whether that possibility is realised depends on historical contingency; but once realised, it amplifies itself, maintains itself, and opens new spaces of possibility.

这句话的前半部分属于科学，后半部分属于哲学。把两者分开，是我们能对这个问题保持诚实的方式。
The first half of this sentence belongs to science, the second to philosophy. Keeping the two apart is how we can remain honest about this question.

section: 附录 E　开放问题清单 / Appendix E. List of Open Questions
text:
附录 E　开放问题清单 / Appendix E. List of Open Questions

前生物条件下，RNA 寡核苷酸能否在无酶情况下达到 100 nt 以上并保持功能？
Under prebiotic conditions, can RNA oligonucleotides reach more than 100 nt without enzymes while remaining functional?
膜脂合成与 RNA 复制能否在同一个囊泡内稳定耦合超过 20 代？
Can membrane lipid synthesis and RNA replication be stably coupled within a single vesicle for more than 20 generations?
自催化网络在真实化学中是否存在可测的一阶相变？
Does an autocatalytic network exhibit a measurable first-order phase transition in real chemistry?
约束闭合能否被操作化为一个可计算的量？
Can constraint closure be operationalised as a computable quantity?
编码系统（遗传密码）的起源是否可以在实验室中重演？
Can the origin of the coding system (the genetic code) be re-enacted in the laboratory?
前生物选择的最小机制是什么？它需要模板吗？
What is the minimal mechanism of prebiotic selection, and does it require a template?
手性一致性是在分子层面还是网络层面形成的？
Is chiral consistency established at the molecular level or at the level of the network?
早期地球的磷酸盐浓度是否足以支持聚合？
Was the phosphate concentration on the early Earth sufficient to support polymerisation?
生命起源是一次事件还是多次并行事件？
Was the origin of life a single event or several parallel events?
LUCA 的代谢是自养的还是异养的？
Was the metabolism of LUCA autotrophic or heterotrophic?
病毒在生命起源中的角色是”寄生者”还是”桥梁”？
In the origin of life, are viruses “parasites” or “bridges”?
数字系统能否实现真正的开放式演化？
Can digital systems achieve genuine open-ended evolution?
软件系统的”自主性”是因果闭合还是隐喻？
Is the “autonomy” of software systems causal closure or a metaphor?
生命性可以被单一定量指标刻画吗？
Can aliveness be captured by a single quantitative index?
组装理论的判据在其他行星样本上是否成立？
Does the criterion of assembly theory hold for samples from other planets?
非水溶剂中的生命是否可能？如何检验？
Is life possible in non-aqueous solvents, and how could it be tested?
生命起源的概率能否被定量估计？
Can the probability of the origin of life be estimated quantitatively?
人工创造的生命是否具有道德地位？
Does artificially created life have moral status?
合成细胞的最小基因组是否可以进一步缩减？
Can the minimal genome of a synthetic cell be reduced further?
我们如何区分”模拟生命”与”实现生命”？
How do we distinguish “simulating life” from “realising life”?

text:
写作说明 / Note on This Article



本文由 DeepSeek-Flash 生成，尚未经过人工校对，可能存在事实、数字或表述上的错误，请以原始文献和官方文档为准。
This article was generated by DeepSeek-Flash and has not yet been proofread by a human. It may contain errors of fact, number, or wording; please defer to the original literature and official documentation.
文中的测序原理、流程和常见问题来自公开文档与文献；所有图表均由本文的 R 代码在渲染时生成，其中的数据是为了说明概念而模拟的，不代表任何真实样本的测量结果。
The sequencing principles, workflows, and common pitfalls described here are drawn from public documentation and the literature; all figures are generated at render time by the R code in this article, and the data in them are simulated to illustrate concepts, and do not represent measurements from any real sample.
单细胞测序（single-cell sequencing）已经成了生物医学的默认工具，但第一次拿到数据时的困惑往往非常具体：一个细胞到底被测成了什么？BCL、FASTQ、BAM、matrix.mtx、h5ad 这些文件分别是什么？FASTQ 里那一行行字母和这个细胞有什么关系？为什么最后只剩下一个稀疏矩阵？
Single-cell sequencing has become a default tool in biomedicine, yet the confusion on first receiving the data is usually very concrete: what exactly has a cell been measured into? What are the BCL, FASTQ, BAM, matrix.mtx, and h5ad files? What do those lines of letters in FASTQ have to do with this cell? And why does everything end up as a single sparse matrix?
这篇文章按数据实际流动的顺序，把整条链路拆开讲：分子层面的捕获与建库 → 平台选择 → 原始文件格式 → 条码与 UMI 处理 → count matrix → 质控 → 标准化与降维 → 聚类与注释 → 细胞状态分析 → 下一轮实验设计。目标是写成一份可以按图索骥的技术报告，而不是概念综述。
This article follows the order in which the data actually flow and takes the whole chain apart step by step: molecular capture and library construction → platform choice → raw file formats → barcode and UMI processing → count matrix → quality control → normalization and dimensionality reduction → clustering and annotation → cell-state analysis → design of the next experiment. The goal is a technical report that can be followed step by step, not a conceptual review.

title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 1. 单细胞测的是什么 / What Does Single-Cell Sequencing Measure
text:
1. 单细胞测的是什么 / What Does Single-Cell Sequencing Measure
Bulk RNA-seq 测的是一管组织里所有细胞混在一起的平均值。平均会抹掉两件最重要的事：细胞之间的差异，以及稀有细胞的存在。
Bulk RNA-seq measures the average of all the cells in a tube of tissue pooled together. Averaging erases the two things that matter most: the differences between cells and the existence of rare cells.


Code
n_genes <- 2000
sc <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(cell = "Cell A", expr = rnorm(n_genes, 6.0, 0.8)),
  data.frame(cell = "Cell B", expr = rnorm(n_genes, 3.5, 0.8)),
  data.frame(cell = "Cell C", expr = rnorm(n_genes, 1.5, 0.8))
)
bulk <- data.frame(
  cell = "Bulk (pooled)",
  expr = rowMeans(matrix(sc$expr, ncol = 3)) + rnorm(n_genes, 0, 0.15)
)

ggplot(bind_rows(sc, bulk), aes(expr, colour = cell, fill = cell)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.16, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(pal[1:3], blog_pal[["grey"]])) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(pal[1:3], blog_pal[["grey"]])) +
  labs(
    x = "expression", y = "density", colour = NULL, fill = NULL,
    title = "Bulk hides the cells",
    subtitle = "Same genes, three cells versus their pool"
  )








Figure 1: Bulk 测序是平均。三种表达模式完全不同的细胞，混合后只剩一条居中的分布。 | Bulk sequencing is an average. Three cells with completely different expression patterns leave only a single centred distribution once pooled.





单细胞测序把“平均”拆回“个体”：每个细胞一个表达向量。由此才能回答三类问题：
Single-cell sequencing takes the average back apart into individuals: one expression vector per cell. Only then can three classes of question be answered:

组成：这份组织里有哪些细胞类型？比例是多少？病人和对照之间比例是否改变？
Composition: which cell types are present in this tissue, and in what proportions? Do the proportions change between patients and controls?
状态：同一类型的细胞是否处在不同状态（激活、耗竭、周期、应激）？
State: are cells of the same type in different states (activation, exhaustion, cell cycle, stress)?
关系：细胞之间的谱系关系、通讯关系、与空间位置的关系。
Relationship: lineage relationships between cells, communication relationships, and relationships to spatial position.

代价是每个细胞的测量变得又浅又噪声大：一个细胞通常只有几千到几万个 UMI，一个基因经常是 0。所以单细胞分析的很大一部分工作，是在稀疏、噪声、技术偏差之上做统计推断。
The price is that the measurement of each cell becomes both shallow and noisy: a cell typically has only a few thousand to a few tens of thousands of UMIs, and a given gene is often 0. A large part of single-cell analysis is therefore statistical inference on top of sparsity, noise, and technical bias.

title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 2. 分子层面：一个 mRNA 如何变成一条 read / At the Molecular Level: How an mRNA Becomes a Read
text:
2. 分子层面：一个 mRNA 如何变成一条 read / At the Molecular Level: How an mRNA Becomes a Read
不同的平台细节不同，但绝大多数 scRNA-seq 都遵循同一套化学逻辑：
Platforms differ in their details, but the vast majority of scRNA-seq follows the same chemical logic:

捕获 mRNA：利用 mRNA 3’ 端的 poly(A) 尾巴，用 oligo-dT 引物反转录。这一步决定了 3’ 偏好。
Capture mRNA: exploit the poly(A) tail at the 3’ end of mRNA and reverse-transcribe with an oligo-dT primer. This step determines the 3’ bias.
打标签：oligo-dT 引物上带有细胞条码（cell barcode）和分子标签（UMI）。同一个细胞的所有 cDNA 共享同一段条码；同一个原始 mRNA 分子的所有 PCR 拷贝共享同一个 UMI。
Tagging: the oligo-dT primer carries a cell barcode and a unique molecular identifier (UMI). All cDNA from the same cell shares the same barcode; all PCR copies of the same original mRNA molecule share the same UMI.
反转录与模板转换：加入模板转换寡核苷酸（TSO），在 cDNA 3’ 端加上已知序列，便于后续扩增。
Reverse transcription and template switching: a template-switching oligonucleotide (TSO) adds a known sequence to the 3’ end of the cDNA to facilitate later amplification.
扩增与建库：cDNA 扩增、片段化、加接头、测序。10x 只测一端（3’ 或 5’），Smart-seq 测全长。
Amplification and library construction: cDNA amplification, fragmentation, adapter ligation, and sequencing. 10x sequences only one end (3’ or 5’), whereas Smart-seq sequences the full length.



Code
mol <- data.frame(
  molecule = factor(
    c("mRNA", "mRNA", "primer", "primer", "primer", "cDNA", "cDNA", "cDNA"),
    levels = c("cDNA", "primer", "mRNA")
  ),
  start = c(30, 95, 30, 36, 42, 30, 36, 42),
  end   = c(95, 100, 36, 42, 50, 36, 42, 100),
  feature = c(
    "coding sequence", "poly(A) tail", "cell barcode", "UMI", "oligo-dT",
    "cell barcode", "UMI", "cDNA"
  )
)

ggplot(mol) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = feature),
    colour = "white", linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = subset(mol, end - start >= 25),
    aes(x = (start + end) / 2, y = 0.5, label = feature),
    size = 3, colour = "white", fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~molecule, ncol = 1, strip.position = "left") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "coding sequence" = blog_pal[["blue"]],
    "poly(A) tail"    = blog_pal[["grey"]],
    "cell barcode"    = blog_pal[["green"]],
    "UMI"             = blog_pal[["vermillion"]],
    "oligo-dT"        = blog_pal[["orange"]],
    "cDNA"            = blog_pal[["sky"]]
  )) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(25, 105), breaks = c(30, 36, 42, 50, 95, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "position along the molecule (schematic)", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())








Figure 2: 一个 mRNA 分子如何被打上细胞条码与 UMI。条码标识细胞，UMI 标识分子，两者组合后才能在没有分子计数的情况下估计表达量。 | How an mRNA molecule is tagged with a cell barcode and a UMI. The barcode identifies the cell and the UMI identifies the molecule; only their combination allows expression to be estimated without counting molecules directly.





两个关键点：
Two key points:

条码必须唯一：10x 的 3’ 试剂盒使用约 737,000 个已知条码（whitelist），随机序列长度 16 bp。条码不是完全不碰撞，但在给定细胞数下碰撞概率很低，而且可以通过“真实条码 vs 背景条码”的计数分布区分。
Barcodes must be unique: 10x 3’ kits use about 737,000 known barcodes (a whitelist) with a random sequence 16 bp long. Barcodes are not entirely collision-free, but at a given cell number the collision probability is low, and real barcodes can be separated from background barcodes by their count distributions.
UMI 必须足够多：10x 3’ 使用 12 bp UMI（约 1,600 万种），实际测到的分子数远小于这个数量级，所以 UMI 碰撞可以忽略；但深度很高时需要校正（UMI saturation）。
UMIs must be numerous enough: 10x 3’ uses a 12 bp UMI (about 16 million possibilities), and the number of molecules actually measured is far below that order of magnitude, so UMI collisions can be neglected; at very high depth, however, correction is needed (UMI saturation).

href: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#细胞的状态到底是什么-what-exactly-is-a-cell-state
title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 3. 细胞的状态到底是什么 / What Exactly Is a Cell State
text:
3. 细胞的状态到底是什么 / What Exactly Is a Cell State
“细胞类型”和“细胞状态”经常被混用，但它们不是一回事。
Cell type and cell state are often used interchangeably, but they are not the same thing.

类型（type）：相对稳定，由发育来源和核心调控网络决定，比如 T 细胞、B 细胞、髓系细胞、内皮细胞。
Type: relatively stable, determined by developmental origin and core regulatory networks, for example T cells, B cells, myeloid cells, and endothelial cells.
状态（state）：在类型内部连续变化，可逆或半可逆，比如细胞周期、激活、耗竭、应激、代谢切换、分化中间态。
State: varies continuously within a type, reversibly or semi-reversibly, for example cell cycle, activation, exhaustion, stress, metabolic switching, or intermediate differentiation states.

测序测到的其实只是一个转录组快照：某个时刻、某个细胞里各个基因的 mRNA 分子数。状态则是从这个快照里推断出来的结构——哪些基因模块一起打开、细胞处在轨迹的哪一段、和参考图谱的哪一类最接近。
What sequencing actually measures is only a transcriptome snapshot: the mRNA molecule counts of each gene in a given cell at a given moment. State is a structure inferred from that snapshot — which gene modules are switched on together, which segment of a trajectory a cell occupies, and which class in a reference atlas it most closely resembles.
这也是为什么单细胞分析里“聚类”只是中间产物：聚类给的是离散的盒子，而细胞状态往往是连续的。后面的拟时序、RNA velocity、模块打分，都是为了把盒子重新拆成连续谱。
This is also why clustering in single-cell analysis is only an intermediate product: clustering gives discrete boxes, whereas cell states are often continuous. The pseudotime, RNA velocity, and module scoring that follow all exist to break the boxes back into a continuum.
一个实用的判断标准是：如果你能用三五个 marker 稳定地区分两群细胞，它们更像类型；如果两群之间是渐变、而且可以被刺激/时间/剂量连续调节，它们更像状态。
A practical rule of thumb: if you can reliably separate two groups of cells with three to five markers, they look more like types; if the two groups form a gradient that can be tuned continuously by stimulation, time, or dose, they look more like states.

title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 4. 平台与方法 / Platforms and Methods
text:
4. 平台与方法 / Platforms and Methods
单细胞测序的核心难点不是测序本身，而是如何把每个 mRNA 分子归回它来自的那个细胞。主流方案分成几类：
The core difficulty of single-cell sequencing is not sequencing itself but how to assign each mRNA molecule back to the cell it came from. Mainstream approaches fall into several classes:

微流控液滴：细胞和凝胶珠被油相包成一个个液滴，珠子上带着细胞条码（cell barcode）和分子标签（UMI）。10x Genomics Chromium、Drop-seq、inDrop 都属于这一类，通量高、单细胞成本低。
Microfluidic droplets: cells and gel beads are encapsulated in oil into individual droplets, and the beads carry cell barcodes and UMIs. 10x Genomics Chromium, Drop-seq, and inDrop all belong to this class: high throughput and low per-cell cost.
纳米孔/微孔阵列：Seq-Well、BD Rhapsody 把细胞沉降到微孔里，再放上带条码的珠子，不依赖液滴，细胞捕获更温和。
Nanowells / microwell arrays: Seq-Well and BD Rhapsody settle cells into microwells and then add barcoded beads; they do not rely on droplets and capture cells more gently.
板式分选：Smart-seq2 / Smart-seq3 用 FACS 把单个细胞分到 96 或 384 孔板，全长转录本、灵敏度高，但通量低、成本高。
Plate-based sorting: Smart-seq2 / Smart-seq3 use FACS to sort single cells into 96- or 384-well plates; full-length transcripts and high sensitivity, but low throughput and high cost.
组合索引：SPLiT-seq、sci-RNA-seq 用多轮连接/拆分给细胞打“组合条码”，不需要专门仪器，适合超大规模。
Combinatorial indexing: SPLiT-seq and sci-RNA-seq tag cells with combinatorial barcodes through rounds of ligation and splitting; they need no dedicated instrument and suit very large scale.
单细胞多组学：10x Multiome 同时测 RNA 和 ATAC；CITE-seq 在 RNA 之外加抗体标签；Mission Bio Tapestri 做单细胞 DNA；单细胞甲基化有 scBS-seq、scNMT。
Single-cell multi-omics: 10x Multiome measures RNA and ATAC together; CITE-seq adds antibody tags on top of RNA; Mission Bio Tapestri does single-cell DNA; single-cell methylation includes scBS-seq and scNMT.
空间转录组：Visium、Xenium、CosMx、MERFISH 保留位置信息，是“单细胞”与“组织切片”的交叉。
Spatial transcriptomics: Visium, Xenium, CosMx, and MERFISH retain positional information and are the intersection of single cell and tissue section.



Code
platforms <- data.frame(
  platform = c(
    "10x Chromium 3'", "10x Chromium 5'", "10x Multiome",
    "Smart-seq2", "Smart-seq3", "Drop-seq", "Seq-Well", "BD Rhapsody"
  ),
  cells = c(1.0e4, 8.0e3, 9.0e3, 96, 96, 1.2e3, 7.0e2, 6.0e3),
  reads = c(2.0e4, 2.2e4, 4.5e4, 2.0e6, 1.0e6, 1.1e4, 9.0e3, 1.8e4),
  mode = c(
    "droplet, 3'", "droplet, 5'", "droplet, RNA + ATAC",
    "plate, full-length", "plate, full-length",
    "droplet, 3'", "nanowell, 3'", "nanowell, targeted"
  )
)

ggplot(platforms, aes(cells, reads, colour = mode)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = cells), alpha = 0.75) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = platform), size = 3, show.legend = FALSE,
    min.segment.length = 0, point.padding = 0.5, box.padding = 0.7,
    max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 9), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(pal[1:3], pal[4:7])) +
  labs(
    x = "cells per run (order of magnitude)", y = "reads per cell",
    colour = NULL, title = "Throughput versus depth"
  )








Figure 3: 不同平台的通量与每个细胞的测序深度大致呈反比。数值为常见量级，仅用于建立直觉。 | Throughput and per-cell sequencing depth are roughly inversely related across platforms. The values are common orders of magnitude, intended only to build intuition.

What really has to be traded off when choosing a platform comes down to four quantities: cell number, depth per cell, price per cell, and whether full-length, multi-omic, or spatial information is needed. 10x 3’ suits many cells with questions about composition and type; Smart-seq suits few cells with questions about isoforms, fusion genes, and low-abundance transcripts.

title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 5. 实验设计：在测序之前就决定了数据质量 / Experimental Design: Data Quality Is Decided Before Sequencing
text:
5. 实验设计：在测序之前就决定了数据质量 / Experimental Design: Data Quality Is Decided Before Sequencing
很多单细胞数据的问题不是分析造成的，而是实验设计造成的。
Many problems in single-cell data are not caused by analysis but by experimental design.

细胞数：常规图谱 5,000–20,000 个细胞足够；要做稀有细胞或连续状态，需要更多。上样细胞数 ≠ 回收细胞数，10x 的回收率通常 50%–70%。
Cell number: 5,000–20,000 cells is enough for a routine atlas; rare cells or continuous states need more. Cells loaded ≠ cells recovered; the recovery rate for 10x is usually 50%–70%.
测序深度：每个细胞 20,000–50,000 reads 是常见区间。深度不足表现为基因数少、dropout 多；深度过高则边际收益很低（见后面的饱和曲线）。
Sequencing depth: 20,000–50,000 reads per cell is the usual range. Insufficient depth shows up as few genes and many dropouts; excessive depth has very low marginal return (see the saturation curve later).
生物学重复：单细胞不能替代重复。每个条件至少 2–3 个供体/样本，否则无法区分处理效应和个体差异。
Biological replication: single cells cannot replace replicates. At least 2–3 donors or samples per condition, otherwise treatment effects cannot be separated from individual variation.
批次：不同天、不同操作者、不同 10x 芯片都是批次。设计上应尽量让每个批次包含所有条件（balanced design），而不是“一天做对照、一天做处理”。
Batch: different days, different operators, and different 10x chips are all batches. The design should, as far as possible, put every condition in every batch (a balanced design), rather than controls on one day and treatment on another.
** Multiplexing**：用 hashing 抗体（CellPlex）或基因型把多个样本混进一个 10x lane，可以显著降低批次效应，但需要额外的去卷积步骤。
** Multiplexing**: pooling several samples into one 10x lane with hashing antibodies (CellPlex) or genotypes markedly reduces batch effects, but requires an extra demultiplexing step.
组织解离：酶解会诱导应激基因（FOS、JUN、HSPA1A 等），可能需要加入转录抑制剂或改用单核测序（snRNA-seq）。
Tissue dissociation: enzymatic digestion induces stress genes (FOS, JUN, HSPA1A, and others), so a transcription inhibitor may need to be added or single-nucleus sequencing (snRNA-seq) used instead.
样本质量：冻存、存活率、RNA 完整性（RIN）都会直接影响空液滴比例和线粒体比例。
Sample quality: freezing, viability, and RNA integrity (RIN) all directly affect the empty-droplet fraction and the mitochondrial fraction.

title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 6. 细胞组成：第一个能讲故事的图 / Cell Composition: The First Figure That Tells a Story
text:
6. 细胞组成：第一个能讲故事的图 / Cell Composition: The First Figure That Tells a Story
拿到聚类之后，最直观的问题是“细胞类型比例有没有变化”。这也是单细胞项目里最容易被过度解读的图之一：比例受捕获效率、解离偏好、测序深度影响，必须结合重复和统计检验。
Once the clustering is in hand, the most intuitive question is whether the cell-type proportions have changed. This is also one of the most easily over-interpreted figures in single-cell projects: proportions are affected by capture efficiency, dissociation bias, and sequencing depth, so replicates and statistical tests are essential.


Code
comp <- data.frame(
  sample = rep(c("Ctrl-1", "Ctrl-2", "Treat-1", "Treat-2"), each = 5),
  celltype = rep(c("T", "B", "Myeloid", "NK", "Stromal"), 4),
  pct = c(
    0.32, 0.24, 0.28, 0.10, 0.06,
    0.30, 0.26, 0.27, 0.11, 0.06,
    0.48, 0.12, 0.25, 0.10, 0.05,
    0.46, 0.14, 0.26, 0.09, 0.05
  )
)

ggplot(comp, aes(sample, pct, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal[1:5]) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "fraction of cells", fill = NULL)








Figure 4: 细胞类型组成的堆叠柱状图。示例中处理组的 T 细胞比例升高、B 细胞比例下降；真实数据需要按样本重复做统计检验，而不是只看柱子。 | Stacked bar chart of cell-type composition. In the example the treated group shows a higher T-cell fraction and a lower B-cell fraction; real data require statistical testing across sample replicates rather than a look at the bars alone.

objectID: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#原始数据与文件格式-raw-data-and-file-formats
href: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#原始数据与文件格式-raw-data-and-file-formats
title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 7. 原始数据与文件格式 / Raw Data and File Formats
text:
7. 原始数据与文件格式 / Raw Data and File Formats
这是最容易含糊过去、但实际最影响后续分析的一节。单细胞项目从下机到分析，会经过至少六种文件格式。
This is the section most easily glossed over, yet the one that most affects downstream analysis. A single-cell project passes through at least six file formats from the sequencer run to analysis.

7.1 BCL：测序仪的原始输出 / BCL: The Sequencer’s Raw Output
测序仪下机的不是序列，而是每个 cycle、每个 tile 的荧光强度，存在 BCL 文件里。一个 run 的目录大致长这样：
What comes off the sequencer is not sequences but the fluorescence intensity of every tile in every cycle, stored in BCL files. The directory of a run looks roughly like this:
200101_A00123_0001_AH7VLYDSX2/
├── RunInfo.xml                  # 读长、cycle 数、tile 布局
├── SampleSheet.csv              # 样本索引与 lane 对应关系
├── Data/
│   └── Intensities/
│       └── BaseCalls/
│           ├── L001/
│           │   ├── C1.1/s_1_1101.bcl
│           │   └── C1.1/s_1_1101.stats
│           └── L002/...
└── InterOp/                     # 质控指标
bcl2fastq（Illumina）或 bcl-convert 负责 base calling 和 demultiplex，把 BCL 变成 FASTQ。对 10x 而言，一个 lane 里所有细胞的 reads 混在一起，靠 Read 1 的条码区分细胞。
bcl2fastq (Illumina) or bcl-convert performs base calling and demultiplexing, turning BCL into FASTQ. For 10x, the reads of all cells in a lane are pooled, and cells are distinguished by the barcode in Read 1.


7.2 FASTQ：序列 + 质量值 / FASTQ: Sequence + Quality Scores
FASTQ 是四行一条记录：header、序列、+、质量值（Phred33）。10x 的 Read 1 和 Read 2 是分开的两个文件：
FASTQ is four lines per record: header, sequence, +, and quality scores (Phred33). For 10x, Read 1 and Read 2 are two separate files:
@A00123:8:H7VLYDSX2:1:1101:1000:1000 1:N:0:SI-GA-A1
CAGGTGATTCAGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATCT
+
FFFFF,FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
@A00123:8:H7VLYDSX2:1:1101:1000:1000 2:N:0:SI-GA-A1
GATTACAGATTACAGGCGTGAGCCACCACGC
+
FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF

Header 里的 1:N:0:SI-GA-A1 表示 read 1、未过滤、样本索引。
The 1:N:0:SI-GA-A1 in the header indicates read 1, not filtered, and the sample index.
Read 1 的前 16 bp 是细胞条码，后 12 bp 是 UMI。
The first 16 bp of Read 1 are the cell barcode and the last 12 bp are the UMI.
Read 2 是 cDNA 插入片段。这时候还没有“基因”这个概念，只有碱基和位置。
Read 2 is the cDNA insert. At this point there is no concept of a gene yet, only bases and positions.



Code
read_map <- data.frame(
  read = factor(
    c("Read 1", "Read 1", "Read 2"),
    levels = c("Read 2", "Read 1")
  ),
  start = c(0, 16, 0),
  end = c(16, 28, 98),
  feature = c("Cell barcode (16 bp)", "UMI (12 bp)", "cDNA insert (91–150 bp)")
)

ggplot(read_map, aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = feature)) +
  geom_rect(colour = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = (start + end) / 2, y = 0.5, label = feature),
    colour = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 3.1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~read, ncol = 1, strip.position = "left") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(blog_pal[["blue"]], blog_pal[["green"]], blog_pal[["vermillion"]])) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 16, 28, 50, 100), limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "base position", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold")
  )








Figure 5: 10x 3’ 文库的 read 结构：Read 1 携带细胞条码和 UMI，Read 2 才是真正的 cDNA 序列。 | Read structure of a 10x 3’ library: Read 1 carries the cell barcode and the UMI, while Read 2 is the actual cDNA sequence.







7.3 BAM：比对后的 reads / BAM: Aligned Reads
比对（STAR / STARsolo / Cell Ranger）之后得到 BAM。单细胞 BAM 和普通 BAM 的区别在于每条 read 上多了两个标签：
After alignment (STAR / STARsolo / Cell Ranger) you get a BAM. A single-cell BAM differs from an ordinary BAM in that each read carries two extra tags:

CB:Z:AAACCTGAGAAACCAT-1 — 校正后的细胞条码。
CB:Z:AAACCTGAGAAACCAT-1 — the corrected cell barcode.
UB:Z:ACGTACGTACGT — 校正后的 UMI。
UB:Z:ACGTACGTACGT — the corrected UMI.

Cell Ranger 还会输出 possorted_genome_bam.bam（按坐标排序）和 molecule_info.h5（分子级别的信息，包含每个 UMI 的 reads 数、基因、条码）。如果要跑 RNA velocity、可变剪接或自定义计数，通常从 BAM 重新开始，而不是从 count matrix 开始。
Cell Ranger also outputs possorted_genome_bam.bam (coordinate-sorted) and molecule_info.h5 (molecule-level information, including the number of reads per UMI, the gene, and the barcode). To run RNA velocity, alternative splicing, or custom counting, one usually restarts from the BAM rather than from the count matrix.


7.4 计数矩阵：matrix.mtx + 两个 TSV / The Count Matrix: matrix.mtx + Two TSVs
Cell Ranger 的标准输出是 Market Matrix（MTX） 三件套：
The standard Cell Ranger output is the Market Matrix (MTX) trio:
outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/
├── barcodes.tsv.gz    # 每一列是一个细胞条码
├── features.tsv.gz    # 每一行是一个基因（ensembl id + symbol + 类型）
└── matrix.mtx.gz      # 稀疏矩阵：行号 列号 值
matrix.mtx 只存非零元素，文件头是矩阵维度，之后每行是 基因行号 细胞列号 UMI计数。这也是为什么单细胞矩阵必须用稀疏矩阵结构存储：90% 以上是 0。
matrix.mtx stores only non-zero elements; the file header gives the matrix dimensions, and each subsequent line is gene row index, cell column index, UMI count. This is also why single-cell matrices must be stored in a sparse structure: more than 90% of the entries are 0.


Code
set.seed(9)
n_cells <- 40
n_g <- 60
counts <- matrix(rpois(n_cells * n_g, 0.25), nrow = n_g)
for (i in 1:3) {
  rows <- ((i - 1) * 15 + 1):(i * 15)
  cols <- ((i - 1) * 13 + 1):(i * 13)
  counts[rows, cols] <- counts[rows, cols] + rpois(length(rows) * length(cols), 6)
}

mat_df <- data.frame(
  gene = rep(1:n_g, times = n_cells),
  cell = rep(1:n_cells, each = n_g),
  count = as.vector(counts)
)

ggplot(mat_df, aes(cell, gene, fill = log1p(count))) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FFFFFF", high = blog_pal[["blue"]]) +
  labs(x = "cells", y = "genes", fill = "log1p\ncounts") +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())








Figure 6: count matrix 的局部。每个点是一个基因 × 细胞计数，空白处是 0；三个细胞群各有一组高表达基因。 | A close-up of the count matrix. Each point is a gene × cell count and blanks are 0; each of the three cell groups has its own block of highly expressed genes.





这个 60 × 40 的小矩阵里有 59% 是 0。真实数据的非零比例通常只有 5%–15%。
In this small 60 × 40 matrix, 59% of the entries are 0. In real data the non-zero fraction is usually only 5%–15%.


7.5 HDF5 家族：.h5、.h5ad、.loom、.rds / The HDF5 Family: .h5, .h5ad, .loom, .rds
除了 MTX，实际项目里更常见的是各种容器格式。它们本质上是矩阵 + 行/列注释 + 降维结果的不同打包方式。
Beyond MTX, real projects more often use various container formats. They are essentially different ways of packaging a matrix + row and column annotations + dimensionality-reduction results.

.h5ad 的内部结构值得单独记住，因为几乎所有 Python 单细胞工具都以它为中心：
The internal structure of .h5ad is worth remembering on its own, because almost every Python single-cell tool is centred on it:
AnnData
├── X          cells × genes 的表达矩阵（通常是稀疏 CSR）
├── obs        每个细胞的元数据：barcode、QC、cluster、sample
├── var        每个基因的元数据：gene id、HVG、mean、dispersion
├── obsm       降维结果：X_pca、X_umap、X_scvi
├── obsp       细胞间图：connectivities、distances
├── layers     同一批细胞的其它矩阵：counts、normalized、scaled
├── raw        原始表达（标准化前）
└── uns        非结构化信息：颜色、参数、邻居数
对应的读取代码：
The corresponding reading code:
import scanpy as sc

# 10x MTX 目录
adata = sc.read_10x_mtx("outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix", var_names="gene_symbols")

# h5ad
adata = sc.read_h5ad("adata.h5ad")

# loom
adata = sc.read_loom("adata.loom")
library(Seurat)

# 10x MTX 目录
counts <- Read10X("outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix")
obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts)

# Cell Ranger 的 h5
obj <- Read10X_h5("outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")

# 保存好的 Seurat 对象
obj <- readRDS("seurat.rds")

实践建议：分析中间结果尽量用 .h5ad 或 .rds 保存完整对象，而不是只保存矩阵。只存矩阵会丢掉聚类、降维、参数和元数据，下一次分析无法复现。


Practical advice: save intermediate analysis results as complete objects in .h5ad or .rds rather than as matrices only. Saving only the matrix loses the clustering, dimensionality reduction, parameters, and metadata, and the next analysis cannot be reproduced.



7.6 Cell Ranger 输出目录 / The Cell Ranger Output Directory
一个典型的 outs/ 目录包含：
A typical outs/ directory contains:
outs/
├── filtered_feature_bc_matrix/     # 过滤后的细胞 × 基因矩阵（分析起点）
├── raw_feature_bc_matrix/          # 全部条码（含空液滴，用于 EmptyDrops）
├── molecule_info.h5                # 分子级信息（UMI、reads、基因）
├── possorted_genome_bam.bam        # 比对结果（含 CB/UB 标签）
├── possorted_genome_bam.bam.bai
├── metrics_summary.csv             # 关键 QC 指标
├── web_summary.html                # 自动报告（knee plot、饱和度、比对率）
└── cloupe.cloupe                   # Loupe Browser 可视化文件

title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 8. 从 FASTQ 到 count matrix / From FASTQ to a Count Matrix
text:
8. 从 FASTQ 到 count matrix / From FASTQ to a Count Matrix
以 10x 官方流程（Cell Ranger / STARsolo）为例，中间要做五件事：条码校正、比对、基因分配、UMI 去重、细胞 calling。
Taking the official 10x workflow (Cell Ranger / STARsolo) as an example, five things happen in between: barcode correction, alignment, gene assignment, UMI deduplication, and cell calling.

8.1 条码校正 / Barcode Correction
测序错误会让读到的 16 bp 条码与白名单不完全一致。标准做法是：如果某个条码与白名单中的某个条码只差 1 个碱基（Hamming distance = 1），就把它校正为白名单条码；差 2 个及以上则归入“未识别”。这一步必须在 UMI 去重之前完成，否则同一个细胞的 reads 会被拆成多个“假细胞”。
Sequencing errors make the 16 bp barcode that is read not fully match the whitelist. The standard approach is: if a barcode differs from a whitelist barcode by only 1 base (Hamming distance = 1), correct it to the whitelist barcode; a difference of 2 or more is classed as unrecognized. This step must be completed before UMI deduplication, otherwise the reads of one cell are split into several fake cells.


Code
set.seed(12)
make_bc <- function() paste(sample(c("A", "C", "G", "T"), 16, replace = TRUE), collapse = "")
whitelist <- replicate(6, make_bc())
observed <- whitelist[1]
substr(observed, 8, 8) <- ifelse(substr(observed, 8, 8) == "A", "C", "A")

hamming <- function(a, b) sum(strsplit(a, "")[[1]] != strsplit(b, "")[[1]])
bc <- data.frame(
  candidate = whitelist,
  distance = vapply(whitelist, function(b) hamming(observed, b), numeric(1))
)
bc <- bc[order(bc$distance), ]
bc$candidate <- factor(bc$candidate, levels = rev(bc$candidate))

ggplot(bc, aes(distance, candidate, fill = distance == min(distance))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = distance), hjust = -0.35, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = blog_pal[["grey"]], `TRUE` = blog_pal[["blue"]]),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max(bc$distance) + 1)) +
  labs(x = "Hamming distance to the observed barcode", y = "whitelist barcode")








Figure 7: 条码校正：观测到的条码与白名单逐个比较 Hamming 距离，只允许 1 个碱基的差异。 | Barcode correction: each observed barcode is compared with the whitelist by Hamming distance, and only a 1-base difference is allowed.





工程上还有两个细节：
There are two more engineering details:

条码白名单随试剂盒版本变化，用错版本会导致大量条码无法识别；Cell Ranger 会根据试剂盒自动选择。
The barcode whitelist changes with the kit version; using the wrong version leaves a large number of barcodes unrecognized; Cell Ranger selects it automatically according to the kit.
条码不是绝对唯一：约 737k 个条码里，两个真实细胞共用同一个条码的概率很低，但百万级细胞的项目需要评估碰撞。
Barcodes are not absolutely unique: among about 737k barcodes, the probability that two real cells share the same barcode is very low, but projects with millions of cells need to evaluate collisions.



8.2 比对与基因分配 / Alignment and Gene Assignment
Read 2 比对到参考基因组/转录组，得到它来自哪个基因的哪个位置。几个影响结果的参数：
Read 2 is aligned to the reference genome or transcriptome to determine which gene and which position it came from. Several parameters affect the result:

参考版本：GRCh38 的不同 patch、GENCODE 版本会改变基因集合和计数。
Reference version: different GRCh38 patches and GENCODE versions change the gene set and the counts.
外显子 vs 全基因：STARsolo 的 Gene 只数外显子，GeneFull 把内含子也算进去。后者对单核 RNA-seq（snRNA-seq）很重要，因为细胞核里大量是未剪接转录本。
Exons versus whole gene: STARsolo’s Gene counts only exons, whereas GeneFull also counts introns. The latter matters for single-nucleus RNA-seq (snRNA-seq), because the nucleus contains a large amount of unspliced transcripts.
链方向：10x 3’ 文库是反向链（reverse stranded），参数错了会得到几乎为 0 的计数。
Strand direction: 10x 3’ libraries are reverse stranded; the wrong parameter yields counts that are almost 0.
多比对 reads：重复序列、假基因、rRNA 会造成 multi-mapping。STARsolo 用 EM 算法在候选基因之间分配，而不是简单丢弃。
Multi-mapping reads: repeats, pseudogenes, and rRNA cause multi-mapping. STARsolo distributes them among candidate genes with an EM algorithm rather than simply discarding them.
rRNA/线粒体：通常单独统计，不进入下游 HVG。
rRNA and mitochondria: usually counted separately and kept out of the downstream HVG selection.



8.3 UMI 去重 / UMI Deduplication
同一个细胞里，同一个 UMI + 同一个基因的多条 read，视为同一个原始 mRNA 分子的 PCR 拷贝，只计一次。
Within the same cell, multiple reads sharing the same UMI and the same gene are treated as PCR copies of one original mRNA molecule and counted only once.


Code
umi <- data.frame(
  read = factor(paste0("read ", 1:7), levels = rev(paste0("read ", 1:7))),
  umi = c("ACGT", "ACGT", "ACGT", "TTGC", "TTGC", "GGAA", "CCAT"),
  gene = c("CD3D", "CD3D", "CD3D", "CD3D", "CD3D", "LYZ", "LYZ")
)
umi$status <- ifelse(duplicated(umi[, c("umi", "gene")]), "PCR duplicate", "unique molecule")

ggplot(umi, aes(umi, read, fill = status)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(status == "PCR duplicate", "dup", "unique")),
    size = 2.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "unique molecule" = blog_pal[["blue"]],
    "PCR duplicate"   = blog_pal[["grey"]]
  )) +
  labs(x = "UMI", y = NULL, fill = NULL, title = "UMI collapse")








Figure 8: UMI 的作用：同一个分子被 PCR 扩增成多条 read，但 UMI 相同，最终只计为 1 个分子。 | What UMIs do: one molecule is amplified by PCR into several reads, but they share the same UMI and are ultimately counted as 1 molecule.





严格去重（exact matching）会把测序错误的 UMI 当成新分子；更常用的策略是方向性邻接去重（directional adjacency）：只有当一个 UMI 的 reads 数远少于邻居、且只差 1 个碱基时，才把它合并。UMI-tools、Cell Ranger 都实现了类似逻辑。
Strict deduplication (exact matching) would treat a sequencing-error UMI as a new molecule; the more common strategy is directional adjacency: a UMI is merged only when its read count is far lower than those of its neighbours and it differs by exactly 1 base. UMI-tools and Cell Ranger implement similar logic.
测序越深，同一个细胞里被重复测到的分子越多，新增的 reads 能带来的新分子越来越少。这条饱和曲线决定了“要不要继续加测序量”。
The deeper the sequencing, the more often molecules in the same cell are sequenced again, and the fewer new molecules each additional read can contribute. This saturation curve determines whether to keep adding sequencing depth.


Code
depth <- seq(0, 60000, length.out = 150)
sat <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(depth = depth, molecules = 3000 * (1 - exp(-depth / 3000)), cell = "high complexity"),
  data.frame(depth = depth, molecules = 900 * (1 - exp(-depth / 900)), cell = "low complexity")
)

ggplot(sat, aes(depth, molecules, colour = cell)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(blog_pal[["blue"]], blog_pal[["vermillion"]])) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    x = "reads assigned to one cell", y = "unique molecules recovered",
    colour = NULL
  )








Figure 9: UMI 饱和曲线：测序深度增加时，能检测到的新分子迅速减少。低复杂度细胞更早饱和。 | UMI saturation curve: as sequencing depth increases, the number of new molecules that can be detected falls rapidly. Low-complexity cells saturate earlier.







8.4 空液滴识别 / Identifying Empty Droplets
液滴测序里绝大多数条码来自不含细胞的空液滴，它们只有少量背景 RNA。区分“真细胞”和“空液滴”靠的是条码秩图（knee plot）：按 UMI 数给条码排序，真细胞会形成一段平台，空液滴迅速掉到背景水平。
In droplet sequencing the overwhelming majority of barcodes come from empty droplets that contain no cell, carrying only a small amount of background RNA. Telling real cells from empty droplets relies on the barcode rank plot (knee plot): barcodes are ranked by UMI count, real cells form a plateau, and empty droplets fall rapidly to the background level.


Code
cell_umi <- rlnorm(5000, log(3200), 0.55)
empty_umi <- rlnorm(15000, log(10), 0.9)
umi_all <- sort(c(cell_umi, empty_umi), decreasing = TRUE)
knee <- data.frame(
  rank = seq_along(umi_all),
  umi = umi_all,
  type = rep(c("Cells", "Empty droplets"), c(5000, 15000))
)

ggplot(knee, aes(rank, umi, colour = type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5000, linetype = "dashed", colour = blog_pal[["grey"]]) +
  annotate("text", x = 5600, y = 6000, label = "called cells", hjust = 0, size = 3.2) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(blog_pal[["blue"]], blog_pal[["grey"]])) +
  labs(x = "barcode rank", y = "UMI count", colour = NULL)








Figure 10: 条码秩图。平台与背景之间的拐点就是细胞 calling 的阈值。 | Barcode rank plot. The inflection between the plateau and the background is the threshold for cell calling.





Cell Ranger 的固定阈值（例如 UMI ≥ 500）在低深度或高背景样本里经常失效。更稳健的方法是 EmptyDrops：对每个条码检验其基因表达谱是否显著偏离背景，而不是只看总 UMI 数。
Cell Ranger’s fixed threshold (for example UMI ≥ 500) often fails in low-depth or high-background samples. A more robust method is EmptyDrops: rather than looking only at the total UMI count, it tests for each barcode whether its gene expression profile deviates significantly from the background.


8.5 输出与稀疏性 / Output and Sparsity
最终产物是三个文件：matrix.mtx（稀疏矩阵）、barcodes.tsv（细胞）、features.tsv（基因）。一个细胞通常只检测到 1,000–5,000 个基因，而人类基因组有两万多个蛋白编码基因，所以矩阵的稀疏度通常在 85%–95%。
The final product is three files: matrix.mtx (the sparse matrix), barcodes.tsv (cells), and features.tsv (genes). A cell typically has only 1,000–5,000 genes detected, whereas the human genome has more than twenty thousand protein-coding genes, so the matrix is usually 85%–95% sparse.

从这一步开始，所有分析都建立在稀疏矩阵上。任何把矩阵转成 dense data.frame 的操作，在十万级细胞时都会直接爆内存。


From this point on, all analysis rests on the sparse matrix. Any operation that converts the matrix into a dense data.frame will run out of memory outright at the hundred-thousand-cell scale.

title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 9. 质控：先把不是细胞的、坏掉的细胞去掉 / Quality Control: First Remove What Is Not a Cell and What Is Broken
text:
9. 质控：先把不是细胞的、坏掉的细胞去掉 / Quality Control: First Remove What Is Not a Cell and What Is Broken
拿到矩阵后第一件事不是聚类，而是 QC。常用指标：
The first thing to do with the matrix is not clustering but QC. Common metrics:

每个细胞的 UMI 总数：太低是空液滴或破损细胞，太高可能是双细胞。
Total UMIs per cell: too low means an empty droplet or a broken cell; too high may mean a doublet.
检测到的基因数：和 UMI 数高度相关，但能暴露低复杂度文库。
Number of genes detected: strongly correlated with the UMI count, but it exposes low-complexity libraries.
线粒体基因比例：细胞膜破损时胞质 RNA 流失，线粒体转录本占比升高。不同组织阈值差异很大（2%–20%）。
Mitochondrial gene fraction: when the cell membrane is damaged, cytoplasmic RNA leaks out and the fraction of mitochondrial transcripts rises. Thresholds differ greatly between tissues (2%–20%).
核糖体基因比例：过高可能提示 rRNA 污染或特定状态。
Ribosomal gene fraction: an elevated value may indicate rRNA contamination or a particular state.
双细胞（doublet）：两个细胞进了同一个液滴，会表现成“混合表达”的假细胞。
Doublets: two cells entering the same droplet appear as a fake cell with mixed expression.



Code
set.seed(21)
n <- 1200
counts_total <- rlnorm(n, log(4200), 0.5)
qc <- data.frame(
  counts = counts_total,
  genes = round(counts_total^0.62 / 4 + rnorm(n, 0, 120)),
  mito = pmax(0, rnorm(n, 14 - 0.001 * counts_total, 4))
)
qc$pass <- qc$counts > 1000 & qc$genes > 300 & qc$mito < 20

p1 <- ggplot(qc, aes(counts, genes, colour = mito)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = blog_pal[["blue"]], high = blog_pal[["vermillion"]]) +
  labs(x = "UMI per cell", y = "genes detected", colour = "% mito")

p2 <- ggplot(qc, aes(pass, counts, fill = pass)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7, colour = NA) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(blog_pal[["vermillion"]], blog_pal[["blue"]])) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "UMI per cell", fill = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p1 + p2








Figure 11: 左：UMI 数与基因数的关系，颜色为线粒体比例；右：过滤前后每个细胞的 UMI 分布。 | Left: UMI count versus gene count, coloured by the mitochondrial fraction; right: the distribution of UMIs per cell before and after filtering.





阈值不建议直接抄“UMI > 1000、基因 > 500”。更稳妥的做法是按样本看分布，用 MAD（median absolute deviation）或分位数设阈值，并把过滤前后的细胞数、基因数记录下来。过度过滤会系统性丢掉低 RNA 含量的真实细胞（例如静息 T 细胞、红细胞、某些神经元）。
Copying thresholds such as UMI > 1000 and genes > 500 directly is not advisable. A more robust approach is to look at the distribution per sample, set thresholds with the MAD (median absolute deviation) or with quantiles, and record the cell and gene counts before and after filtering. Over-filtering systematically discards real cells with low RNA content (for example resting T cells, red blood cells, and some neurons).
双细胞率随上样细胞数上升。10x 的经验公式大致是每 1,000 个细胞约 0.8%，所以 10,000 个细胞里可能有 800 个左右的 doublet，需要用 Scrublet、DoubletFinder 或 scDblFinder 检测。
The doublet rate rises with the number of cells loaded. The empirical 10x formula is roughly 0.8% per 1,000 cells, so 10,000 cells may contain around 800 doublets, which need to be detected with Scrublet, DoubletFinder, or scDblFinder.


Code
cells <- seq(500, 20000, by = 500)
doublet <- data.frame(cells = cells, rate = 0.008 * cells / 1000)

ggplot(doublet, aes(cells, rate * 100)) +
  geom_line(colour = blog_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(
    data = data.frame(cells = c(1000, 5000, 10000, 20000)),
    aes(cells, 0.008 * cells / 1000 * 100),
    colour = blog_pal[["vermillion"]], size = 2.5
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "cells loaded", y = "expected doublets (%)")








Figure 12: 双细胞率与上样细胞数的近似关系（10x 经验值）。 | Approximate relationship between the doublet rate and the number of cells loaded (empirical 10x values).





还有一类污染不容易在 QC 图里看到：ambient RNA。空液滴里的游离 RNA 会附着到真细胞上，让所有细胞都“表达”某些高丰度基因（例如血红蛋白、白蛋白、免疫球蛋白）。SoupX、CellBender 可以估计背景并扣除。判断方法是看空液滴矩阵里哪些基因最高，以及这些基因是否在所有细胞类型里均匀出现。
There is another kind of contamination that is not easy to see in QC plots: ambient RNA. Free RNA in empty droplets attaches to real cells, making all cells appear to express certain high-abundance genes (for example haemoglobin, albumin, and immunoglobulins). SoupX and CellBender can estimate and subtract the background. One way to judge is to look at which genes are highest in the empty-droplet matrix and whether those genes appear uniformly across all cell types.

objectID: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#标准化特征选择降维聚类-normalization-feature-selection-dimensionality-reduction-and-clustering
href: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#标准化特征选择降维聚类-normalization-feature-selection-dimensionality-reduction-and-clustering
title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 10. 标准化、特征选择、降维、聚类 / Normalization, Feature Selection, Dimensionality Reduction, and Clustering
text:
10. 标准化、特征选择、降维、聚类 / Normalization, Feature Selection, Dimensionality Reduction, and Clustering
原始 UMI 计数受三个因素影响：细胞本身的 RNA 总量、捕获效率、测序深度。所以要先标准化，再做降维。
Raw UMI counts are affected by three factors: the cell’s own total RNA content, the capture efficiency, and the sequencing depth. So normalize first, then reduce dimensions.

10.1 标准化 / Normalization
最常见的做法是 library-size normalization + log1p：每个细胞除以总计数，乘一个常数（常用 10,000），再取 log1p。它的作用是把“均值–方差”关系拉平，让高表达基因不再天然占据全部方差。
The most common approach is library-size normalization + log1p: divide each cell by its total count, multiply by a constant (commonly 10,000), and then take log1p. Its effect is to flatten the mean–variance relationship so that highly expressed genes no longer naturally occupy all of the variance.


Code
mu <- 10^seq(0, 4, length.out = 150)
mv <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(mean = mu, variance = mu + (0.5 * mu)^2, method = "Raw counts"),
  data.frame(mean = mu, variance = 0.2 + 1.2 / (mu + 1), method = "Log-normalized")
)

ggplot(mv, aes(mean, variance)) +
  geom_line(colour = blog_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ method, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "mean expression", y = "variance")








Figure 13: 原始计数的方差随均值平方增长；log 标准化后方差近似与均值无关。 | The variance of raw counts grows with the square of the mean; after log normalization the variance is approximately independent of the mean.





其他常用方案：
Other common approaches:

scran pooling：先对细胞分组、用 pooled size factor 估计，适合细胞间 RNA 总量差异很大的数据。
scran pooling: group the cells first and estimate with a pooled size factor; suited to data in which total RNA content differs greatly between cells.
SCTransform / Pearson residuals：直接用负二项模型对计数建模，输出残差，避免 log 变换的偏差。
SCTransform / Pearson residuals: model the counts directly with a negative binomial model and output residuals, avoiding the bias of the log transform.
scVI / totalVI：用变分自编码器学习低维表示，同时校正批次；适合十万级以上细胞。
scVI / totalVI: learn a low-dimensional representation with a variational autoencoder while correcting for batch; suited to a hundred thousand cells and beyond.



10.2 特征选择 / Feature Selection
标准化之后选出高变基因（HVG），只保留信息量最大的 2,000–3,000 个基因。常用方法有 vst、mean.var.plot、dispersion，以及基于 Poisson 偏差的 scry。HVG 的选择会显著影响聚类结果，建议做敏感性分析（例如 1,000 / 2,000 / 4,000 个基因各跑一次）。
After normalization, highly variable genes (HVGs) are selected, keeping only the 2,000–3,000 most informative genes. Common methods include vst, mean.var.plot, dispersion, and the Poisson-deviance-based scry. The choice of HVGs markedly affects the clustering result, so a sensitivity analysis is recommended (for example running once each with 1,000 / 2,000 / 4,000 genes).


10.3 PCA、kNN 图与聚类 / PCA, the kNN Graph, and Clustering
PCA 的前几十个主成分构成细胞的低维表示，在这个空间里建 kNN 图，用 Leiden/Louvain 做社区发现，就得到了聚类；UMAP 或 tSNE 只是把这个图再压到二维用来可视化。
The first few dozen principal components of PCA form the low-dimensional representation of the cells; a kNN graph is built in this space, and community detection with Leiden/Louvain yields the clusters; UMAP or tSNE merely compresses that graph into two dimensions for visualization.


Code
set.seed(8)
pts <- data.frame(
  x = c(rnorm(45, 0, 0.7), rnorm(45, 3.2, 0.7)),
  y = c(rnorm(45, 0, 0.7), rnorm(45, 2.4, 0.7)),
  group = factor(rep(c("Cluster A", "Cluster B"), each = 45))
)
d <- as.matrix(dist(pts[, c("x", "y")]))
k <- 4
edges <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(pts)), function(i) {
  nn <- order(d[i, ])[2:(k + 1)]
  data.frame(x = pts$x[i], y = pts$y[i], xend = pts$x[nn], yend = pts$y[nn])
}))

ggplot(pts, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_segment(
    data = edges, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
    colour = blog_pal[["grey"]], linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = group), size = 1.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(blog_pal[["blue"]], blog_pal[["vermillion"]])) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2", colour = NULL)








Figure 14: 聚类的本质是图分割：每个细胞连到最近的 k 个邻居，社区发现算法在图上找连接更密的区域。 | Clustering is essentially graph partitioning: each cell is connected to its k nearest neighbours, and a community-detection algorithm finds regions of denser connectivity in the graph.







Code
set.seed(33)
genes <- 300
per <- 100

make_block <- function(i) {
  m <- matrix(rnorm(genes * per, 5, 1), nrow = genes)
  rows <- ((i - 1) * 40 + 1):(i * 40)
  m[rows, ] <- m[rows, ] + 3.5
  m
}

expr <- do.call(cbind, lapply(1:3, make_block))
expr[expr < 0] <- 0
pca <- prcomp(t(expr), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
km <- kmeans(pca$x[, 1:10], centers = 3, nstart = 20)
emb <- data.frame(PC1 = pca$x[, 1], PC2 = pca$x[, 2], cluster = factor(km$cluster))
var_pc <- round(100 * summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2], 1)
centers <- emb %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(PC1 = mean(PC1), PC2 = mean(PC2), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(emb, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.75) +
  stat_ellipse(linewidth = 0.5) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = centers,
    aes(label = paste("Cluster", cluster)),
    fill = "white", alpha = 0.88, label.size = 0.25, size = 3, seed = 1,
    point.padding = unit(0.8, "lines"), box.padding = 0.8,
    min.segment.length = 0, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal[1:3]) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_pc[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_pc[2], "%)"),
    colour = "cluster"
  )








Figure 15: 对模拟的三群细胞做 PCA 与 k-means：聚类结构在 PC1–PC2 上已经很清楚。 | PCA and k-means on three simulated groups of cells: the cluster structure is already clear on PC1–PC2.





关于聚类有三个常见误解：
There are three common misconceptions about clustering:

分辨率不是越高越好：Leiden 的 resolution 越大，簇越多；要结合 marker 和稳定性选择，而不是调到“看起来分得开”。
Higher resolution is not better: the larger Leiden’s resolution, the more clusters; choose it together with markers and stability rather than tuning it until the groups look separated.
UMAP 的距离不是生物学距离：它只保留局部邻接关系，簇间距离和面积都不代表相似度或细胞数。
UMAP distances are not biological distances: it preserves only local adjacency, and neither the distances between clusters nor their areas represent similarity or cell number.
聚类不是细胞类型：一个 cluster 可以包含多个类型，一个类型也可以被拆成多个 cluster；注释需要 marker 或参考映射。
A cluster is not a cell type: one cluster can contain several types, and one type can be split into several clusters; annotation requires markers or reference mapping.

objectID: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#注释细胞类型-annotating-cell-types
href: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#注释细胞类型-annotating-cell-types
title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 11. 注释细胞类型 / Annotating Cell Types
text:
11. 注释细胞类型 / Annotating Cell Types
聚类只给出 cluster 0、1、2，接下来才是生物学：这些 cluster 是什么细胞、处于什么状态。
Clustering only gives cluster 0, 1, 2; the biology comes next: what cells these clusters are and what state they are in.
最常用的方法是标记基因：看每个 cluster 里哪些基因特异高表达。把“表达比例”和“平均表达量”画成点图，是单细胞文章里最常见的图之一。
The most common approach is marker genes: look at which genes are specifically highly expressed in each cluster. Plotting expression fraction against mean expression as a dot plot is one of the most familiar figures in single-cell papers.


Code
markers <- data.frame(
  gene = c("CD3D", "CD79A", "LYZ", "NKG7"),
  cluster = c("T", "B", "Myeloid", "NK")
)
grid <- expand.grid(gene = markers$gene, cluster = c("T", "B", "Myeloid", "NK"))
grid$own <- markers$cluster[match(grid$gene, markers$gene)] == grid$cluster
set.seed(4)
grid$pct <- ifelse(grid$own, runif(nrow(grid), 70, 95), runif(nrow(grid), 5, 40))
grid$avg <- ifelse(grid$own, runif(nrow(grid), 1.5, 3), runif(nrow(grid), 0, 1))

ggplot(grid, aes(cluster, gene)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = pct, colour = avg)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 8)) +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = blog_pal[["grey"]], high = blog_pal[["blue"]]) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, size = "% expressed", colour = "mean\nexpression")








Figure 16: 标记基因点图：点的大小是表达该基因的细胞比例，颜色是平均表达量。 | Marker-gene dot plot: dot size is the fraction of cells expressing the gene, and colour is the mean expression.





注释的三条路径：
Three routes to annotation:

人工 marker：可解释性最好，但依赖经验，且对稀有类型不敏感。
Manual markers: the most interpretable, but depends on experience and is insensitive to rare types.
参考映射：把细胞投影到已注释的参考图谱（Azimuth、scType、CellTypist、scANVI），适合免疫、脑等有成熟图谱的组织。
Reference mapping: project the cells onto an annotated reference atlas (Azimuth, scType, CellTypist, scANVI), suited to tissues with mature atlases such as immune and brain.
自动聚类 + 差异基因：先找每个 cluster 的 top genes，再和文献/数据库比对。
Automatic clustering + differential genes: find the top genes of each cluster and then compare them with the literature or databases.

注释之后建议做两件事：亚聚类（在某个类型内部再分状态）和独立验证（蛋白流式、原位杂交、空间转录组）。只靠同一批 marker 循环论证，是单细胞文章最常见的硬伤。
Two things are recommended after annotation: subclustering (splitting states within a type) and independent validation (protein flow cytometry, in situ hybridization, spatial transcriptomics). Arguing in a circle with the same set of markers is the most common weakness of single-cell papers.

objectID: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#细胞状态与动态过程-cell-states-and-dynamic-processes
href: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#细胞状态与动态过程-cell-states-and-dynamic-processes
title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 12. 细胞状态与动态过程 / Cell States and Dynamic Processes
text:
12. 细胞状态与动态过程 / Cell States and Dynamic Processes
除了离散的标记基因，状态还可以用打分来描述：细胞周期（S/G2M）、耗竭（exhaustion）、干扰素响应、缺氧、衰老……这些分数通常是一组基因的平均表达，在 UMAP 上用连续色阶展示。打分方法有 AddModuleScore、UCell、AUCell、GSVA，区别在于是否考虑背景表达和细胞间可比性。
Besides discrete marker genes, state can also be described by scoring: cell cycle (S/G2M), exhaustion, interferon response, hypoxia, senescence, and so on. These scores are usually the mean expression of a gene set, shown on UMAP as a continuous colour scale. Scoring methods include AddModuleScore, UCell, AUCell, and GSVA, which differ in whether background expression and comparability between cells are taken into account.
如果细胞来自一个分化过程，聚类得到的离散标签就不够用了。拟时序（pseudotime）把细胞按表达相似性排到一条轨迹上，RNA velocity则用未剪接/已剪接 reads 的比例预测每个细胞“下一步往哪走”。
If the cells come from a differentiation process, the discrete labels from clustering are no longer sufficient. Pseudotime orders cells along a trajectory by expression similarity, while RNA velocity uses the ratio of unspliced to spliced reads to predict where each cell will go next.


Code
set.seed(6)
n_cells <- 80
n_g <- 40
t <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n_cells)
peaks <- seq(0.08, 0.92, length.out = n_g)
wave <- outer(peaks, t, function(p, tt) exp(-((tt - p)^2) / (2 * 0.055^2)))

pt <- expand.grid(gene = 1:n_g, cell = 1:n_cells)
pt$expr <- as.vector(wave)

ggplot(pt, aes(cell, gene, fill = expr)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#FFFFFF", "#56B4E9", "#0072B2", "#CC79A7")) +
  labs(x = "pseudotime →", y = "genes", fill = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())








Figure 17: 拟时序热图：每一行是一个基因，按峰值位置排序，可以看到基因模块沿轨迹依次开启。 | Pseudotime heatmap: each row is a gene, ordered by the position of its peak, showing gene modules switching on in sequence along the trajectory.







Code
tt <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 35)
x <- cos(tt * pi * 1.15)
y <- sin(tt * pi * 0.85)
vel <- data.frame(
  x = x, y = y, t = tt,
  vx = c(diff(x), 0), vy = c(diff(y), 0)
)

ggplot(vel, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = x + vx * 4, yend = y + vy * 4, colour = t),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "cm"), type = "closed"), linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = t), size = 1.6) +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = blog_pal[["sky"]], high = blog_pal[["vermillion"]]) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2", colour = "pseudotime")








Figure 18: RNA velocity 的直观形式：每个细胞的箭头指向它预测的下一个状态。 | An intuitive picture of RNA velocity: each cell’s arrow points to the next state it predicts.





需要强调的是：注释不是终点，而是下一轮分析的起点。你得到的不是一个“答案”，而是一组带标签的细胞和一堆可以验证的假设。
It should be stressed that annotation is not the end point but the starting point of the next round of analysis. What you get is not an answer but a set of labelled cells and a pile of hypotheses that can be tested.

objectID: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#多组学整合与空间-multi-omics-integration-and-space
href: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#多组学整合与空间-multi-omics-integration-and-space
title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 13. 多组学、整合与空间 / Multi-omics, Integration, and Space
text:
13. 多组学、整合与空间 / Multi-omics, Integration, and Space
单细胞项目很少只做一个模态。常见的组合：
Single-cell projects rarely involve only one modality. Common combinations:

RNA + ATAC（10x Multiome）：同一批细胞核同时测表达和染色质可及性，用 WNN（weighted nearest neighbor）联合聚类，可以把“哪个 enhancer 驱动了哪个基因”放到同一个细胞里看。
RNA + ATAC (10x Multiome): expression and chromatin accessibility are measured in the same batch of nuclei; joint clustering with WNN (weighted nearest neighbour) lets which enhancer drives which gene be examined in the same cell.
RNA + 蛋白（CITE-seq）：抗体标签（ADT）提供表面蛋白，常用来区分 T 细胞亚群、NK 亚群，或做样本 hashing。
RNA + protein (CITE-seq): antibody tags (ADTs) provide surface proteins and are often used to distinguish T-cell and NK subsets, or to hash samples.
RNA + 空间（Visium / Xenium）：把单细胞图谱映射到组织切片，回答“这群细胞在哪个区域”。
RNA + space (Visium / Xenium): map the single-cell atlas onto a tissue section to answer in which region this group of cells sits.
多样本整合：Harmony、BBKNN、scVI、Seurat CCA/RPCA。整合的目标是去掉批次，不是把所有样本强行混在一起；如果生物学差异本身很大，过度整合会抹掉真实信号。
Multi-sample integration: Harmony, BBKNN, scVI, Seurat CCA/RPCA. The goal of integration is to remove batch, not to force all samples together; if the biological differences themselves are large, over-integration erases real signal.



Code
set.seed(15)
demo <- data.frame(
  x = c(rnorm(80, -2, 0.8), rnorm(80, 2, 0.8)),
  y = c(rnorm(80, 0, 0.8), rnorm(80, 0, 0.8)),
  type = factor(rep(c("T", "B"), each = 80)),
  batch = factor(rep(c("batch 1", "batch 2"), 80))
)
demo$x[demo$batch == "batch 2"] <- demo$x[demo$batch == "batch 2"] + 1.6

p1 <- ggplot(demo, aes(x, y, colour = batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(blog_pal[["blue"]], blog_pal[["orange"]])) +
  labs(title = "before", x = "PC1", y = "PC2", colour = NULL)

p2 <- ggplot(demo, aes(x - ifelse(batch == "batch 2", 1.6, 0), y, colour = type)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(blog_pal[["blue"]], blog_pal[["vermillion"]])) +
  labs(title = "after", x = "PC1", y = "PC2", colour = NULL)

p1 + p2








Figure 19: 整合的直观目标：左图按样本分开，右图按细胞类型混合；好的整合应当去掉批次但保留类型。 | The intuitive goal of integration: the left panel separates by sample and the right panel mixes by cell type; good integration should remove batch while preserving type.

objectID: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#从-count-matrix-到下一轮结果-from-the-count-matrix-to-the-next-round-of-results
href: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#从-count-matrix-到下一轮结果-from-the-count-matrix-to-the-next-round-of-results
title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 14. 从 count matrix 到下一轮结果 / From the Count Matrix to the Next Round of Results
text:
14. 从 count matrix 到下一轮结果 / From the Count Matrix to the Next Round of Results
单细胞项目的“下一轮”通常发生在五个方向：
The next round of a single-cell project usually happens in five directions:

差异表达：某个基因在病人和对照的同一细胞类型里是否变化？推荐 pseudobulk + DESeq2/edgeR，而不是把每个细胞当独立样本做 Wilcoxon（后者会给出极小的 p 值）。
Differential expression: does a gene change in the same cell type between patients and controls? pseudobulk + DESeq2/edgeR is recommended, rather than treating each cell as an independent sample in a Wilcoxon test (the latter yields extremely small p values).
细胞比例：某个细胞类型是否扩增或缺失？用 propeller、sccomp、scCODA 等考虑组成数据的模型，并按样本重复检验。
Cell proportions: is a cell type expanded or depleted? Use models that account for compositional data, such as propeller, sccomp, and scCODA, and test across sample replicates.
细胞间通讯：配体–受体共表达分析（CellChat、CellPhoneDB、NicheNet）推测哪群细胞在“对话”。
Cell–cell communication: ligand–receptor co-expression analysis (CellChat, CellPhoneDB, NicheNet) to infer which groups of cells are talking to each other.
多组学整合：把 RNA 与 ATAC、蛋白、空间位置对齐（Harmony、scVI、TotalVI、WNN）。
Multi-omics integration: align RNA with ATAC, protein, and spatial position (Harmony, scVI, TotalVI, WNN).
把状态映射回组织：用参考图谱做 label transfer（Azimuth），或把单细胞图谱反卷积到空间转录组上。
Mapping state back to tissue: label transfer with a reference atlas (Azimuth), or deconvolving the single-cell atlas onto spatial transcriptomics.

整条链路可以压缩成一张图：
The whole chain can be compressed into a single figure:


Code
steps <- data.frame(
  x = 1:6,
  label = c(
    "Tissue\n→ single cells", "Droplet\nbarcode + UMI", "FASTQ\nreads",
    "Count matrix\ncells × genes", "QC, clustering\nannotation", "Cell states\n→ next question"
  )
)

ggplot(steps, aes(x = x, y = 0)) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(xmin = x - 0.44, xmax = x + 0.44, ymin = -0.3, ymax = 0.3),
    fill = "#E8F1F8", colour = blog_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3, lineheight = 1) +
  geom_segment(
    data = data.frame(x = 1:5),
    aes(x = x + 0.44, xend = x + 0.56, y = 0, yend = 0),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    colour = blog_pal[["blue"]]
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.4, 6.6), ylim = c(-0.5, 0.5)) +
  theme_void()








Figure 20: 从组织到细胞状态的完整链路。每一步的输出都是下一步的输入。 | The complete chain from tissue to cell state. The output of every step is the input of the next.

href: posts/2026-10-22 Single-cell sequencing/index.html#常见坑与检查清单-common-pitfalls-and-a-checklist
title: Single-cell sequencing: from a cell to a cell state
section: 15. 常见坑与检查清单 / Common Pitfalls and a Checklist
text:
15. 常见坑与检查清单 / Common Pitfalls and a Checklist
分析前
Before analysis

参考基因组版本、试剂盒版本、链方向是否一致？
Are the reference genome version, kit version, and strand direction consistent?
是否有生物学重复？批次是否平衡？
Are there biological replicates? Is the batch balanced?
空液滴阈值是否按样本检查过？
Has the empty-droplet threshold been checked per sample?

分析中
During analysis

是否做 doublet 检测？doublet 是否被当成新类型？
Is doublet detection performed? Have doublets been treated as a new type?
是否检查 ambient RNA？高丰度污染基因是否驱动了聚类？
Is ambient RNA checked? Do high-abundance contaminating genes drive the clustering?
过滤阈值是否过严？是否丢掉了低 RNA 含量的真实细胞？
Are the filtering thresholds too strict? Have real cells with low RNA content been lost?
HVG 数量、PC 数、Leiden 分辨率是否做过敏感性分析？
Have the HVG number, PC number, and Leiden resolution been tested in a sensitivity analysis?
整合是否过度？批次和生物学是否被混为一谈？
Is the integration excessive? Have batch and biology been conflated?

解释时
When interpreting

是否用 pseudobulk 做差异表达？
Is differential expression done with pseudobulk?
细胞比例变化是否按样本重复检验？
Are changes in cell proportions tested across sample replicates?
marker 是否独立验证？是否循环论证？
Are markers validated independently? Is the argument circular?
UMAP 距离/面积是否被当作生物学差异？
Are UMAP distances or areas treated as biological differences?
结论是否能被第二个数据集、蛋白或空间数据支持？
Can the conclusions be supported by a second dataset, protein, or spatial data?

section: 16. 术语表 / Glossary
text:
16. 术语表 / Glossary



术语
含义




Cell barcode
16 bp 细胞标签，标识一个液滴/细胞


UMI
分子标签，用于去除 PCR 重复


Whitelist
平台预设的合法条码列表


Empty droplet
不含细胞、只有背景 RNA 的液滴


Ambient RNA
空液滴中的游离 RNA，会污染真细胞


Doublet
两个细胞进入同一个液滴


Count matrix
基因 × 细胞的 UMI 计数矩阵


HVG
高变基因，用于降维


Pseudobulk
把同一细胞类型的细胞计数相加成样本级表达


Label transfer
把参考图谱的细胞类型标签映射到新数据


Pseudotime
按表达相似性推断的细胞顺序


RNA velocity
用剪接比例预测细胞状态变化方向



English







Term
Meaning




Cell barcode
a 16 bp cell tag that identifies a droplet or cell


UMI
a molecular tag used to remove PCR duplicates


Whitelist
the list of valid barcodes predefined by the platform


Empty droplet
a droplet with no cell and only background RNA


Ambient RNA
free RNA from empty droplets that contaminates real cells


Doublet
two cells entering the same droplet


Count matrix
a gene × cell UMI count matrix


HVG
highly variable genes, used for dimensionality reduction


Pseudobulk
summing counts of cells of the same type into sample-level expression


Label transfer
mapping cell-type labels from a reference atlas onto new data


Pseudotime
a cell ordering inferred from expression similarity


RNA velocity
predicting the direction of state change from splicing ratios

objectID: posts/2025-04-23 gfatools for Graphical Fragment Assembly files/index.html
href: posts/2025-04-23 gfatools for Graphical Fragment Assembly files/index.html
title: gfatools for GFA (graphical fragment assembly) files
text:
GFA（Graphical Fragment Assembly，图形化片段组装）格式用于序列组装图。它由 Heng Li 博士（Prof. Dr. Heng Li）于 2014 年提出。以下是他当时的提案：https://lh3.github.io/2014/07/19/a-proposal-of-the-grapical-fragment-assembly-format。
GFA (Graphical Fragment Assembly) format is used for sequence assembly graphs. It was proposed by Prof. Dr. Heng Li in 2014. Here is his proposal: https://lh3.github.io/2014/07/19/a-proposal-of-the-grapical-fragment-assembly-format.
在过去十年里，他不断更新这一格式，使其更加完善。以下是他对 rGFA 格式的说明：http://www.liheng.org/downloads/rGFA-GAF.pdf。另一个是 https://github.com/lh3/gfatools/blob/master/doc/rGFA.md。
He updated this format in past 10 years to make it better. Here is his description about rGFA format: http://www.liheng.org/downloads/rGFA-GAF.pdf. Another one is https://github.com/lh3/gfatools/blob/master/doc/rGFA.md.
简而言之，GFA 格式与同样由他开发的 SAM 格式很相似。（我很喜欢他的工作，这对学术界帮助很大。）
Shortly, GFA format is like SAM format, which is also developed by him. (I really like his work, that helped the academia a lot).

GFA 是一种简单的、以 TAB 分隔的文本格式，由 12 个必需字段组成，用于表示比对到参考泛基因组图（pan-genome graph）上的 reads：• 第 1–4 列：查询名称、长度、起始与结束位置。• 第 5 列：查询链相对于第 6 列中比对路径的方向。• 第 6 列：稳定的图路径，其格式匹配正则表达式 /([><][^\s><]+:\d+- \d+)+|([^\s><]+)/。小于号或大于号表示片段（segment）的方向。如果一条路径只包含单个片段，则可以省略坐标，并假定其方向为正向“>”。• 第 7–9 列：路径总长度、在路径正链上的起始与结束比对位置。• 第 10–12 列：匹配碱基数量、比对块长度和比对质量


GFA is a simple TAB-dellimited text format consisting of 12 mandatory fields to represent reads aligned to a reference pan-genome graph: • Col 1–4: query name, length, start and end positions. • Col 5: the query strand relative to the mapping path in col 6. • Col 6: a stable graph path in the format matching the regular expression /([><][^\s><]+:\d+- \d+)+|([^\s><]+)/. The less or greater sign indicates the orientation of the segment. If a path consists of a single segment, coordinates can be omitted and its orientation is assumed to be forward “>”. • Col 7–9: total path length, start and end mapping positions on the forward strand of the path. • Col 10–12: number of matching bases, alignment block length and mapping quality
每一行都可以带有 SAM 格式中的标签。CIGAR 存储在标签中。
Each line may have tags as in the SAM format. CIGARs are stored in tags

由于 GFA 格式与 SAM、PAF 格式如此相似，我可以使用此前编写的 R 脚本读取并检查这些文件。改用 rust 可能更好，但我还需要时间学习它。
Since the GFA format is so similar to SAM and PAF formats. I could use the R script that I wrote before to read and check those files. It may be better to use rust. I still need time to learn it.

GFA is a simple TAB-dellimited text format consisting of 12 mandatory fields to represent reads aligned to a reference pan-genome graph: • Col 1–4: query name, length, start and end positions. • Col 5: the query strand relative to the mapping path in col 6. • Col 6: a stable graph path in the format matching the regular expression /([><][^\s><]+:\d+- \d+)+|([^\s><]+)/. The less or greater sign indicates the orientation of the segment. If a path consists of a single segment, coordinates can be omitted and its orientation is assumed to be forward “>”. • Col 7–9: total path length, start and end mapping positions on the forward strand of the path. • Col 10–12: number of matching bases, alignment block length and mapping quality
每一行都可以带有 SAM 格式中的标签。CIGAR 存储在标签中。
Each line may have tags as in the SAM format. CIGARs are stored in tags

由于 GFA 格式与 SAM、PAF 格式如此相似，我可以使用此前编写的 R 脚本读取并检查这些文件。改用 rust 可能更好，但我还需要时间学习它。
Since the GFA format is so similar to SAM and PAF formats. I could use the R script that I wrote before to read and check those files. It may be better to use rust. I still need time to learn it.

title: Git Push every repo in a folder
section: 第 1 步：为所有仓库批量执行 git pull / Step 1: Batch git pull for All Repositories
text:
第 1 步：为所有仓库批量执行 git pull / Step 1: Batch git pull for All Repositories
创建一个名为 pull_all.sh 的 shell 脚本：
Create a shell script named pull_all.sh:


Code
# Loop through all subdirectories
for dir in */; do
  if [ -d "$dir/.git" ]; then
    echo "Pulling in $dir"
    cd "$dir"
    git pull
    cd ..
  fi
done

text:
第 2 步：为所有仓库批量执行 git push / Step 2: Batch git push for All Repositories
类似地，创建一个名为 push_all.sh 的脚本：
Similarly, create a script called push_all.sh:


Code
# Loop through all subdirectories
for dir in */; do
  if [ -d "$dir/.git" ]; then
    echo "Pushing in $dir"
    cd "$dir"
    git add .
    git commit -m "Auto commit"
    git push
    cd ..
  fi
done
