title: Manhattan Plot for GWAS Results
section: 基本信息 / Basic Information
text:
基本信息 / Basic Information
曼哈顿图（Manhattan Plot)是基因组范围内关联研究（GWAS）中常用的可视化工具，用于展示单核苷酸多态性（SNP）与表型之间的关联。它通过在x轴上绘制基因组位置，在y轴上绘制-log10(p-value)来显示每个SNP的显著性水平。
The Manhattan plot is a visualization tool commonly used in genome-wide association studies (GWAS) to display the association between single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) and phenotypes. It shows the significance level of each SNP by plotting genomic position on the x-axis and -log10(p-value) on the y-axis.

objectID: posts/2025-04-14 Manhattan Plot/index.html#曼哈顿图的特点-features-of-a-manhattan-plot
href: posts/2025-04-14 Manhattan Plot/index.html#曼哈顿图的特点-features-of-a-manhattan-plot
title: Manhattan Plot for GWAS Results
section: 曼哈顿图的特点 / Features of a Manhattan Plot
text:
曼哈顿图的特点 / Features of a Manhattan Plot

X轴： 基因组的位置，按照染色体编号和物理位置排列，每条染色体用不同的颜色区分
X-axis: genomic position, arranged by chromosome number and physical position, with each chromosome distinguished by a different color
Y轴：用-log10(p-value)表示SNPs的显著性水平，越高表示显著性水平越高
Y-axis: -log10(p-value) represents the significance level of SNPs; the higher the value, the more significant
阈值线：图中与X轴平行的一条线，表示不同的显著性水平，分别对应p-value的某些值，比如p<5x10-8
Threshold line: a line in the plot parallel to the x-axis, indicating different significance levels, which correspond to certain p-value values, such as p<5x10-8
点: 每一个点表示一个SNPs，其高度表示显著性程度
Points: each point represents a SNP, and its height indicates the degree of significance

objectID: posts/2025-01-01 Process Cores/index.html

title: Dynamically adjust the process cores number
text:
在高性能计算或脚本环境中，根据一天中的时间动态调整所使用的线程数往往很有用。
In high-performance computing or scripting environments, it’s often useful to dynamically adjust the number of threads used based on the time of day.
例如，在工作时段，我们可能希望使用较少的线程，以免压垮共享系统；而在夜间，则可以充分利用可用资源。
For example, during working hours, we might want to use fewer threads to avoid overwhelming shared systems, while at night, we can take full advantage of available resources.
本教程演示如何使用一个简单的 Bash 脚本判断当前时间，并据此设置线程数。
This tutorial demonstrates how to use a simple Bash script to determine the current time and set the number of threads accordingly.

objectID: posts/2025-01-01 Process Cores/index.html#bash-脚本-bash-script
href: posts/2025-01-01 Process Cores/index.html#bash-脚本-bash-script
title: Dynamically adjust the process cores number
section: Bash 脚本 / Bash Script
text:
Bash 脚本 / Bash Script
下面的脚本使用 date 命令获取当前小时数，然后依据预设规则设置线程数：
The following script uses the date command to get the current hour and then sets the number of threads based on predefined rules:


Code
# Get the current hour in 24-hour format (00-23)
hour=$(date +"%H")

# Set thread number based on the time of day
if [ "$hour" -ge 0 ] && [ "$hour" -lt 6 ]; then
    threads=16  # Early morning: high resource usage allowed
elif [ "$hour" -ge 6 ] && [ "$hour" -lt 12 ]; then
    threads=8   # Morning: moderate usage
elif [ "$hour" -ge 12 ] && [ "$hour" -lt 18 ]; then
    threads=4   # Afternoon: light usage
else
    threads=12  # Evening: high usage again
fi

echo "Current hour: $hour"
echo "Using $threads threads"

About this site

Bioinformatics Notes

Maintained by Jie Hua · Biomedical Center, LMU Munich


A working notebook of reproducible bioinformatics — short, practical notes on genomes, structures, and the tools that make analysis easier.

This site collects solutions worth finding twice: plotting recipes, annotation and assembly formats, protein-structure workflows, and command-line patterns. Each note is written to be copy-pasteable and easy to revisit. It is built with Quarto and published on Netlify.
Language
I write some notes in English and some in Chinese, depending on the topic and the day. The other language you see in each post is an AI-generated translation, added so the material is readable to more people; it has not been reviewed line by line. Where the two versions differ, the language the piece was originally written in is the authoritative one.

title: Testing R torch and PyTorch in One Quarto Document
section: 1. 这个测试想回答什么 / What this test tries to answer
text:
1. 这个测试想回答什么 / What this test tries to answer
这篇不是教程，更像一次环境审计。我把三件事塞进了同一份 .qmd：两边各自训练一个小模型、比较两边的数值、检查 Quarto 的多种 chunk 引擎到底哪几个会在渲染时真正执行。
This is less a tutorial than an environment audit. I put three things into a single .qmd: train a small model in each framework, compare the two numerically, and check which of Quarto’s chunk engines actually execute during rendering.
具体来说有三个问题：

两个框架能不能在同一台机器上同时跑通？ R 的 torch 包和 Python 的 PyTorch 都封装了 libtorch，但它们的 Windows 二进制分发是两条独立的路径，坑也不一样。
同一份数据、同一个网络结构，两边的收敛和耗时差多少？ 我不想只看”都能跑”，还想看它们跑出来的东西是否等价。
Quarto 的 chunk 引擎是不是”什么语言都能写”？ 文档里能写 {julia} 不代表渲染时它会执行；有些引擎只是把代码原样搬到 HTML 里。

Three questions, more precisely:

Can both frameworks run on the same machine? R’s torch package and Python’s PyTorch both wrap libtorch, but their Windows binaries ship along separate paths and fail in different ways.
On identical data and identical architecture, how different are convergence and runtime? “Both work” is not enough; I want to know whether they produce equivalent results.
Do Quarto chunk engines really mean “any language”? Being able to write a {julia} chunk does not mean it executes; some engines only ship the code to the browser.

section: 3. 哪些 chunk 引擎真的会执行 / Which chunk engines actually run
text:
3. 哪些 chunk 引擎真的会执行 / Which chunk engines actually run
Quarto 允许在同一个文档里混用多种引擎，但”可写”和”可执行”是两件事。下表是本机的实测结果，后面的小节会逐个给出证据。
Quarto lets one document mix engines freely, but “can be written” and “can be executed” are different things. The table below is what this machine actually did; later sections show the evidence.








引擎 / Engine
渲染时执行 / Runs at render time
前提 / Requirement




{r}
是 / yes
R + knitr


{python}
是 / yes
reticulate 找到可用的 Python 与 torch


{bash}
是 / yes
系统里有 bash（本机是 WSL）


{ojs}
否 / no
代码被送到浏览器，由读者执行


{julia}
否，且会中断渲染 / no, aborts the render
需要 Julia 与 JuliaCall，eval: false 也拦不住


{sql}
未测试 / not run
需要一个可连接的数据库



表中 {ojs} 那一行最容易被误解：OJS 代码在渲染阶段完全不运行，Quarto 只是把 JavaScript 模块嵌进 HTML，等页面在浏览器里打开时才求值。因此”这段代码执行成功”这件事本身无法在渲染日志里得到证明。
The {ojs} row is the one most often misread: OJS code does not run at render time at all. Quarto embeds a JavaScript module into the HTML and the page evaluates it when a reader opens it. “This code ran successfully” therefore can never be confirmed from the render log.

section: 4. 同一个任务，两个框架 / One task, two frameworks
text:
4. 同一个任务，两个框架 / One task, two frameworks
任务刻意选得很小：二维平面上的两个半月形（two moons），400 个点，320 个训练、80 个测试，两层 MLP（2 → 16 → 2），交叉熵损失，Adam，学习率 0.05，全批量训练 200 轮。这个规模小到 CPU 上几秒钟就能跑完，同时又足够让两个框架的 API 差异暴露出来。
The task is deliberately small: two interleaved half-moons in the plane, 400 points split into 320 train and 80 test, a two-layer MLP (2 → 16 → 2), cross-entropy loss, Adam with learning rate 0.05, full-batch training for 200 epochs. It is small enough to finish in seconds on a CPU, yet large enough to expose API differences between the frameworks.
数据只生成一次，由 Python 生成，然后写成一个 CSV 给 R 侧读。这样两边的差别只剩”框架”，而不是”数据”。
The data are generated once, in Python, then handed to R as a CSV. That leaves the framework as the only difference.


Code
import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(7)

def make_moons(n=400, noise=0.12):
    half = n // 2
    t = rng.uniform(0, np.pi, half)
    outer = np.c_[np.cos(t), np.sin(t)]
    inner = np.c_[1 - np.cos(t), 0.5 - np.sin(t)]
    X = np.r_[outer, inner] + rng.normal(0, noise, (n, 2))
    y = np.r_[np.zeros(half), np.ones(half)].astype(int)
    return X.astype("float32"), y

X, y = make_moons()

# shared plotting / prediction grid: x varies fastest, y slowest
gx = np.linspace(X[:, 0].min() - 0.3, X[:, 0].max() + 0.3, 80)
gy = np.linspace(X[:, 1].min() - 0.3, X[:, 1].max() + 0.3, 80)

# the R side runs in its own process, so the data travel through a CSV
np.savetxt(r.csv_path, np.c_[X, y], delimiter=",", header="x,y,label", comments="")

print(f"X: {X.shape}, positives: {int(y.sum())} / {len(y)}")


X: (400, 2), positives: 200 / 400

section: 5. 用 PyTorch 训练 / Training with PyTorch
text:
5. 用 PyTorch 训练 / Training with PyTorch
Python 侧是最”标准”的写法：Sequential 堆两层线性，CrossEntropyLoss，Adam。损失每轮都记下来，最后在网格上预测一遍，得到决策边界。
The Python side is the textbook form: Sequential with two linear layers, CrossEntropyLoss, Adam. Loss is recorded every epoch, and the model then predicts on a grid to give a decision surface.


Code
import time

t0 = time.perf_counter()
import torch
t_load_py = time.perf_counter() - t0

torch.manual_seed(7)


<torch._C.Generator object at 0x0000022F0090BB70>


Code
Xtr, ytr = torch.tensor(X[:320]), torch.tensor(y[:320])
Xte, yte = torch.tensor(X[320:]), torch.tensor(y[320:])

model_py = torch.nn.Sequential(
    torch.nn.Linear(2, 16), torch.nn.ReLU(), torch.nn.Linear(16, 2)
)
opt = torch.optim.Adam(model_py.parameters(), lr=0.05)
lossf = torch.nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

t0 = time.perf_counter()
losses_py = []
for _ in range(200):
    opt.zero_grad()
    loss = lossf(model_py(Xtr), ytr)
    loss.backward()
    opt.step()
    losses_py.append(loss.item())
t_train_py = time.perf_counter() - t0

with torch.no_grad():
    acc_py = (model_py(Xte).argmax(1) == yte).float().mean().item()

# flat grid, x fastest -- same ordering the R chunk will build with expand.grid()
grid_flat = np.array([[a, b] for b in gy for a in gx], dtype="float32")
Xg = torch.tensor(grid_flat)
with torch.no_grad():
    model_py(Xg)  # warm-up: the first forward pays one-off kernel setup
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    Z_py = model_py(Xg).argmax(1).numpy()
    t_infer_py = time.perf_counter() - t0

title: Testing R torch and PyTorch in One Quarto Document
section: 6. 用 R 的 torch 训练 / Training with torch for R
text:
6. 用 R 的 torch 训练 / Training with torch for R
R 侧的模型定义几乎是逐字对应：nn_sequential()、nn_linear()、nn_relu()，损失是 nnf_cross_entropy()，优化器是 optim_adam()。区别主要在两点：R 的标签张量必须是 1 起始的整数（torch_long()），以及所有方法都用 $ 调用而不是 .。
The R side maps almost one-to-one: nn_sequential(), nn_linear(), nn_relu(), loss as nnf_cross_entropy(), optimiser as optim_adam(). Two differences matter: R label tensors must be 1-based integers (torch_long()), and every method is called with $ instead of ..
核心部分就是下面这些（完整脚本是同目录的 train-r-torch.R，跟着仓库走，不随网页发布）：
The core of it is below (the full script is train-r-torch.R next to this post, kept in the repository rather than published with the page):
model <- nn_sequential(nn_linear(2, 16), nn_relu(), nn_linear(16, 2))
opt <- optim_adam(model$parameters, lr = 0.05)

for (epoch in seq_len(200)) {
  opt$zero_grad()
  loss <- nnf_cross_entropy(model(Xtr), ytr)
  loss$backward()
  opt$step()
  losses[epoch] <- as.numeric(loss$item())
}

with_no_grad({
  acc <- as.numeric(
    (model(Xte)$argmax(dim = 2) == yte)$to(dtype = torch_float())$mean()$item()
  )
})
注意这里有两个 R 特有的细节。第一，argmax(dim = 2) 里的 dim 是从 1 开始的，对应 Python 的 argmax(1)。第二，把张量转回 R 向量用 as.integer()，R 的 torch 张量没有 $numpy() 方法——第一次写的时候我照着 Python 的习惯写了 $cpu()$numpy()，得到的是一个和上下文毫无关系的报错（没有"fn"这个函数），而不是”方法不存在”。
Two details are R-specific. First, dim in argmax(dim = 2) is 1-based, matching Python’s argmax(1). Second, converting a tensor back to an R vector uses as.integer(); R torch tensors have no $numpy() method — copying the Python habit produced an error with no relation to the actual mistake (no function "fn"), not “method not found”.

6.1 为什么这一段必须单独开进程 / Why this part needs its own process
最开始我把 R torch 的训练直接写在 {r} chunk 里，与前面的 {python} chunk 共用同一个 R 会话。结果 Python 侧一 import torch 就炸：
At first I put the R torch training straight into an {r} chunk, sharing the session with the {python} chunk above. The Python side then failed the moment it ran import torch:
OSError: [WinError 127] The specified procedure could not be found. Error loading
"C:\Software\miniforge3\Lib\site-packages\torch\lib\torch_cpu.dll" or one of its dependencies.
原因不是装错了，而是两个 libtorch 不能共存于同一个进程。R 的 torch 包附带一份 libtorch（2.8.0），Python 的 PyTorch 自带另一份（2.13.0）。一旦 R 先加载了自己的 torch_cpu.dll、c10.dll，Python 再按名字去解析依赖时就会绑定到已经加载的旧版本，符号对不上。把 PATH 改回去也没用——DLL 已经在进程里了。
The install is not broken; two libtorch builds cannot share one process. R’s torch ships its own libtorch (2.8.0) and Python’s PyTorch ships another (2.13.0). Once R has loaded its torch_cpu.dll and c10.dll, Python’s import binds its dependencies to the already-loaded older copies by name, and the symbols do not match. Restoring PATH does not help: the DLLs are already in the process.
所以这一节改成：R 的训练脚本用 Rscript 起一个独立进程跑，结果存成 RDS，再由文档里的 R chunk 读回来画图。代价是多一个文件，好处是两边用的都是各自完整、未经污染的运行时。
The fix is to run the R script in a separate Rscript process, save the results as an RDS, and let the document’s R chunks read them back for plotting. It costs one extra file and buys each side a clean, uncontaminated runtime.


Code
code <- system2(
  file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript"),
  c("train-r-torch.R", shQuote(csv_path), shQuote(rds_path)),
  stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE
)
r_res <- readRDS(rds_path)

6.2 第二个坑：lantern.dll 找不到依赖 / Trap two: lantern.dll and its dependencies
在独立进程里第一次 library(torch) 后调 torch_tensor()，报的是这个：
Inside the separate process, the first library(torch) followed by torch_tensor() still failed:
✖ .../library/torch/lib/lantern.dll - The specified procedure could not be found.
Error: Lantern is not loaded.
同时还有一条警告说包是用 R 4.5.3 编译的，而本机是 4.5.1。看起来像是版本不匹配，实际并不是：lantern.dll 依赖同目录下的 torch_cpu.dll、libiomp5md.dll 等一堆 DLL，而 Windows 在 dyn.load() 时并没有把该目录当成搜索路径，于是随便找到一个旧版本、缺符号，才报”找不到指定的过程”。
There was also a warning that the package was built under R 4.5.3 while this machine runs 4.5.1. That looks like a version mismatch, but it is not: lantern.dll depends on torch_cpu.dll, libiomp5md.dll and friends sitting in the same directory, and Windows does not treat that directory as a search path during dyn.load(). An older copy gets picked up, a symbol is missing, and the error says “specified procedure could not be found”.
修法只有一行，写在脚本开头：把包自己的 lib/ 目录加到 PATH 前面，再加载。
The fix is one line at the top of the script: prepend the package’s own lib/ directory to PATH before loading.
torch_lib <- file.path(find.package("torch"), "lib")
Sys.setenv(PATH = paste(torch_lib, Sys.getenv("PATH"), sep = .Platform$path.sep))
library(torch)
如果你的 R 里 torch 一加载就报 Lantern is not loaded，先加这一行，再去考虑重装。
If torch fails with Lantern is not loaded on your machine, add this line before reinstalling anything.

title: Testing R torch and PyTorch in One Quarto Document
section: 7. 数值一致性 / Numeric consistency
text:
7. 数值一致性 / Numeric consistency
两个框架背后是同一个 C++ 库，所以确定性运算应该逐位一致。用同一个向量做 exp() 再求和，两边结果如下：Python 得到 30.1928749084，R 得到 30.1928749084，差值 0.0e+00。这不是巧合，而是因为两边调用的是同一份 libtorch 内核。
Both frameworks sit on the same C++ library, so deterministic operations should agree to the last digit. Taking exp() of the same vector and summing gives 30.1928749084 in Python and 30.1928749084 in R, a difference of 0.0e+00. That is not a coincidence; both calls land on the same libtorch kernel.
但训练轨迹也是几乎重合的，这一点比预想的更有意思。原因是随机数生成器既不在 R 里、也不在 Python 里，而在 libtorch 里：torch_manual_seed(7) 与 torch.manual_seed(7) 播种的是同一个引擎，两边的层又按同样的顺序创建，于是初始权重逐位相同。200 轮之后，两条损失的最大差只有 4.5e-08，纯属浮点运算顺序的差别。
The training trajectories also almost coincide, which is more interesting than expected. The random number generator lives neither in R nor in Python but inside libtorch: torch_manual_seed(7) and torch.manual_seed(7) seed the same engine, and both models build their layers in the same order, so the initial weights are identical bit for bit. After 200 epochs the largest gap between the two loss sequences is 4.5e-08, purely a floating-point ordering artefact.
这个重合其实有点侥幸：两边的 libtorch 版本并不相同（R 侧 2.8.0，Python 侧 2.13.0），只是初始化与 Adam 在这两个版本之间的数值行为没有变。换个版本、换个建模顺序，或者中间插一个消耗随机数的算子，序列就会错开。所以被复现的是同一个引擎的状态，而不是”跨框架等价”。
The overlap is partly luck: the two libtorch builds are not the same (2.8.0 on the R side, 2.13.0 on the Python side); initialisation and Adam simply behave identically across these versions. A different build, a different construction order, or any random-consuming op in between would desynchronise the sequences. What is reproduced is the state of one engine, not a cross-framework equivalence.

text:
8. 结果对比 / Comparing the results


Code
res <- data.frame(
  engine   = c("PyTorch (Python)", "torch (R)"),
  version  = c(py$ver_py, r_res$version),
  final    = sprintf("%.4f", c(py$losses_py[[200]], r_res$losses[200])),
  accuracy = sprintf("%.3f", c(py$acc_py, r_res$acc))
)
kable(res,
      col.names = c("引擎 / Engine", "版本 / Version",
                    "末轮损失 / Final loss", "测试准确率 / Test acc"),
      caption = "同一数据、同一结构下的结果。 / Same data, same architecture.")




Table 1: 同一数据、同一结构下的结果。 / Same data, same architecture.












引擎 / Engine
版本 / Version
末轮损失 / Final loss
测试准确率 / Test acc




PyTorch (Python)
2.13.0+cpu
0.0050
1.000


torch (R)
0.17.0
0.0050
1.000








两边都在 200 轮内收敛到接近零的损失，测试集准确率都是 100%。在这个规模上，两者的结果是等价的；差别全在时间上，而时间又可以拆成三段来看。
Both converge to near-zero loss within 200 epochs, and both reach 100% on the test split. At this scale the results are equivalent; everything that differs is time, and time splits into three parts.


Code
train_r <- r_res$seconds
train_py <- py$t_train_py
timing_tbl <- data.frame(
  engine = c("PyTorch (Python)", "torch (R)"),
  load   = sprintf("%.2f", c(py$t_load_py, r_res$load)),
  epoch  = sprintf("%.1f", 1000 * c(train_py, train_r) / 200),
  train  = sprintf("%.2f", c(train_py, train_r)),
  infer  = sprintf("%.1f", 1000 * c(py$t_infer_py, r_res$infer))
)
kable(timing_tbl,
      col.names = c("引擎 / Engine", "加载 torch (s)", "每轮 (ms)",
                    "训练 200 轮 (s)", "网格推理 (ms)"),
      caption = "时间拆成三段：导入、训练、推理。加载只计 import / library 本身，不含解释器启动；推理前先各跑一次预热。 / Time in three parts: import, training, inference. Loading counts only import/library, not interpreter startup, and inference is measured after one warm-up pass.")




Table 2: 时间拆成三段：导入、训练、推理。加载只计 import / library 本身，不含解释器启动；推理前先各跑一次预热。 / Time in three parts: import, training, inference. Loading counts only import/library, not interpreter startup, and inference is measured after one warm-up pass.













引擎 / Engine
加载 torch (s)
每轮 (ms)
训练 200 轮 (s)
网格推理 (ms)




PyTorch (Python)
1.77
0.7
0.15
1.0


torch (R)
2.84
5.3
1.06
4.5








三段数字指向三种不同的东西。
The three segments point at three different things.
加载是同一量级，1.77 秒对 2.84 秒，R 略慢但没有数量级差。两者都要把一份几百 MB 的 libtorch 映射进内存，瓶颈在磁盘与动态链接，跟语言本身关系不大。
Loading is the same order of magnitude, 1.77 s versus 2.84 s; R is a little slower but not by an order of magnitude. Both have to map several hundred megabytes of libtorch into memory, so the cost is disk and dynamic linking rather than the language.
训练是唯一真正拉开差距的地方：R 每轮 5.3 ms，Python 每轮 0.7 ms，差 7.1 倍。R 的每一步都要跨一次 R 与 C++ 的边界，而 Python 的 autograd 与优化器都在 C++ 里跑完，只有一次 loss.item() 回到解释器。轮数越多、这个固定开销被摊得越薄；但每轮只有几毫秒时，接口成本占比就很可观。
Training is the only place where they really diverge: 5.3 ms per epoch in R against 0.7 ms in Python, a factor of 7.1. Every R step crosses the R/C++ boundary, whereas Python runs autograd and the optimiser entirely inside C++ and returns to the interpreter once, for loss.item(). The more epochs you run, the thinner that fixed overhead is spread; but when an epoch costs only a few milliseconds, the interface dominates.
推理（在 80 × 80 网格上预测 6400 个点）两边都在毫秒量级：1.0 ms 与 4.5 ms。倍数仍然是几倍，但绝对值小到可以忽略——一次前向传播的开销本来就远小于一次参数更新。
Inference (6,400 points on an 80 × 80 grid) is in the millisecond range on both sides: 1.0 ms and 4.5 ms. The ratio is still a few-fold, but the absolute numbers are negligible — a forward pass was never the expensive part.


Code
timing <- data.frame(
  engine  = rep(c("PyTorch (Python)", "torch (R)"), each = 3),
  stage   = factor(rep(c("load", "train 200 epochs", "inference"), 2),
                   levels = c("load", "train 200 epochs", "inference")),
  seconds = c(py$t_load_py, train_py, py$t_infer_py,
              r_res$load, train_r, r_res$infer)
)

ggplot(timing, aes(stage, seconds, colour = engine, group = engine)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.001)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(blog_pal[["blue"]], blog_pal[["vermillion"]])) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "seconds (log scale)", colour = NULL,
       title = "Where the time goes",
       subtitle = "same model, same data, CPU only")








Figure 2: 三个阶段的对数时间对比。加载与推理接近，训练差一个数量级。 | Log-scale comparison of the three stages. Loading and inference are close; training differs by an order of magnitude.







Code
loss_py <- unlist(py$losses_py)

curves <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    epoch  = rep(seq_len(200), 2),
    value  = c(loss_py, r_res$losses),
    series = rep(c("PyTorch (Python)", "torch (R)"), each = 200),
    panel  = "cross-entropy loss"
  ),
  data.frame(
    epoch  = seq_len(200),
    value  = pmax(abs(loss_py - r_res$losses), 1e-12),
    series = "|PyTorch − R|",
    panel  = "absolute difference"
  )
)
curves$panel <- factor(curves$panel, levels = c("cross-entropy loss", "absolute difference"))

ggplot(curves, aes(epoch, value, colour = series)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75) +
  facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(blog_pal[["blue"]], blog_pal[["vermillion"]],
                                 blog_pal[["green"]])) +
  labs(x = "epoch", y = "value (log scale)", colour = NULL,
       title = "Same task, two frameworks",
       subtitle = "200 full-batch Adam steps, learning rate 0.05")








Figure 3: 左：两条损失曲线（对数纵轴），几乎完全重合；右：逐轮差值的绝对值，触到底线表示该轮两边完全相同。随机数生成器在 libtorch 里，两边播种的是同一个引擎。 | Left: two loss curves on a log axis, almost coincident; right: the per-epoch absolute difference, where the floor means the two runs agreed exactly. The RNG lives in libtorch and both sides seed the same engine.







Code
grid_flat <- as.matrix(expand.grid(x = as.numeric(py$gx), y = as.numeric(py$gy)))
surf <- data.frame(
  x = grid_flat[, 1], y = grid_flat[, 2],
  py = factor(as.integer(py$Z_py)), r = factor(r_res$classes)
)
surf_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(surf, c(py, r), names_to = "engine", values_to = "class")
surf_long$engine <- factor(surf_long$engine, levels = c("py", "r"),
                           labels = c("PyTorch (Python)", "torch (R)"))

ggplot() +
  geom_tile(data = surf_long, aes(x, y, fill = class), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = pts, aes(x, y, colour = class), size = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~engine) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "#CFE3F0", "1" = "#F6D9C9"), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(blog_pal[["blue"]], blog_pal[["vermillion"]]),
                      labels = c("class 0", "class 1")) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = NULL,
       title = "Where the two models put the boundary",
       subtitle = "shaded regions are predicted classes")








Figure 4: 决策面：左为 PyTorch，右为 R torch；点为真实类别。 | Decision surfaces: PyTorch left, R torch right; dots are the true classes.





两个决策面几乎一样：分界线都落在两条半月之间，边缘处的小差异来自不同的权重初始化。也就是说，在这个任务上”用哪个框架”不影响结论，只影响写代码的手感。
The two surfaces are nearly identical: both boundaries fall between the half-moons, and the small differences near the edges come from different initial weights. On this task, the framework choice changes how the code feels to write, not what the model concludes.

section: 9. 其他引擎的实测 / What the other engines did
text:
9. 其他引擎的实测 / What the other engines did

9.1 Bash
{bash} chunk 在 Windows 上会去调用 bash，如果装了 WSL，实际执行的是 Linux 子系统。所以 uname 报的是 Linux，文件计数也是 Linux 侧看到的那个目录。
On Windows a {bash} chunk calls bash, which means WSL if installed, so uname reports Linux and the file count is whatever the Linux side sees in that directory.


Code
echo "shell: ${BASH_VERSION:-unknown}"
uname -sr
printf 'qmd files in this folder: %s\n' "$(ls -1 *.qmd 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"


shell: 5.2.37(1)-release
Linux 6.6.87.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2
qmd files in this folder: 1




9.2 OJS
OJS 是在浏览器里跑的，渲染阶段只会看到代码被嵌进 HTML。
OJS runs in the browser; at render time you only see the code being embedded into the HTML.


Code
vals = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
total = vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
"OJS says: sum = " + total + ", mean = " + (total / vals.length).toFixed(2)























页面打开后上面这行字才会出现，它来自读者的浏览器，而不是构建机器。
That line only appears once the page is open, and it comes from the reader’s browser rather than from the build machine.


9.3 Julia
Julia 的代码看起来和 R、Python 的 chunk 一样自然，但这台机器上没有 Julia。下面这段现在只是一个普通代码块——原因见后文。
The Julia code looks as natural as an R or Python chunk, but this machine has no Julia. What follows is now an ordinary code block, and the reason is below.
using LinearAlgebra
A = randn(3, 3)
println("det = ", det(A))
这一段原本是 {julia} chunk，并且写了 #| eval: false。结果是渲染直接中断：
This started life as a {julia} chunk with #| eval: false. The render aborted anyway:
错误于loadNamespace(x): 不存在叫'JuliaCall'这个名称的程序包
Calls: .main ... loadNamespace -> withRestarts ...
Quitting from index.qmd:441-447 [julia-check]
原因是 knitr 在注册引擎的阶段就要加载 JuliaCall，这一步发生在判断 eval 之前。所以”关掉执行”并不能让一个没有运行时的语言蒙混过关，只能把它降级成普通的代码块。这大概是本文最有用的一个结论：eval: false 保护不了你。
knitr has to load JuliaCall when it registers the engine, which happens before eval is consulted. Turning execution off does not let a language without a runtime slip through; the only option is to demote it to a plain code block. This is probably the most useful conclusion in the post: eval: false will not save you.

section: 10. freeze 与 code-fold 改变了什么 / What freeze and code-fold change
text:
10. freeze 与 code-fold 改变了什么 / What freeze and code-fold change
这个站点在 posts/_metadata.yml 里开了 freeze: true，所以上面的数字只在第一次渲染时算出来，之后存进 _freeze/ 目录。修改正文不会触发重新计算；只有改动带代码的 chunk 或删掉对应的 _freeze 目录，才会重跑。
This site sets freeze: true in posts/_metadata.yml, so the numbers above are computed on the first render and then stored under _freeze/. Editing prose does not trigger recomputation; only changing a code chunk or deleting the matching _freeze directory does.
这意味着两件事。第一，页面上”我跑通了”的证据是可以过期的：代码改了但缓存还在，读者看到的仍是旧输出。第二，freeze 让这类混合语言的文档变得可行——不必在每次构建时都启动 R、Python 和 bash。
That has two consequences. First, the evidence that “it ran” can go stale: change the code while the cache survives, and readers still see the old output. Second, freeze is what makes a multi-language document practical, since a rebuild no longer has to start R, Python and bash every time.
code-fold: true 只影响展示，不影响执行：代码默认收起，读者点开才看到。对于这种以”输出”为主的文章，收起代码反而让结果更清楚。
code-fold: true affects presentation only, not execution: code is collapsed by default and expands on click. For a post whose point is the output, collapsing the code actually makes the results easier to read.

objectID: posts/2025-02-15 Testing R torch and PyTorch in Quarto/index.html#结论-takeaways
href: posts/2025-02-15 Testing R torch and PyTorch in Quarto/index.html#结论-takeaways
title: Testing R torch and PyTorch in One Quarto Document
section: 11. 结论 / Takeaways
text:
11. 结论 / Takeaways

两个框架都能跑，但坑不同。 Python 的 PyTorch 装好即用；R 的 torch 需要把 lib/ 目录加进 PATH，否则 lantern.dll 会报”找不到指定的过程”。 Both frameworks work, but they fail differently. PyTorch works out of the box; R’s torch needs its lib/ directory on PATH, or lantern.dll fails with “specified procedure could not be found”.
两个 libtorch 不能住进同一个进程。 想在 R 会话里用 reticulate 跑 PyTorch、同时又跑 R torch，必然有一方加载失败；只能分进程。 Two libtorch builds cannot share one process. Using reticulate to run PyTorch and R torch in the same session makes one of them fail to load; they have to be separated into processes.
一致性比想象中强。 同一个 exp().sum() 两边差 0.0e+00；连 200 轮训练曲线都几乎重合，因为随机数生成器和算子都在 libtorch 里，不在 R 或 Python 里。 Consistency is stronger than expected. The same exp().sum() differs by 0.0e+00, and even the 200-epoch loss curves nearly coincide, because both the RNG and the kernels live in libtorch rather than in R or Python.
时间差集中在训练轮内。 加载 torch 两边都在数秒之内（1.77 vs 2.84 秒），推理都是毫秒级；只有每轮训练 R 比 Python 慢 7.1 倍，因为每一步都要跨一次 R/C++ 边界。 The gap sits inside the training loop. Loading torch takes a few seconds on both sides (1.77 vs 2.84 s) and inference is milliseconds; only the per-epoch cost differs, with R slower by 7.1x because every step crosses the R/C++ boundary.
“能写 chunk”不等于”能执行 chunk”。 {python}、{bash} 在渲染时执行，{ojs} 交给浏览器，{julia}、{sql} 取决于本机是否具备运行环境。 “Can write a chunk” is not “can execute a chunk”. {python} and {bash} run at render time; {ojs} is delegated to the browser; {julia} and {sql} depend on what the machine has installed.
freeze 是这类文档的前提，也是隐患。 它避免每次构建都重启多套运行时，但也让输出与代码可能不同步。 freeze is both the enabler and the risk: it avoids restarting several runtimes per build, but it lets output drift away from code.

"https://www.dfam.org/releases/current/families/FamDB/dfam39_full.1.h5.gz"
"https://www.dfam.org/releases/current/families/FamDB/dfam39_full.1.h5.gz.md5"
"https://www.dfam.org/releases/current/families/FamDB/dfam39_full.7.h5.gz"
"https://www.dfam.org/releases/current/families/FamDB/dfam39_full.7.h5.gz.md5"
)

# 使用 aria2c 多线程下载
for url in "${URLS[@]}"; do
    echo "Downloading $url ..."
    aria2c -x 16 -s 16 -k 1M "$url"
done
# 校验 MD5
for file in *.gz; do
    echo "Checking MD5 for $file ..."
    md5file="${file}.md5"
    if [ -f "$md5file" ]; then
        # 格式转换为标准 md5sum 可读格式
        hash=$(cut -d ' ' -f 1 "$md5file")
        echo "$hash  $file" > check.md5
        md5sum -c check.md5
        if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "❌ MD5 check failed for $file"
            exit 1
        else
            echo "✅ MD5 check passed for $file"
        fi
        rm check.md5
    else
        echo "⚠️ Warning: MD5 file not found for $file"
    fi
done
# 解压缩
for file in *.gz; do
    echo "Unzipping $file ..."
    gunzip -k "$file"
done
echo "✅ All files downloaded, verified, and unzipped successfully."

title: Illustrate: Non-photorealistic Biomolecular Illustration
text:
Illustrate 是一个小型的 Fortran 程序，用于生成分子的非真实感插图（non-photorealistic illustration），具有卡通化的配色与轮廓线，以及柔和的环境阴影。它最初是我在斯克利普斯研究所（Scripps Research Institute）Arthur J. Olson 实验室从事博士后研究期间开发的，此后我一直对它加以改进。我用它为我的著作以及 RCSB 蛋白质数据库（RCSB Protein Data Bank）的科普门户 PDB-101 制作素材，其中最著名的是“每月一分子”（Molecule of the Month）栏目。


Illustrate is a small Fortran program for creating non-photorealistic illustrations of molecules, with cartoony colors and outlines, and soft ambient shadows. I originally developed it during postdoctoral training in the laboratory of Arthur J. Olson at the Scripps Research Institute, and have tinkered with it ever since. I have used it to create materials for my books and for PDB-101, the outreach portal of the RCSB Protein Data Bank, most notably, for the “Molecule of the Month.”

title: Transfer GFF to GTF file
text:
GFF3（Generic Feature Format Version 3）文件格式以简单的纯文本、制表符分隔的文件来描述基因组特征
GFF3 文件包含九个字段（seqid、source、feature、start、end、score、strand、phase 和 attributes）
以“##”开头的行提供文件的元信息，以“#”开头则表示人类可读的注释


GFF3 (Generic Feature Format Version 3) file format represents the genomic features in a simple text-based tab-delimited file
GFF3 file has nine fields (seqid, source, feature, start, end, score, strand, phase, and attributes)
The lines which starts with ‘##’ provides the meta-information of the file and ‘#’ represents the human-readable comments

我们有时需要把 GFF3 转换为 GTF 格式。
We sometimes need to transfer GFF3 to GTF format.
我之前使用过 gffread。它通常运行良好，但当我要处理从 NCBI 下载的 GFF3 文件时，会出现一些问题。
I used gffread before. It generally works well, but it has some problem when I need to deal with a GFF3 file downloaded from NCBI.
这个文件中有一些类似下面的行：
This file has some lines like:
chrxxx  Gnomon  exon    46964   46999   .   -   .   ID=id-LOC123327042;Parent=gene-LOC123327042;Dbxref=GeneID:123327042;gbkey=exon;gene=LOC123327042;model_evidence=Supporting evidence includes similarity to: 1 Protein%2C and 74%25 coverage of the annotated genomic feature by RNAseq alignments;pseudo=true
chrxxx  Gnomon  exon    47054   47468   .   -   .   ID=id-LOC123327042-2;Parent=gene-LOC123327042;Dbxref=GeneID:123327042;gbkey=exon;gene=LOC123327042;model_evidence=Supporting evidence includes similarity to: 1 Protein%2C and 74%25 coverage of the annotated genomic feature by RNAseq alignments;pseudo=true
chrxxx  Gnomon  exon    47542   47661   .   -   .   ID=id-LOC123327042-3;Parent=gene-LOC123327042;Dbxref=GeneID:123327042;gbkey=exon;gene=LOC123327042;model_evidence=Supporting evidence includes similarity to: 1 Protein%2C and 74%25 coverage of the annotated genomic feature by RNAseq alignments;pseudo=true
当我使用 gffread 时，它无法读取那些包含 “ID=id*” 的行，输出的 GTF 文件中会丢失 gene_id 属性。
When I used gffread, it can not read there lines containing “ID=id*”, it will lose the gene_id attribute in the output GTF file.
我意识到需要自己写一个脚本。
I realized that I need to write a script by myself.

在外圈添加热图层 / Add heatmap layer on the outer ring


Code
# Next, we will add a heatmap layer on the outer ring of p2 using `geom_tile` of `ggplot2`.
# Since we want to map some variable of dataset to the `fill` aesthetics of `geom_tile`, but 
# the `fill` of p2 had been mapped. So I need use `new_scale_fill` of `ggnewscale` package to initialize it.
p3 <- p2 + 
      new_scale_fill() + 
      geom_fruit(
          data=dat2,
          geom=geom_tile,
          mapping=aes(y=ID, x=Pos, fill=Type),
          offset=0.08,   # The distance between external layers, default is 0.03 times of x range of tree.
          pwidth=0.25 # width of the external layer, default is 0.2 times of x range of tree.
      ) + 
      scale_fill_manual(
          values=c("#339933", "#dfac03"),
          guide=guide_legend(keywidth=0.5, keyheight=0.5, order=3)
      ) 
p3 + theme_blog_overlay









Fan layout tree with heatmap

# You can also add heatmap layer for continuous values.
p4 <- p3 + 
      new_scale_fill() +
      geom_fruit(
          data=dat3,
          geom=geom_tile,
          mapping=aes(y=ID, x=Type2, alpha=Alpha, fill=Type2),
          pwidth=0.15,
          axis.params=list(
                          axis="x", # add axis text of the layer.
                          text.angle=-45, # the text angle of x-axis.
                          hjust=0  # adjust the horizontal position of text of axis.
                      )
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
          values=c("#b22222", "#005500", "#0000be", "#9f1f9f"),
          guide=guide_legend(keywidth=0.5, keyheight=0.5, order=4)
      ) +
      scale_alpha_continuous(
          range=c(0, 0.4), # the range of alpha
          guide=guide_legend(keywidth=0.5, keyheight=0.5, order=5)
      ) 
p4 + theme_blog_overlay









Fan layout tree with heatmap for continuous values




Code
# Then add a bar layer outside of the tree.
p5 <- p4 + 
      new_scale_fill() +
      geom_fruit(
          data=dat1,
          geom=geom_col,
          mapping=aes(y=ID, x=Abundance, fill=Location),  #The 'Abundance' of 'dat1' will be mapped to x
          pwidth=0.4,
          axis.params=list(
                          axis="x", # add axis text of the layer.
                          text.angle=-45, # the text size of axis.
                          hjust=0  # adjust the horizontal position of text of axis.
                      ),
          grid.params=list() # add the grid line of the external bar plot.
      ) + 
      scale_fill_manual(
          values=c("#F8766D", "#C49A00", "#53B400", "#00C094", "#00B6EB", "#A58AFF", "#FB61D7"),
          guide=guide_legend(keywidth=0.5, keyheight=0.5, order=6)
      ) +
      theme(#legend.position=c(0.96, 0.5), # the position of legend.
          legend.background=element_rect(fill=NA), # the background of legend.
          legend.title=element_text(size=7), # the title size of legend.
          legend.text=element_text(size=6), # the text size of legend.

# To reproduce.
set.seed(1024)
# generate a tree contained 100 tip labels.
tr <- rtree(100)
# generate three datasets, which are the same except the third column name.
dt <- data.frame(id=tr$tip.label, value=abs(rnorm(100)), group=c(rep("A",50),rep("B",50)))
df <- dt
dtf <- dt
colnames(df)[[3]] <- "group2"
colnames(dtf)[[3]] <- "group3"
# plot tree 
p <- ggtree(tr, layout="fan", open.angle=0)
#> Scale for y is already present.
#> Adding another scale for y, which will replace the existing scale.
p + theme_blog_overlay









Fan layout tree with heatmap for continuous values




Code
# the first ring.
p1 <- p + 
      geom_fruit(
          data = dt,
          geom = geom_col,
          mapping = aes(y=id, x=value, fill=group),
      ) + 
      new_scale_fill()
p1 + theme_blog_overlay









Fan layout tree with heatmap for continuous values




Code
# the second ring
# geom_fruit_list is a list, which first element must be layer of geom_fruit.
p2 <- p1 + 
      geom_fruit_list(
          geom_fruit(
              data = df,
              geom = geom_col,
              mapping = aes(y=id, x=value, fill=group2),
          ),
          scale_fill_manual(values=c("blue", "red")), # To map group2

写作说明 / A note on how this post was written



本文由 DeepSeek-Flash 生成，尚未经过人工校对，可能存在事实、数字或表述上的错误，请以原始文献、仪器手册和官方文档为准。
This article was generated by DeepSeek-Flash and has not been manually proofread. It may contain errors in facts, numbers, or wording; please defer to the original literature, instrument manuals, and official documentation.
文中的所有图表都由本文的 R 代码在渲染时生成，其中的数值是为说明概念而模拟的，不代表任何真实仪器、样本或数据集。软件包名称与文件格式的描述基于公开文档，但版本演进很快，实际使用时请以对应版本的文档为准。
All figures and tables in this article are generated at render time by the R code in this post, and the values in them are simulated to illustrate concepts; they do not represent any real instrument, sample, or dataset. Descriptions of software package names and file formats are based on public documentation, but versions evolve quickly, so please refer to the documentation for the version you actually use.
蛋白质组学最容易被误解的一点是：很多人以为”测一个蛋白”就是仪器直接报告一个浓度。实际上，基于质谱的蛋白质组学测的是肽段的质荷比和信号强度，蛋白是从这些肽段反推出来的。所以一个 .raw 文件里并没有”蛋白”这个字段，只有成千上万张质谱图，以及每张图属于哪一次扫描、在什么时间、用什么参数采集。
The most common misunderstanding about proteomics is that many people assume “measuring a protein” means the instrument directly reports a concentration. In reality, mass-spectrometry-based proteomics measures the mass-to-charge ratios and signal intensities of peptides, and proteins are inferred back from those peptides. A .raw file therefore contains no “protein” field at all—only tens of thousands of mass spectra, together with which scan each spectrum belongs to, at what time, and with which acquisition parameters.
这篇文章按数据实际流动的顺序展开：
This article follows the order in which the data actually flow:
目标是写成一份可以按图索骥的技术报告。
The goal is to write a technical report that can serve as a step-by-step guide.

objectID: posts/2026-10-26 Proteomics mass spectrometry data/index.html#蛋白质组学测的是什么为什么难-what-proteomics-measures-and-why-it-is-hard
href: posts/2026-10-26 Proteomics mass spectrometry data/index.html#蛋白质组学测的是什么为什么难-what-proteomics-measures-and-why-it-is-hard
title: Proteomics by mass spectrometry: what is inside a raw file
section: 1. 蛋白质组学测的是什么，为什么难 / What proteomics measures, and why it is hard
text:
1. 蛋白质组学测的是什么，为什么难 / What proteomics measures, and why it is hard
基因组是一份稳定的序列，转录组是”此刻在转录什么”，而蛋白质组是此刻真正在执行功能的分子。三者之间并不是简单的一一映射：
A genome is a stable sequence, the transcriptome is “what is being transcribed right now”, and the proteome is the molecules that are actually carrying out functions at this moment. The mapping among the three is not a simple one-to-one correspondence:

一个基因可以产生多种蛋白质形式（proteoform）：可变剪接、蛋白酶切、信号肽去除；
A single gene can give rise to multiple protein forms (proteoforms): alternative splicing, proteolytic cleavage, and signal-peptide removal;
蛋白丰度与 mRNA 丰度只有中等相关（常见报道在 0.4–0.6 之间），因为翻译效率和降解速率不同；
Protein abundance correlates only moderately with mRNA abundance (reported values commonly fall between 0.4 and 0.6), because translation efficiency and degradation rates differ;
蛋白会被修饰（磷酸化、乙酰化、泛素化、糖基化、氧化），修饰状态往往才是功能开关；
Proteins are modified (phosphorylation, acetylation, ubiquitination, glycosylation, oxidation), and the modification state is often the actual functional switch;
蛋白丰度的动态范围极大：血浆中白蛋白与低丰度细胞因子之间可以相差 10 个数量级。
Protein abundance spans an enormous dynamic range: in plasma, albumin and low-abundance cytokines can differ by 10 orders of magnitude.



Code
set.seed(42)
ab <- data.frame(rank = 1:600)
ab$log_ab <- 10 - 10 * (ab$rank - 1) / 599 + rnorm(nrow(ab), 0, 0.04)

mark <- data.frame(
  protein = c("albumin", "transferrin", "IgG", "CRP", "IL-6", "troponin I"),
  rank = c(1, 6, 15, 150, 430, 580)
)
mark$log_ab <- 10 - 10 * (mark$rank - 1) / 599

set.seed(1)
ggplot(ab, aes(rank, log_ab)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 60, xmax = 320, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = blog_pal[["sky"]], alpha = 0.14) +
  annotate("text", x = 190, y = 1.0, label = "routine LC-MS/MS coverage",
           size = 3, colour = "grey25") +
  geom_line(colour = blog_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = mark, colour = blog_pal[["vermillion"]], size = 2.4) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = mark, aes(label = protein), size = 3,
    fill = "white", alpha = 0.88, label.size = 0.2,
    min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.45, point.padding = 0.35,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "protein rank in plasma", y = expression(log[10]~"relative abundance"),
    title = "The dynamic range problem",
    subtitle = "roughly 10 orders of magnitude between albumin and cytokines"
  )








Figure 1: 血浆蛋白的丰度横跨约 10 个数量级。质谱一次进样能覆盖的主要是中间那一段，最两端通常需要去除高丰度蛋白或富集低丰度蛋白。 | Plasma protein abundance spans about 10 orders of magnitude. A single mass spectrometry injection mainly covers the middle segment; the two extremes usually require depletion of high-abundance proteins or enrichment of low-abundance proteins.





把这件事翻译成数据语言，就是三个不同层次的问题：
Translated into the language of data, this becomes three questions at different levels:








层次
问题
数据产物




鉴定（identification）
样本里有哪些肽段和蛋白
PSM 表、peptide 表、protein 表


定量（quantification）
每个蛋白在不同样本里有多少
强度矩阵、比值、差异检验结果


状态（state）
修饰位点、互作、定位、结构
位点表、互作网络、交联对、HDX 曲线



English








Level
Question
Data product




Identification
Which peptides and proteins are present in the sample
PSM table, peptide table, protein table


Quantification
How much of each protein is present in each sample
Intensity matrix, ratios, differential test results


State
Modification sites, interactions, localization, structure
Site table, interaction network, cross-linked pairs, HDX curves



后面所有的文件格式和分析步骤，都是为这三层服务。
Every file format and analysis step that follows serves these three layers.

objectID: posts/2026-10-26 Proteomics mass spectrometry data/index.html#一台-lc-msms-里发生了什么-what-happens-inside-an-lc-msms
href: posts/2026-10-26 Proteomics mass spectrometry data/index.html#一台-lc-msms-里发生了什么-what-happens-inside-an-lc-msms
title: Proteomics by mass spectrometry: what is inside a raw file
section: 2. 一台 LC-MS/MS 里发生了什么 / What happens inside an LC-MS/MS
text:
2. 一台 LC-MS/MS 里发生了什么 / What happens inside an LC-MS/MS
自下而上（bottom-up）蛋白质组学的标准流程是：提取蛋白 → 酶切成肽段 → 液相色谱分离 → 电喷雾离子化 → 质谱测量 → 数据库搜索。之所以先酶切，是因为完整蛋白太大、太难气化和碎裂；胰蛋白酶（trypsin）在 Lys/Arg 之后切割，产生长度和带电性质都比较适合质谱的肽段（常见 7–25 个氨基酸）。
The standard workflow of bottom-up proteomics is: extract proteins → digest into peptides → separate by liquid chromatography → ionize by electrospray → measure by mass spectrometry → database search. Digestion comes first because intact proteins are too large and too difficult to vaporize and fragment; trypsin cleaves after Lys/Arg, producing peptides whose length and charge properties are reasonably well suited to mass spectrometry (commonly 7–25 amino acids).


Code
steps <- data.frame(
  x = c(1, 2.75, 4.5, 6.25, 8),
  head = c("LC separation", "ESI", "MS1", "isolation", "MS2"),
  sub = c(
    "peptides elute over a\n60-120 min gradient",
    "multiply charged\nions in the gas phase",
    "precursor m/z,\nRT, ion mobility",
    "one precursor (DDA)\nor a window (DIA)",
    "fragment ions\nb / y series"
  )
)
links <- data.frame(x = steps$x[-nrow(steps)] + 0.72, xend = steps$x[-1] - 0.72)

ggplot() +
  geom_rect(
    data = steps,
    aes(xmin = x - 0.68, xmax = x + 0.68, ymin = 0.42, ymax = 0.90, fill = head),
    colour = "white", linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(data = steps, aes(x, 0.665, label = head),
            colour = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 3.2) +
  geom_text(data = steps, aes(x, 0.20, label = sub),
            size = 2.7, colour = "grey30", lineheight = 0.95) +
  geom_segment(
    data = links, aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = 0.665, yend = 0.665),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(2.4, "mm")), colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal[1:5], guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.15, 8.85), ylim = c(0, 1.05), clip = "off") +
  theme_blog() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.border = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )








Figure 2: 自下而上蛋白质组学的主链路。每一步的产物都是一个可检查的中间文件，这也是排错时最有效的定位顺序。 | The main pipeline of bottom-up proteomics. The product of every step is an inspectable intermediate file, which is also the most effective order for localizing problems during troubleshooting.





几个决定数据形态的物理事实：
A few physical facts determine the shape of the data:

电喷雾（ESI）让肽段带上多个质子，所以同一个肽段会以 2+、3+、4+ 等多个电荷态出现，质荷比不同，但”质量”相同。
Electrospray ionization (ESI) gives peptides multiple protons, so the same peptide appears in several charge states such as 2+, 3+, and 4+; the mass-to-charge ratios differ, but the “mass” is the same.
质量分析器决定分辨率、质量精度和扫描速度。Orbitrap 分辨率高、质量精度好；TOF 扫描快；离子阱便宜；四极杆常作为前级过滤或做 PRM。这些硬件差别直接决定了 mzML 里每条 scan 的元数据。
The mass analyzer determines resolution, mass accuracy, and scan speed. The Orbitrap offers high resolution and good mass accuracy; TOF scans fast; ion traps are inexpensive; quadrupoles often act as a front-end filter or are used for PRM. These hardware differences directly determine the metadata of every scan in an mzML file.
离子淌度（ion mobility）在 m/z 和强度之外再加一维：碰撞截面积（CCS）或 1/K0。timsTOF 的 .d 文件因此是 4D 的。
Ion mobility adds another dimension beyond m/z and intensity: collision cross section (CCS) or 1/K0. The timsTOF .d file is therefore 4D.
碎裂方式决定谱图长什么样：HCD/CID 主要产生 b/y 离子，ETD 对磷酸化和大肽段更友好。
The fragmentation method determines what the spectrum looks like: HCD/CID mainly produce b/y ions, while ETD is more favorable for phosphorylation and large peptides.



Code
set.seed(3)
n <- 3000
mz <- runif(n, 400, 1200)
k0 <- 1.05 - 0.00042 * (mz - 400) + rnorm(n, 0, 0.045)
ccs_df <- data.frame(mz = mz, k0 = k0)

ggplot(ccs_df, aes(mz, k0)) +
  geom_point(colour = blog_pal[["blue"]], size = 0.35, alpha = 0.22) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, colour = blog_pal[["vermillion"]],
              linewidth = 0.8, se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "m/z", y = expression("1/"*K[0]~"(ion mobility)"),
    title = "4D separation",
    subtitle = "peptides form a narrow band in the m/z - ion mobility plane"
  )








Figure 3: 加上离子淌度后，数据从 3D 变成 4D。同一 m/z 上的共洗脱肽段可以在淌度维度被分开，这也是 timsTOF 和 FAIMS 提高鉴定数的核心原因。 | With ion mobility, the data go from 3D to 4D. Co-eluting peptides at the same m/z can be separated in the mobility dimension, which is the core reason timsTOF and FAIMS increase identification numbers.

objectID: posts/2026-10-26 Proteomics mass spectrometry data/index.html#一次运行在文件里长什么样-what-a-single-run-looks-like-inside-the-file
href: posts/2026-10-26 Proteomics mass spectrometry data/index.html#一次运行在文件里长什么样-what-a-single-run-looks-like-inside-the-file
title: Proteomics by mass spectrometry: what is inside a raw file
section: 3. 一次运行在文件里长什么样 / What a single run looks like inside the file
text:
3. 一次运行在文件里长什么样 / What a single run looks like inside the file
一次 90 分钟的 DDA 运行，典型会产生 3,000–10,000 张 MS1 谱和 30,000–150,000 张 MS2 谱，文件大小从几百 MB 到几 GB。这个规模决定了三件事：不能一次全读进内存、必须能随机访问某一条扫描、必须有索引。
A typical 90-minute DDA run produces 3,000–10,000 MS1 spectra and 30,000–150,000 MS2 spectra, with file sizes ranging from a few hundred MB to several GB. This scale dictates three things: the file cannot be read into memory all at once, random access to any given scan must be possible, and an index is required.
最直观的视图是总离子流（TIC）：把每一张 MS1 谱的所有强度加起来，对保留时间作图。
The most intuitive view is the total ion current (TIC): sum all intensities in each MS1 spectrum and plot the result against retention time.


Code
rt <- seq(0, 90, length.out = 4000)
mu  <- c(9, 14, 18.5, 23, 28, 33, 37.5, 42, 47, 52, 57.5, 63, 68, 73, 79, 84.5)
amp <- c(0.35, 0.55, 0.80, 0.50, 0.95, 0.42, 1.00, 0.60, 0.75, 0.50, 0.90, 0.65, 0.55, 0.70, 0.40, 0.30)
wd  <- c(0.90, 1.10, 0.70, 1.30, 0.90, 1.00, 0.80, 1.20, 0.70, 1.10, 0.90, 1.00, 1.20, 0.80, 1.00, 1.10)

tic <- rowSums(sapply(seq_along(mu), function(i) amp[i] * exp(-((rt - mu[i])^2) / (2 * wd[i]^2))))
tic_df <- data.frame(rt = rt, intensity = tic + 0.04)

p_tic <- ggplot(tic_df, aes(rt, intensity)) +
  geom_area(fill = blog_pal[["sky"]], alpha = 0.28) +
  geom_line(colour = blog_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.45) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "total ion current",
    title = "One LC-MS/MS run",
    subtitle = "TIC over a 90 min gradient"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

cyc <- seq(0.8, 89, by = 1.55)
scan_df <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(t = cyc, level = "MS1", h = 1),
  data.frame(t = as.vector(outer(cyc, seq(0.15, 1.25, length.out = 6), "+")),
             level = "MS2", h = 0.28)
)

p_scan <- ggplot(scan_df, aes(x = t, xend = t, y = 0, yend = h, colour = level)) +
  geom_segment(linewidth = 0.45) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(MS1 = "grey35", MS2 = blog_pal[["vermillion"]])) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "retention time (min)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top", panel.border = element_blank()
  )

p_tic / p_scan + plot_layout(heights = c(3.4, 1))








Figure 4: 上：总离子流色谱图，峰是随梯度洗脱出来的肽段群体。下：同一条时间轴上的扫描类型，灰色是 MS1 调查扫描，红色是随后触发的 MS2 碎裂扫描。 | Top: total ion current chromatogram; the peaks are populations of peptides eluting along the gradient. Bottom: scan types on the same time axis—grey marks MS1 survey scans, red marks the MS2 fragmentation scans they trigger.





单张谱图则是另一个视图：横轴 m/z，纵轴强度。MS1 上看到的是同位素包络（isotope envelope），MS2 上看到的是碎片离子。
A single spectrum is another view: m/z on the x-axis, intensity on the y-axis. MS1 shows the isotope envelope; MS2 shows fragment ions.


Code
iso <- data.frame(
  mz = 500.26 + (0:6) * (1.00728 / 2),
  intensity = c(0.32, 1.00, 0.74, 0.41, 0.19, 0.08, 0.03)
)
p_ms1 <- ggplot(iso, aes(mz, intensity)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = mz, y = 0, yend = intensity),
               colour = blog_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(colour = blog_pal[["blue"]], size = 1.6) +
  annotate("text", x = 501.05, y = 0.92, label = "0.501 Th", size = 3, colour = "grey30") +
  annotate("segment", x = 500.26, xend = 501.26, y = 0.86, yend = 0.86,
           arrow = arrow(ends = "both", length = unit(1.8, "mm")), colour = "grey45") +
  labs(x = "m/z", y = "relative intensity", title = "MS1: isotope envelope",
       subtitle = "charge 2+, spacing 1.007 / z") +
  ylim(0, 1.1)

frag <- data.frame(
  mz = c(147.11, 218.15, 331.23, 402.27, 515.35, 612.41, 726.45, 813.48,
         175.12, 288.20, 359.25, 472.33, 569.39, 683.43, 770.47, 899.51),
  intensity = c(0.22, 0.45, 0.31, 0.68, 0.39, 1.00, 0.28, 0.74,
                0.36, 0.58, 0.25, 0.88, 0.33, 0.62, 0.42, 0.95),
  series = c(rep("b", 8), rep("y", 8))
)
lab <- frag %>% filter(intensity > 0.6)

p_ms2 <- ggplot(frag, aes(mz, intensity, colour = series)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = mz, y = 0, yend = intensity), linewidth = 0.55) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = lab, aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", mz)), size = 2.6,
    min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.3, seed = 2,
    max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(b = blog_pal[["blue"]], y = blog_pal[["vermillion"]])) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "m/z", y = "relative intensity", colour = "ion series",
       title = "MS2: fragment ions", subtitle = "the b / y ladder encodes the sequence") +

section: 4. DDA、DIA、PRM：三种采集策略 / DDA, DIA, PRM: three acquisition strategies
text:
4. DDA、DIA、PRM：三种采集策略 / DDA, DIA, PRM: three acquisition strategies
数据长什么样，首先取决于仪器怎么选前体。
What the data look like depends first on how the instrument selects precursors.
DDA（data-dependent acquisition）：先做一张 MS1 调查扫描，挑信号最强的前 N 个前体，逐个隔离、碎裂、采集 MS2。优点是谱图干净、好搜库；缺点是随机性——强弱共洗脱时弱信号会被挤掉，低丰度肽段在不同重复之间可能时有时无，这就是定量缺失值的主要来源之一。
DDA (data-dependent acquisition): acquire an MS1 survey scan first, pick the top N most intense precursors, then isolate, fragment, and acquire MS2 for each in turn. The advantage is clean spectra that are easy to search; the drawback is stochasticity—when strong and weak signals co-elute, weak signals get crowded out, and low-abundance peptides may appear in some replicates but not others. This is one of the main sources of missing values in quantification.
DIA（data-independent acquisition）：不等选择，按 m/z 切成若干窗口，每个窗口内的所有前体一起碎裂、一起采集。覆盖更稳定、重复性更好；代价是 MS2 谱是混合谱，必须靠谱图库或伪谱库去卷积。
DIA (data-independent acquisition): no precursor selection; the m/z range is divided into windows, and all precursors within a window are fragmented and acquired together. Coverage is more stable and reproducibility better; the cost is that MS2 spectra are mixed spectra, which must be deconvolved using a spectral library or a pseudo-library.
PRM（parallel reaction monitoring）：事先指定目标肽段，把它们的前体列进包含列表，长时间累积信号。这是靶向定量，灵敏度最高，但只能测你列出来的东西。
PRM (parallel reaction monitoring): target peptides are specified in advance, their precursors are placed on an inclusion list, and signal is accumulated over a long period. This is targeted quantification with the highest sensitivity, but it can only measure what you list.


Code
set.seed(7)
cycles <- 20
ms2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(cycles), function(i) {
  k <- sample(2:5, 1)
  data.frame(
    rt = (i - 1) * 2.6 + runif(k, 0.3, 2.2),
    mz = runif(k, 430, 1150)
  )
}))

p_dda <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = data.frame(rt = (seq_len(cycles) - 1) * 2.6 + 0.14),
    aes(x = rt, xend = rt, y = 400, yend = 1200),
    colour = "grey78", linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = ms2,
    aes(xmin = rt - 0.18, xmax = rt + 0.18, ymin = mz - 6, ymax = mz + 6),
    fill = blog_pal[["vermillion"]], alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 52), ylim = c(400, 1200)) +
  labs(x = "retention time (min)", y = "m/z", title = "DDA",
       subtitle = "top-N precursors per cycle") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

w <- 20
starts <- seq(400, 1200 - w, by = w * 2 / 3)
dia <- data.frame(ymin = starts, ymax = starts + w, idx = seq_along(starts))

p_dia <- ggplot(dia) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 52, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = factor(idx %% 3)),
    colour = "white", linewidth = 0.45, alpha = 0.42
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal[c(1, 5, 3)], guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 52), ylim = c(400, 1200)) +
  labs(x = "retention time (min)", y = NULL, title = "DIA",
       subtitle = "overlapping windows tile everything, all the time") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

section: 5. 原始数据格式的架构 / The architecture of raw data formats
text:
5. 原始数据格式的架构 / The architecture of raw data formats
这是本文的核心部分。理解格式的关键，是把文件分成四层：
This is the core part of the article. The key to understanding the formats is to divide a file into four layers:

厂商原始层：仪器直接写出的文件，包含完整扫描信息，但二进制结构不公开。
Vendor raw layer: the file the instrument writes directly, containing complete scan information, but with a binary structure that is not public.
开放谱图层：把原始层无损转换成语义明确的谱图格式，主要是 mzML。
Open spectra layer: a lossless conversion of the raw layer into a spectra format with explicit semantics, mainly mzML.
鉴定结果层：搜库软件输出的 PSM / peptide / protein 记录（mzIdentML、pepXML、mzTab）。
Identification result layer: the PSM / peptide / protein records output by search software (mzIdentML, pepXML, mzTab).
定量与处理层：矩阵、报告表、项目文件（parquet、TSV、Skyline .sky、FragPipe 输出等）。
Quantification and processing layer: matrices, report tables, and project files (parquet, TSV, Skyline .sky, FragPipe output, etc.).



Code
fmt <- data.frame(
  layer = factor(
    c(rep("vendor raw", 4), rep("open spectra", 4), rep("identification", 3), rep("quantification", 4)),
    levels = c("vendor raw", "open spectra", "identification", "quantification")
  ),
  name = c(
    "Thermo .raw", "Bruker .d", "SCIEX .wiff2", "Waters .raw",
    "mzML", "mzMLb", "MGF", "imzML",
    "mzIdentML", "pepXML", "mzTab",
    "DIA-NN parquet", "MaxQuant txt", "Skyline .sky", "FragPipe tsv"
  )
) %>%
  group_by(layer) %>%
  mutate(pos = row_number(), n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    x = (pos - 0.5) / n,
    y = as.numeric(layer),
    half = 0.43 / n
  )

ggplot(fmt) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(xmin = x - half, xmax = x + half, ymin = y - 0.17, ymax = y + 0.17, fill = layer),
    colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(x, y, label = name), size = 2.8, colour = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("vendor raw" = blog_pal[["grey"]], "open spectra" = blog_pal[["blue"]],
               "identification" = blog_pal[["green"]], "quantification" = blog_pal[["purple"]]),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:4,
    labels = c("vendor raw\n(binary, closed)", "open spectra\n(XML / HDF5)",
               "identification\n(PSM results)", "quantification\n(matrices / reports)"),
    limits = c(0.55, 4.45)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.02, 1.02), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_blog() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(), legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, lineheight = 0.95)
  )








Figure 7: 四层格式的分工。分析代码通常只和上面三层打交道，但排错时必须回到最底层的原始文件。 | The division of labor among the four format layers. Analysis code usually only deals with the top three layers, but troubleshooting must go back to the raw files at the very bottom.






5.1 厂商封闭格式 / Closed vendor formats

Platform
Extension

.raw

Most common; reading it requires the official RawFileReader or a prior conversion


Bruker (timsTOF, maXis)
.d
Directory containing analysis.tdf, analysis.tdf_bin, *.baf
4D data (including ion mobility); almost always requires the vendor SDK or alphatims first

.d

.raw (directory)
Directory, MassLynx internal structure
Same name as Thermo .raw but completely different



封闭格式的共同问题：
Common problems with closed formats:

不可逆：一旦厂商停止维护解析库，旧数据就可能读不出来；
Irreversible: once the vendor stops maintaining the parsing library, old data may become unreadable;
平台绑定：想批量处理只能装对应 SDK，Windows/Linux 支持不一致；
Platform-bound: batch processing requires installing the corresponding SDK, and Windows/Linux support is inconsistent;
仓库不友好：大二进制 + 目录结构，做版本管理几乎不可能。
Repository-unfriendly: large binaries plus directory structures make version control almost impossible.

所以几乎所有正式的蛋白质组学流程都会做一步”转换一次，之后只读开放格式”。常用转换器是 ProteoWizard 的 msconvert 和 Thermo 官方的 ThermoRawFileParser。
So almost every serious proteomics pipeline performs one step: “convert once, then read only open formats from then on”. The common converters are ProteoWizard’s msconvert and Thermo’s official ThermoRawFileParser.


5.2 mzML：开放谱图格式的事实标准 / mzML: the de facto standard for open spectra
mzML 由 HUPO-PSI 维护，本质是一个 XML 索引 + base64 编码的压缩二进制数组。一个最小的结构如下：
mzML is maintained by HUPO-PSI and is essentially an XML index plus base64-encoded, compressed binary arrays. A minimal structure looks like this:
<indexedmzML>
  <mzML version="1.1.0">
    <cvList>            <!-- 受控词表：PSI-MS、UO、MS -->
    <fileDescription>   <!-- 文件内容、来源 -->
    <softwareList>      <!-- 写入该文件的软件与版本 -->
    <instrumentConfigurationList>
    <dataProcessingList>
    <run id="run1" startTimeStamp="...">
      <spectrumList count="84213">
        <spectrum id="controllerType=0 controllerNumber=1 scan=2"
                  index="1" defaultArrayLength="412">
          <cvParam cvRef="MS" accession="MS:1000511" name="ms level" value="1"/>
          <scanList count="1">
            <scan>
              <cvParam accession="MS:1000016" name="scan start time" value="0.0212" unitName="minute"/>
            </scan>
          </scanList>
          <binaryDataArrayList count="2">
            <binaryDataArray>
              <cvParam accession="MS:1000514" name="m/z array" unitName="m/z"/>
              <binary>eJztwTEBAAAAwqD1T20...</binary>   <!-- zlib + base64 -->
            </binaryDataArray>
            <binaryDataArray>
              <cvParam accession="MS:1000515" name="intensity array" unitName="number of detector counts"/>
              <binary>eJztwTEBAAAAwqD1T20...</binary>
            </binaryDataArray>
          </binaryDataArrayList>
        </spectrum>
      </spectrumList>
      <chromatogramList count="3"> ... </chromatogramList>
    </run>
  </mzML>
  <indexList>  <!-- offset 索引，支持随机访问 -->
    <index name="spectrum">
      <offset idRef="...scan=2">12345</offset>
    </index>
  </indexList>
</indexedmzML>
几个容易忽略但很重要的细节：
A few details that are easy to overlook but important:

所有字段都由受控词表（CV）定义，例如 MS:1000511 是 ms level，MS:1000514 是 m/z array。这让不同仪器的数据可以语义对齐，也让解析器不必猜字段名。
All fields are defined by controlled vocabularies (CV): for example, MS:1000511 is ms level and MS:1000514 is m/z array. This lets data from different instruments be semantically aligned and frees parsers from guessing field names.
二进制数组是 zlib 压缩后的 base64，通常 32 位 float（m/z 也可以是 64 位 double）。m/z 用 double、intensity 用 float 是最常见的组合。
Binary arrays are zlib-compressed base64, usually 32-bit float (m/z can also be 64-bit double). Using double for m/z and float for intensity is the most common combination.
indexedmzML 才有索引，未索引的 mzML 只能顺序读，处理大队列时会慢一个量级。
Only indexedmzML has an index; an unindexed mzML can only be read sequentially, which is an order of magnitude slower when processing large cohorts.
谱图顺序是文件顺序，不是 m/z 顺序。很多算法需要先按 m/z 排序，这一步很吃内存。
Spectrum order is file order, not m/z order. Many algorithms need to sort by m/z first, and this step is memory-hungry.

围绕 mzML 还有几个变体：
There are also several variants around mzML:

适用场景

只适用于成像数据

生态仍在建设中

5.3 鉴定与定量层的格式 / Formats in the identification and quantification layers
搜库之后，数据不再是”谱图”，而是”谱图与肽段的对应关系”：
After database search, the data are no longer “spectra” but “correspondences between spectra and peptides”:

5.4 同样的数据，不同的体积 / Same data, different sizes
同一次运行转成不同格式，体积差别很大。下面的数字是示意性的量级，不是实测值，但比例关系是真实的：文本格式（MGF）只保留 MS2 所以最小；mzML 不做压缩会膨胀数倍；HDF5 类格式介于两者之间。
Converting the same run into different formats yields very different file sizes. The numbers below are illustrative magnitudes, not measured values, but the ratios are realistic: the text format (MGF) keeps only MS2 and is therefore the smallest; uncompressed mzML inflates several-fold; HDF5-based formats fall in between.


Code
sizes <- data.frame(
  format = factor(
    c("MGF (MS2 only)", "Thermo .raw", "mzML (zlib)", "mzXML", "mzML (uncompressed)"),
    levels = rev(c("MGF (MS2 only)", "Thermo .raw", "mzML (zlib)", "mzXML", "mzML (uncompressed)"))
  ),
  gb = c(0.6, 1.3, 2.4, 3.2, 7.8)
)

ggplot(sizes, aes(gb, format, fill = format)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.62, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(gb, " GB")), hjust = -0.15, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "MGF (MS2 only)" = blog_pal[["grey"]], "Thermo .raw" = blog_pal[["purple"]],
    "mzML (zlib)" = blog_pal[["blue"]], "mzXML" = blog_pal[["sky"]],
    "mzML (uncompressed)" = blog_pal[["vermillion"]]
  )) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 9.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "file size (GB, illustrative)", y = NULL,
       title = "Format overhead", subtitle = "same run, five containers")








Figure 8: 同一次 90 分钟 DDA 运行在不同格式下的示意体积。注意 MGF 体积小是因为它丢掉了 MS1 和大部分元数据，不是因为它更高效。 | Illustrative file sizes for the same 90-minute DDA run in different formats. Note that MGF is small because it discards MS1 and most of the metadata, not because it is more efficient.

text:
6. 原始文件里到底存了哪些字段 / Which fields are actually stored in a raw file
不管容器是什么，每条扫描通常都带有下列信息。这份清单可以直接用来检查”转换是否丢信息”：
Whatever the container, every scan usually carries the following information. This list can be used directly to check whether a conversion has lost information:








类别
字段
为什么重要




定位
scan number / native ID、index

层级

决定后续处理方式

Category
Field
Why it matters

determines whether centroiding is needed


Mobility
1/K0, CCS, FAIMS CV
the fourth dimension of 4D data


Instrument
model, source, detector, polarity
troubleshooting batch effects


Summary
TIC, base peak intensity, injection time, AGC
quality control and normalization


Chromatogram
chromatogram list (TIC, BPC, SRM)
fast quality control without parsing every spectrum



一个常见的坑：profile 与 centroid。高分辨仪器原始数据常是 profile（连续采样的峰形），而搜库需要 centroid（峰顶一个 m/z 值）。msconvert 的 --filter "peakPicking true 1-" 就是在做这件事。如果 centroid 参数不合适，同位素峰会被合并或漏掉，直接影响电荷判断。
A common pitfall: profile versus centroid. Raw data from high-resolution instruments are often profile (a continuously sampled peak shape), whereas database search requires centroid (a single m/z value at the peak apex). msconvert’s --filter "peakPicking true 1-" does exactly this. If the centroiding parameters are unsuitable, isotope peaks may be merged or missed, directly affecting charge determination.

href: posts/2026-10-26 Proteomics mass spectrometry data/index.html#用-python-读取-reading-data-with-python
title: Proteomics by mass spectrometry: what is inside a raw file
section: 7. 用 Python 读取 / Reading data with Python
text:
7. 用 Python 读取 / Reading data with Python
Python 生态里最常用的是 pyteomics（纯 Python、惰性迭代、内存友好）和 pymzml；需要完整工具链时用 pyOpenMS；做谱图相似度与机器学习时用 matchms。
In the Python ecosystem, the most commonly used packages are pyteomics (pure Python, lazy iteration, memory-friendly) and pymzml; use pyOpenMS when a complete toolchain is needed, and matchms for spectral similarity and machine learning.

7.1 mzML：流式读取 MS2 / mzML: streaming MS2 reads
from pyteomics import mzml

with mzml.MzML("run.mzML") as reader:
    print(reader.header[:3])          # 软件、仪器等元数据
    for spec in reader:
        if spec["ms level"] != 2:
            continue
        scan = spec["scanList"]["scan"][0]
        rt = scan["scan start time"]   # 默认单位见 unitInfo
        prec = spec["precursorList"]["precursor"][0]
        ion = prec["selectedIonList"]["selectedIon"][0]

        mz = spec["m/z array"]
        intensity = spec["intensity array"]
        print(spec["id"], rt, ion.get("selected ion m/z"),
              ion.get("charge state"), mz[:3], intensity[:3])
        break
要点：
Key points:

mzml.MzML 是迭代器，不会把整个文件读进内存；
mzml.MzML is an iterator and will not read the whole file into memory;
数组是 numpy.ndarray，可以直接做向量运算；
Arrays are numpy.ndarray, so vectorized operations work directly;
电荷、前体 m/z 等键名不保证存在，用 .get()；
Keys such as charge and precursor m/z are not guaranteed to exist; use .get();
如果只关心元数据，reader.get_by_id() 配合索引比顺序遍历快得多。
If you only care about metadata, reader.get_by_id() with an index is much faster than sequential iteration.



7.2 其他格式 / Other formats
# pymzml：接口更"对象化"
import pymzml
run = pymzml.run.Reader("run.mzML")
for spec in run:
    if spec.ms_level == 2:
        mz, i = spec.peaks("raw")
        break

# matchms：读成标准化 Spectrum 对象，方便算余弦相似度
from matchms.importing import load_from_mzml
spectra = list(load_from_mzml("run.mzML"))
print(spectra[0].metadata)

# pyOpenMS：完整算法库（峰提取、校正、搜库接口）
import pyopenms as oms
exp = oms.MSExperiment()
oms.MzMLFile().load("run.mzML", exp)
print(exp.getNrSpectra(), exp.getNrChromatograms())

# mzIdentML：读鉴定结果
from pyteomics import mzid
with mzid.MzIdentML("search.mzid") as reader:
    for psm in reader:
        print(psm["spectrumID"], psm["chargeState"], psm["PeptideSequence"])


7.3 厂商格式与衍生格式 / Vendor formats and derived formats
# Thermo .raw：官方推荐先转开放格式，一次性成本换来长期可复现
# ThermoRawFileParser -i run.raw -o out/ -f 2      (-f 2 = mzML)

# Bruker timsTOF 的 4D 数据
from alphatims.bruker import TimsTOF
data = TimsTOF("run.d", use_bruker_sdk=False)
print(data.shape)          # 语义维度：frame / scan / tof ...

# DIA-NN 的 parquet 报告：列式存储，读取和筛选都快
import pyarrow.parquet as pq
df = pq.read_table("report.parquet").to_pandas()
df = df[df["Q.Value"] <= 0.01]
