section: 5. 群体运动：Vicsek 模型与从无序到有序 / Collective Motion: The Vicsek Model and the Transition from Disorder to Order
text:
5. 群体运动：Vicsek 模型与从无序到有序 / Collective Motion: The Vicsek Model and the Transition from Disorder to Order
元胞自动机有一个隐忧：它的宏观图案是静态的，而生命系统最显眼的能力是运动中的协调。鸟群没有中心控制器，鱼群在受惊时半秒内整体转向。Vicsek 模型（Vicsek et al., 1995）用最少的机制解释了这件事。
Cellular automata carry one worry: their macroscopic patterns are static, while the most conspicuous ability of living systems is coordination in motion. A flock has no central controller, and a school of fish can turn as a whole in half a second. The Vicsek model (Vicsek et al., 1995) explains this with the least possible machinery.

5.1 三条规则 / Three rules
\(N\) 个粒子在边长 \(L\) 的环面上以恒定速率 \(v\) 运动。每一步：
\(N\) particles move at constant speed \(v\) on a torus of side \(L\). At each step:

找到半径 \(r\) 内的所有邻居；
find every neighbour within radius \(r\);
把自己的朝向角改成邻居平均朝向，再加上一个均匀噪声 \(\xi_i\sim U(-\eta/2,\eta/2)\)；
replace your heading by the neighbours’ mean heading, plus uniform noise \(\xi_i\sim U(-\eta/2,\eta/2)\);
沿新朝向前进 \(v\,\Delta t\)。
move forward by \(v\,\Delta t\) along the new heading.

写成式子：
In symbols:
\[
\theta_i(t+1)=\arg\!\left(\sum_{j\in\mathcal{N}_i(t)} e^{\,i\theta_j(t)}\right)+\xi_i,
\qquad
\mathbf{r}_i(t+1)=\mathbf{r}_i(t)+v\,\Delta t\,\big(\cos\theta_i,\ \sin\theta_i\big)
\]
注意 \(\arg\sum e^{i\theta}\) 这个写法：它自动处理了角度的环绕（\(0\) 与 \(2\pi\) 是同一个方向），而且是邻居平均方向而不是「邻居平均角度」——这两者在跨过 \(\pm\pi\) 时完全不同，是这类模型最容易写错的地方。
Note the \(\arg\sum e^{i\theta}\) form: it handles the wrap-around of angles automatically (\(0\) and \(2\pi\) are the same heading), and it averages directions rather than numbers — the two differ completely across \(\pm\pi\), and this is the most common implementation error in this class of models.


5.2 有序与无序的两种面貌 / What the two phases look like


Code
plot_vicsek <- function(d, title) {
  m0 <- atan2(mean(sin(d$theta)), mean(cos(d$theta)))
  d$align <- cos(d$theta - m0)
  ggplot(d, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = x + 1.1 * cos(theta), yend = y + 1.1 * sin(theta),
                     colour = align),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(1.5, "mm")), linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_colour_gradientn(colours = em_div, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "alignment") +
    coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, d$L[1]), ylim = c(0, d$L[1]), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank())
}
ord <- data.frame(vic$ordered); ord$L <- vic$ordered$L
dis <- data.frame(vic$disordered); dis$L <- vic$disordered$L
plot_vicsek(ord, sprintf("eta = 0.2, Phi = %.2f", order_parameter(ord$theta))) +
  plot_vicsek(dis, sprintf("eta = 4.2, Phi = %.2f", order_parameter(dis$theta))) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect")








Figure 5: 图 9　同一模型、同一密度、同一速度，只改噪声。左：噪声 \(\eta=0.2\)，粒子在几十步内对齐成一股；右：\(\eta=4.2\)，局部对齐被噪声持续打散，只剩短程的小团簇。箭头方向为朝向，颜色为与全局平均方向的夹角余弦。 | Figure 9. Same model, same density, same speed — only the noise differs. Left: \(\eta=0.2\), particles align into one stream within a few dozen steps. Right: \(\eta=4.2\), local alignment is continuously destroyed and only short-lived clumps remain. Arrows are headings; colour is the cosine between a heading and the global mean.





图中两个系统的粒子数、密度、速度、边界条件完全相同，唯一差别是噪声幅度。左边那股「流」不是任何粒子被指定的目标：每个粒子只做了一件事——把朝向调向邻居的平均。右边也没有任何「反协调」机制：噪声足够大时，局部平均本身就不可靠。
The two systems in the figure have identical particle number, density, speed and boundary conditions; the only difference is the noise amplitude. The stream on the left was not assigned to any particle: each one only turned towards the mean of its neighbours. Nor is there any “anti-coordination” rule on the right: with enough noise, the local average itself becomes unreliable.







图 10　Vicsek 模型的实时演化（\(\eta=0.9\)）：颜色是与瞬时全局平均方向的夹角余弦，所以「变红」就是群体对齐。 / Figure 10. The Vicsek model in real time (\(\eta=0.9\)): colour is the cosine between a heading and the instantaneous global mean, so “turning red” is the flock forming.




5.3 序参量随控制参数怎么变？ / How does the order parameter move with the knob?
这是全文最核心的一张定量图。左图扫噪声，中图扫密度，右图把「系统尺寸」这个隐藏变量单独拿出来。三条曲线来自同一套模型、同一套参数，唯一改变的是被扫的那个量。
This is the central quantitative figure of the article. The left panel sweeps noise, the middle sweeps density, and the right isolates a hidden variable — system size. All three come from the same model and settings, with only the swept quantity changed.


Code
noise_mean <- vic$noise_sweep |> group_by(eta) |> summarise(phi = mean(phi), .groups = "drop")
dens_mean  <- vic$dens_sweep  |> group_by(rho) |> summarise(phi = mean(phi), .groups = "drop")

p_noise <- ggplot(noise_mean, aes(eta, phi)) +
  geom_line(data = vic$size_sweep, aes(eta, phi, group = factor(N),
                                       colour = factor(N)),
            linewidth = 0.55, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_line(colour = em_pal[["deep_red"]], linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(colour = em_pal[["deep_red"]], size = 1.3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("120" = em_pal[["pale_blue"]],
                                 "300" = em_pal[["blue"]],
                                 "700" = em_pal[["deep_blue"]]),
                      name = "N (single seed)") +
  labs(x = expression("noise " * eta), y = expression(Phi),
       title = "(a) noise sweep, rho = 4")

p_dens <- ggplot(dens_mean, aes(rho, phi)) +
  geom_line(colour = em_pal[["deep_blue"]], linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(colour = em_pal[["deep_blue"]], size = 1.3) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log2") +
  labs(x = expression("density " * rho), y = expression(Phi),
       title = "(b) density sweep, eta = 2.5")

p_size <- ggplot(subset(vic$size_sweep, eta == 3.5), aes(N, phi)) +
  geom_line(colour = em_pal[["grey"]], linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(colour = em_pal[["deep_red"]], size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log2") +
  labs(x = "N", y = expression(Phi), title = "(c) eta = 3.5")

(p_noise + p_dens + p_size) + plot_layout(widths = c(1.2, 1, 0.8))








Figure 6: 图 11　(a) 极化率随噪声下降；细线是不同系统尺寸的单次运行，\(N\) 越大曲线越低。(b) 固定 \(\eta=2.5\)，提高密度同样可以把系统推入有序相。(c) 在 \(\eta=3.5\) 处把 (a) 的差异单独画出来：同一噪声下，系统越大越无序，说明小系统的「有序」是有限尺寸效应。 | Figure 11. (a) Polarisation falls with noise; thin lines are single runs at different system sizes, and larger \(N\) sits lower. (b) At fixed \(\eta=2.5\), raising the density also pushes the system into the ordered phase. (c) The same difference isolated at \(\eta=3.5\): at fixed noise, larger systems are less ordered, so the apparent order of small systems is a finite-size effect.





左图的粗线是 \(N=300\)、两个种子的平均；三条细线是单种子的 \(N=120,300,700\)。这里必须诚实地说：在 \(N=300\) 时看不到尖锐的相变，\(\Phi\) 是从 1.00 平滑降到 0.10 的连续曲线。细线给出了原因的一半：在 \(\eta=3.5\) 附近，\(N=120\) 的系统仍报告 \(\Phi=\) 0.501，而 \(N=700\) 只有 0.402。小系统的高序参量是有限尺寸效应，不是更强的有序。
The thick line on the left is the mean over two seeds at \(N=300\); the three thin lines are single seeds at \(N=120, 300, 700\). Honesty is required here: at \(N=300\) there is no sharp transition — \(\Phi\) falls smoothly from 1.00 to 0.10. The thin lines give half of the reason: near \(\eta=3.5\) the \(N=120\) system still reports \(\Phi=\) 0.501, while \(N=700\) reports only 0.402. The higher order parameter of the small system is a finite-size effect, not stronger order.
右图则给出一个更清楚的结论：在 \(\eta=2.5\) 处，密度从 \(\rho=0.5\) 提高到 \(\rho=12\)，\(\Phi\) 从 0.138 升到 0.746，而且变化集中在 \(\rho\in[0.5,4]\)。这说明「有序」不是某个参数单独决定的，而是「邻居数量 × 邻居可靠性」的联合结果。 在低密度下，每个粒子只有很少的邻居，局部平均被个体噪声淹没；提高密度等价于提高局部平均的信噪比。
The middle panel gives a cleaner conclusion: at \(\eta=2.5\), raising the density from \(\rho=0.5\) to \(\rho=12\) lifts \(\Phi\) from 0.138 to 0.746, with most of the change between \(\rho=0.5\) and \(4\). Order is not decided by one parameter but by the product of neighbour number and neighbour reliability. At low density each particle has few neighbours, so the local average is drowned by individual noise; raising density is equivalent to raising the signal-to-noise ratio of that average.
如果只画到 \(N=700\)，「小系统看起来更有序」还只是一个现象。把它推到 \(N=1200\)、并只看无序相，就能得到一个可以用公式检验的结论。
If the sweep stops at \(N=700\), “small systems look more ordered” is just a phenomenon. Push it to \(N=1200\) and look only at the disordered phase, and the statement becomes something a formula can be checked against.


Code
fsum <- subset(fl$summary, eta == 4.2)
fsum$pred <- fsum$mean_phi[fsum$N == 120] * sqrt(120 / fsum$N)
p_a <- ggplot(fsum, aes(N, mean_phi)) +
  geom_line(aes(N, pred), colour = em_pal[["grey"]], linetype = "dashed",
            linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(colour = em_pal[["deep_blue"]], size = 2.4) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "N", y = expression(Phi), title = "(a) eta = 4.2, slope -1/2")

fhist <- subset(fl$series, N == 300 & t > 100)
fhist$phase <- ifelse(fhist$eta < 1, "ordered (eta = 0.4)",
                      "disordered (eta = 4.2)")
fill_vals <- c("ordered (eta = 0.4)" = em_pal[["deep_red"]],
               "disordered (eta = 4.2)" = em_pal[["deep_blue"]])
p_b <- ggplot(fhist, aes(phi, fill = phase, colour = phase)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_vals, name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = fill_vals, name = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1.02)) +
  labs(x = expression(Phi), y = "density", title = "(b) N = 300")
p_a + p_b
fit_slope <- coef(lm(log(mean_phi) ~ log(N), data = fsum))[[2]]








Figure 7: 图 12　无序相里的「有序」有多少是尺寸造的。左：\(\eta=4.2\) 的稳态极化率随 \(N\) 在双对数坐标下下降，虚线是由 \(N=120\) 出发、按 \(N^{-1/2}\) 外推的参考线；四个点整体沿着这条线走，中间两点在线的两侧。右：\(N=300\) 时 \(\Phi\) 的分布，有序相是一个贴着 1 的窄峰，无序相是一个横跨 0.01–0.37 的宽分布。 | Figure 12. How much of the ‘order’ in the disordered phase is manufactured by system size. Left: steady-state polarisation at \(\eta=4.2\) against \(N\) on log-log axes; the dashed line is the \(N^{-1/2}\) prediction anchored at \(N=120\), and the four points follow it overall, with the middle two falling on either side. Right: the distribution of \(\Phi\) at \(N=300\); the ordered phase is a narrow peak against 1, the disordered phase a broad distribution spanning 0.01–0.37.





左图给出的数字很干脆：\(\eta=4.2\) 时，\(\Phi\) 从 \(N=120\) 的 0.216 掉到 \(N=1200\) 的 0.069，比值 0.32，而 \(1/\sqrt{10}=0.32\)；四个点做双对数拟合得到的斜率是 -0.56，与 \(-0.5\) 几乎一致。无序相里的序参量不是零，而是按 \(1/\sqrt{N}\) 收缩——这正是「有限尺寸效应」的定量含义：任何有限系统都会报告一点点「有序」，系统越小，这一点点越大。同时也必须承认，中间两个点并不落在线上：\(1/\sqrt{N}\) 是一条趋势律，不是逐点定律。
The left panel gives a crisp number: at \(\eta=4.2\), \(\Phi\) drops from 0.216 at \(N=120\) to 0.069 at \(N=1200\); the ratio is 0.32 against \(1/\sqrt{10}=0.32\), and a log-log fit through the four points gives a slope of -0.56, close to \(-0.5\). The order parameter in the disordered phase is not zero; it shrinks as \(1/\sqrt{N}\) — which is exactly what “finite-size effect” means quantitatively: any finite system reports a little order, and the smaller the system, the bigger that little bit. One caveat is required: the middle two points do not sit on the line, so \(1/\sqrt{N}\) is a trend law here, not a pointwise one.
右图补上了另一半：同一个 \(N=300\)，有序相里的 \(\Phi\) 是一条贴着 1 的窄峰，无序相里则是一个宽分布。这里不能顺手说「涨落也按 \(1/\sqrt{N}\) 收缩」——实测标准差只从 0.086 降到 0.043，比值 0.50，比 \(1/\sqrt{10}\) 慢。均值的行为可以预测，涨落的收敛速度本文没有继续追。
The right panel supplies the other half: at the same \(N=300\), \(\Phi\) in the ordered phase is a narrow peak against 1, while the disordered phase gives a broad distribution. One should not casually extend the claim to the fluctuations: the measured standard deviation only falls from 0.086 to 0.043, a ratio of 0.50, slower than \(1/\sqrt{10}\). The mean is predictable; the convergence rate of the fluctuations is not pursued here.


5.4 相图：把两条曲线合成一张地图 / The phase diagram: two curves into one map


Code
ggplot(ph$vicsek, aes(factor(rho), factor(eta), fill = phi)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", phi)), size = 2.6,
            colour = ifelse(abs(ph$vicsek$phi - 0.5) > 0.32, "white",
                            em_pal[["grey"]])) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = em_div, limits = c(0, 1), name = expression(Phi)) +
  labs(x = expression("density " * rho), y = expression("noise " * eta))








Figure 8: 图 13　Vicsek 模型的相图。颜色为稳态极化率 \(\Phi\)，横轴为密度、纵轴为噪声。有序区（红）与无序区（蓝）之间是一条弯曲的边界：噪声越大，需要越多的邻居才能维持对齐。 | Figure 13. The Vicsek phase diagram. Colour is the steady-state polarisation \(\Phi\); the axes are density and noise. The boundary between the ordered region (red) and the disordered one (blue) is curved: the more noise, the more neighbours are needed to sustain alignment.





这张图把前面两个扫描合成一个二维地图，读法与地形图相同：等高线越密的地方，系统对参数的改变越敏感。可以看到，\(\eta\le 1\) 时几乎所有密度都处于有序区；\(\eta\ge 3.5\) 时只有 \(\rho\ge 4\) 还能维持部分有序；中间是一条斜向的过渡带。这条带是不是「真相变」，取决于它在 \(N\to\infty\) 时是否收窄成一条线——本文的系统尺寸不足以回答这个问题，这是必须承认的局限。
This figure folds the two sweeps into one two-dimensional map, read like a topographic map: the denser the contours, the more sensitive the system. For \(\eta\le 1\) almost every density is ordered; for \(\eta\ge 3.5\) only \(\rho\ge 4\) retains partial order; between them lies a diagonal band. Whether that band is a true transition depends on whether it narrows to a line as \(N\to\infty\) — the system sizes here cannot answer that, and the limitation has to be stated.


5.5 一级还是二级？一个没做完的检验 / First order or continuous? A test not completed here
文献里的 Vicsek 模型有一个值得警惕的性质：在更大的系统里，这个转变常常表现为一级相变，并伴随迟滞（hysteresis）——从有序相加大噪声，和从无序相减小噪声，两条路径给出的临界值不同，中间会出现有序与无序共存的条带。
A cautionary property of the Vicsek model in the literature is that at larger sizes the transition often appears first order, with hysteresis: increasing noise from the ordered side and decreasing it from the disordered side give different critical values, and in between the ordered and disordered phases coexist in bands.
本文没有做迟滞实验，也没有做从有序相出发的反向扫描，所以不能声称这里观察到的是哪种类型的相变。能说的只有一句：在 \(N=300\) 的这次扫描里，\(\Phi(\eta)\) 是一条单调下降的平滑曲线，没有任何突变或双稳的迹象。 这既可能是因为系统太小（一级相变在有限系统中会被严重抹平），也可能是因为参数区间选得太粗。把这一点写出来，是为了避免读者把图 13 的渐变带当成「临界点」。
This article does not run the hysteresis experiment, nor the reverse sweep starting from the ordered phase, so it cannot claim which type of transition is observed. The only defensible statement is: in this sweep at \(N=300\), \(\Phi(\eta)\) is a smooth, monotone decrease with no sign of a jump or of bistability. That may be because the system is too small (a first-order transition is heavily smeared by finite size) or because the parameter grid is too coarse. The point of saying it is to stop the reader from reading the gradient in Figure 13 as a critical point.


5.6 三维：规则里根本没有「二维」 / Three dimensions: the rule never mentioned “two”


Code
library(plotly)
mk3d <- function(k) {
  d <- vic3$runs[[k]]
  plot_ly(d, x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~z, color = ~alignment,
          colors = colorRamp(em_div), type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers",
          marker = list(size = 2.2), hoverinfo = "text",
          text = ~sprintf("alignment %.2f", alignment)) |>
    layout(title = sprintf("%s  (Phi = %.2f)", k, vic3$phi[[k]]),
           showlegend = FALSE,
           scene = list(xaxis = list(title = "", showticklabels = FALSE),
                        yaxis = list(title = "", showticklabels = FALSE),
                        zaxis = list(title = "", showticklabels = FALSE),
                        aspectmode = "cube"),
           margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 30, b = 0))
}
subplot(mk3d("eta 0.2"), mk3d("eta 0.8"), mk3d("eta 1.6"),
        nrows = 1, shareX = FALSE, shareY = FALSE, titleX = FALSE, titleY = FALSE)








Figure 9: 图 14　三维 Vicsek（可拖动旋转）。三种噪声下同一密度、同一速度的末态；每个点是一个粒子的位置，颜色为与全局平均方向的夹角余弦。三维版本的意义不是「更好看」，而是说明规则中没有任何与维度有关的内容。 | Figure 14. Three-dimensional Vicsek (drag to rotate). Final states at one density and speed under three noise levels; each dot is a particle, coloured by the cosine between its heading and the global mean. The point of the 3-D run is not that it looks better, but that nothing in the rule refers to the dimension.




三维结果与二维一致：噪声 \(0.2\) 时 \(\Phi=\) 0.998，噪声 \(0.8\) 时 0.973，噪声 \(1.6\) 时 0.894。这个数字本身不重要，重要的是同一条规则在三维里照样成立，说明「对齐」是一种与空间维度无关的机制。生命系统并不局限于二维，这一点在建模时经常被忘掉。
The 3-D results agree with the 2-D ones: \(\Phi=\) 0.998 at noise \(0.2\), 0.973 at \(0.8\), 0.894 at \(1.6\). The numbers themselves matter little; what matters is that the same rule works in three dimensions, showing that alignment is a mechanism independent of spatial dimension. Living systems are not confined to two dimensions, and models often forget it.

section: 6. 简单细胞通讯如何产生空间图案？ / How Can Simple Cell Communication Produce Spatial Patterns?
text:
6. 简单细胞通讯如何产生空间图案？ / How Can Simple Cell Communication Produce Spatial Patterns?
前两节的宏观结构都是「对齐」或「连通块」。生物体更常见的一类结构是空间图案：斑马条纹、毛囊间距、手指间的间隙、果蝇翅膀上的 veins。Turing（1952）给出了一个反直觉的机制：两种化学物质，一种自我激活、一种抑制并扩散得更快，就足以从均匀状态中长出有特征波长的图案。
The macroscopic structures in the previous two sections were alignment or connected patches. A more common biological structure is spatial pattern: zebra stripes, hair follicle spacing, the gaps between fingers, veins on a fly wing. Turing (1952) gave a counter-intuitive mechanism: two chemicals, one activating itself and one inhibiting it while diffusing faster, suffice to grow a pattern with a characteristic wavelength out of a uniform state.

6.1 模型：局部激活 + 长程抑制 / The model: local activation, long-range inhibition
把每个格点看成一个细胞，它有一个「底物」\(u\) 和一个「信号」\(v\)。细胞不断把 \(u\) 转成 \(v\)，\(v\) 自己催化这一步（正的局部反馈），同时 \(v\) 会扩散到邻居那里去抑制同样的过程（负的长程反馈）。Gray–Scott 方程是这个思想最简洁的写法：
Treat each site as a cell with a substrate \(u\) and a signal \(v\). The cell converts \(u\) into \(v\), and \(v\) catalyses that conversion (positive local feedback), while \(v\) diffuses to the neighbours and suppresses the same reaction there (negative long-range feedback). The Gray–Scott equations are the most compact statement of this idea:
\[
\frac{\partial u}{\partial t}=D_u\nabla^2u-uv^2+F(1-u),
\qquad
\frac{\partial v}{\partial t}=D_v\nabla^2v+uv^2-(F+k)v
\]
两个扩散系数满足 \(D_u>D_v\)（底物扩散得快，信号扩散得慢），这正是 Turing 条件在离散格点上的翻版：抑制必须比激活跑得更远。\(F\) 是补给率，\(k\) 是清除率，二者共同决定系统停在哪种形态。
The two diffusion constants satisfy \(D_u>D_v\) (substrate fast, signal slow), which is the lattice version of the Turing condition: inhibition must travel further than activation. \(F\) is the feed rate, \(k\) the kill rate, and together they decide which morphology the system settles into.


6.2 为什么「扩散」会制造结构？ / Why would diffusion create structure?
直觉上扩散是抹平差异的：一滴墨水滴进水里会散开，而不是聚成斑点。Turing 的反直觉之处在于指出：当两种物质以不同速度扩散，并且互相激活/抑制时，扩散反而会破坏均匀态。
Intuitively diffusion erases differences: ink dropped into water spreads out, it does not gather into spots. Turing’s counter-intuitive point is that when two species diffuse at different rates and regulate each other, diffusion can destroy the uniform state instead.
把方程在均匀定态 \((u^*,v^*)\) 附近线性化，设扰动为 \(e^{\sigma t+i\mathbf{k}\cdot\mathbf{x}}\)，得到色散关系
Linearise the equations around the uniform steady state \((u^*,v^*)\) and insert a perturbation \(e^{\sigma t+i\mathbf{k}\cdot\mathbf{x}}\); the dispersion relation is
\[
\sigma(\kappa) = \tfrac{1}{2}\Big[\,(J_{11}+J_{22})-\kappa^2(D_u+D_v) \pm \sqrt{\big((J_{11}-J_{22})-\kappa^2(D_u-D_v)\big)^2+4J_{12}J_{21}}\ \Big]
\]
其中 \(J\) 是反应项的雅可比矩阵，\(\kappa=|\mathbf{k}|\) 是波数。注意 \(\kappa^2\) 只出现在扩散项里：如果 \(D_u=D_v\)，扩散只是把 \(\sigma\) 整体平移，绝不会把稳定变成不稳定。只有当 \(D_u\neq D_v\)、且 \(J\) 的符号结构满足「自激活 + 交叉抑制」时，某个有限波数 \(\kappa_c\) 上的 \(\sigma\) 才会变正——这就是扩散驱动的不稳定性（diffusion-driven instability）。
where \(J\) is the Jacobian of the reaction terms and \(\kappa=|\mathbf{k}|\) the wavenumber. Note that \(\kappa^2\) appears only inside the diffusion terms: if \(D_u=D_v\), diffusion shifts \(\sigma\) uniformly and can never turn stability into instability. Only when \(D_u\neq D_v\) and the signs of \(J\) encode “self-activation plus cross-inhibition” does \(\sigma\) become positive at some finite wavenumber \(\kappa_c\) — this is diffusion-driven instability.
这个推导给出两个可检验的预言，本文的实验都验证了：第一，存在一个首选的波数，所以斑点的间距几乎一致（图 15）；第二，图案只在参数的一个窄带里出现，因为在带外要么 \(J\) 本身不稳定（整片点亮），要么扩散不足以打破稳定（什么都不长）。这也解释了为什么第 18 张图里 16 个组合有图案，而 60 个没有。
The derivation makes two testable predictions, and both are visible in the experiments here. First, a preferred wavenumber exists, so the spot spacing is nearly uniform (Figure 15). Second, patterns exist only in a narrow band of parameters, because outside it either \(J\) itself is unstable (the whole lattice ignites) or diffusion is too weak to break stability (nothing grows). This also explains why Figure 18 has 16 combinations with a pattern and 60 without one.


6.3 同一个规则，三种组织 / One rule, three tissues


Code
snap_idx <- c(1, 7, 13, 20)
pat_long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(pat), function(nm) {
  p <- pat[[nm]]
  do.call(rbind, lapply(snap_idx, function(i) {
    d <- as.data.frame(as.table(p$snaps[[i]]))
    names(d) <- c("row", "col", "v")
    d$row <- as.integer(d$row); d$col <- as.integer(d$col)
    d$regime <- nm
    d$t <- p$metrics$t[i]
    d
  }))
}))
pat_long$regime <- factor(pat_long$regime,
                          levels = c("uniform", "spots", "stripes"),
                          labels = c("uniform", "spots", "labyrinth"))
ggplot(pat_long, aes(col, row, fill = v)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#FFFFFF", em_pal[["pale_blue"]],
                                   em_pal[["blue"]], em_pal[["deep_blue"]]),
                       limits = c(0, 0.6), oob = scales::squish,
                       name = expression(v)) +
  scale_y_reverse(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  facet_grid(regime ~ t, labeller = label_both) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(), panel.spacing = unit(0.15, "lines"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))








Figure 10: 图 15　同一模型、同一初始种子，只改 \((F,k)\)。上行：信号始终无法自我维持，系统回到均匀态；中行：斑点；下行：迷宫状的条纹。每列是同一时刻。颜色为信号浓度 \(v\)。 | Figure 15. The same model and the same initial seed, changing only \((F,k)\). Top: the signal cannot sustain itself and the lattice returns to uniform. Middle: spots. Bottom: labyrinthine stripes. Columns are matched in time; colour is the signal \(v\).







Code
do.call(rbind, lapply(names(pat), function(nm) {
  m <- pat[[nm]]$metrics
  data.frame(regime = nm, F = pat[[nm]]$F, k = pat[[nm]]$k,
             `signal fraction` = round(m$v_frac[nrow(m)], 3),
             patches = as.integer(m$patches[nrow(m)]),
             `autocorr. lag` = as.integer(m$ac_len[nrow(m)]),
             class = pattern_class(pat[[nm]]$final))
})) |>
  knitr::kable()

English: macroscopic variables of the three tissues at \(t=4000\).
三行之间唯一的差别是两个数：\(F\) 与 \(k\)。没有任何一行被「编程」成斑点或迷宫——斑点是在 \(F=0.035\)、\(k=0.065\) 时自己长出来的，迷宫是在 \(F=0.030\)、\(k=0.055\) 时长出来的。这一点值得停一下：图案的「类型」不是由某个上层指令决定的，而是由两个反应速率的比值决定的。
The only difference between the three rows is two numbers: \(F\) and \(k\). No row was “programmed” to be spots or a labyrinth — spots grew at \(F=0.035\), \(k=0.065\), and the labyrinth at \(F=0.030\), \(k=0.055\). This is worth pausing on: the type of pattern is not set by any higher-level instruction, but by the ratio of two reaction rates.







图 16　斑点图案的生长过程（\(F=0.035\)，\(k=0.065\)）。从一个方形种子的局部扰动开始，信号向外扩散、彼此抑制，最后稳定成一群体积相近的斑点。 / Figure 16. How spots grow (\(F=0.035\), \(k=0.065\)). Starting from one square perturbation, the signal spreads, inhibits its neighbours, and settles into a set of spots of similar size.


图 16 里最容易被忽略的一点是斑点的尺寸几乎一致。这正是 Turing 机制的特征：图案的波长由扩散系数之比 \(\sqrt{D_u/D_v}\) 决定，而不是由初始种子的形状或大小决定。换句话说，尺度信息被写在了参数里，而不是写在初始条件里。
The easily missed point in Figure 16 is that the spots are nearly the same size. That is the signature of the Turing mechanism: the wavelength is set by the ratio \(\sqrt{D_u/D_v}\) of the diffusion constants, not by the shape or size of the initial seed. In other words, the scale is encoded in the parameters, not in the initial condition.
动画只给出「长成什么样」。要看清「怎么长」，更适合用时空图（kymograph）：取格点中的一行，把每一时刻的浓度画成一列，横向堆起来。
An animation shows only what the lattice ends up looking like. To see how it grows, a space-time diagram (kymograph) is better: take one row of the lattice and stack its concentration profile at successive times.


Code
kymo <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(gsd$cases), function(nm) {
  k <- gsd$cases[[nm]]$prof
  d <- expand.grid(r = seq_len(ncol(k)), t = gsd$cases[[nm]]$times)
  d$v <- as.vector(t(k))
  d$regime <- nm
  d
}))
kymo$regime <- factor(kymo$regime, levels = names(gsd$cases))
p_k <- ggplot(kymo, aes(t, r, fill = v)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#FFFFFF", em_pal[["pale_blue"]],
                                   em_pal[["blue"]], em_pal[["deep_blue"]]),
                       limits = c(0, 0.4), oob = scales::squish,
                       name = expression(v)) +
  facet_wrap(~regime, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "time step", y = "distance from the seed")

cov <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(gsd$cases), function(nm) {
  m <- gsd$cases[[nm]]$metrics
  data.frame(t = m$t, v_frac = m$v_frac, regime = nm)
}))
cov$regime <- factor(cov$regime, levels = names(gsd$cases))
p_cov <- ggplot(cov, aes(t, v_frac, colour = regime)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(em_pal[["deep_blue"]], em_pal[["grey"]]),
                      name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "time step", y = "signal coverage")

p_k + p_cov + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))
kA <- gsd$cases[[1]]$metrics
kB <- gsd$cases[[2]]$metrics








Figure 11: 图 17　同一方程的时空图：横轴是时间（0–4000 步），纵轴是距种子中心的距离，颜色是该半径上的平均信号浓度（按环平均，把角度方向压掉）。上：\((F,k)=(0.035,0.065)\)，信号从中心向外推进，前沿过处留下等间距的波列，间距由参数决定、与初始种子无关；下：\((F,k)=(0.010,0.060)\)，同一初始扰动在几百步内衰减为零。最下一行是两者的信号覆盖率随时间的变化。 | Figure 17. Space-time diagrams of the same equation: time runs left to right (0–4000 steps), the vertical axis is distance from the centre of the seed, and colour is the signal averaged over rings at that radius (which removes the angular direction). Top: \((F,k)=(0.035,0.065)\), where the signal advances outwards and leaves an evenly spaced wave train behind its front, the spacing set by the parameters rather than the seed. Bottom: \((F,k)=(0.010,0.060)\), where the same initial perturbation decays to zero within a few hundred steps. The lowest panel tracks signal coverage over time for both.





时空图把两件事同时说清楚了。第一，图案是长出来的，不是摆出来的：信号从中心向外推进，\(t=4000\) 时的径向剖面在半径约 7 与 17 个格点处各有一个峰，两峰相距约 10 个格点——这正是 Turing 波长，由参数决定，与初始种子的形状和大小无关。第二，生长有时间尺度：信号覆盖率从 \(t=1000\) 时的 2.0% 单调升到 \(t=4000\) 时的 6.8%，连通斑块从 4 个增到 16 个；而对照组在 80 步之内就衰减到零。
The space-time diagram settles two things at once. First, the pattern is grown, not placed: the signal advances outwards, and the radial profile at \(t=4000\) has one peak at about 7 lattice sites and another at about 17, roughly 10 sites apart — the Turing wavelength, fixed by the parameters and independent of the seed’s shape or size. Second, growth has a time scale: coverage rises monotonically from 2.0% at \(t=1000\) to 6.8% at \(t=4000\), and the patch count grows from 4 to 16, while the control case decays to zero within 80 steps.


6.4 相图：图案在哪里出现？ / The phase diagram: where do patterns exist?


Code
abbr <- c(uniform = "\u00b7", spots = "s", labyrinth = "l", mixed = "m", saturated = "x")
ggplot(ph$grayscott, aes(F, k, fill = v_frac)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = abbr[as.character(class)]), size = 2.8,
            colour = ifelse(ph$grayscott$v_frac > 0.45, "white", em_pal[["grey"]])) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#FFFFFF", em_pal[["pale_blue"]],
                                   em_pal[["blue"]], em_pal[["deep_blue"]]),
                       limits = c(0, 1), name = "signal\nfraction") +
  labs(x = "feed rate F", y = "kill rate k")








Figure 12: 图 18　细胞通讯模型的参数地图。颜色为稳态时携带信号的格点比例；标注为该格点的形态：· 均匀（什么都不长），s 斑点，l 迷宫（单连通条纹），m 混合，x 整片饱和。左下角（低补给）信号无法维持；右上角（高补给、低清除）整片格点被点亮；中间的窄带才是斑点与条纹。 | Figure 18. Parameter map of the signalling model. Colour is the fraction of the lattice carrying signal at steady state; the label gives the morphology: · uniform (nothing grows), s spots, l stripes, m mixed, x saturated. The lower-left corner (low feed) cannot sustain a signal; the upper-right (high feed, low kill) ignites the whole lattice; only the narrow band between them contains spots and stripes.





这张图说明「图案」是一个窄带现象：在 \(9\times 9\) 的扫描中，9 个参数组合给出斑点，7 个给出迷宫，24 个什么都不长，36 个整片点亮。大部分参数空间里什么都不会发生——这与「复杂系统总能产生复杂行为」的印象正好相反。
The figure shows that “pattern” is a narrow-band phenomenon: in the \(9\times 9\) scan, 9 parameter combinations give spots, 7 give a labyrinth, 24 give nothing, and 36 light up the whole lattice. In most of parameter space nothing happens — the opposite of the impression that complex systems always produce complex behaviour.
还有一点必须说清楚：这里的「迷宫」与斑点是同一个方程的两个解，不是两种机制。这提醒我们，用「形态分类」去推断「机制类别」是危险的：在模型里可以确认二者同源，在真实组织里却做不到。
One more caveat: the “labyrinth” and the spots here are two solutions of the same equation, not two mechanisms. That is a warning: inferring “different mechanism” from “different morphology” is unsafe. Inside a model we can verify common ancestry; in a real tissue we cannot.
同一张地图换一个坐标看，形状会更清楚：把覆盖率当作高度画出来，参数空间是一块高原（整片饱和）加一片平原（什么都不长），两片之间是一道沿对角线的陡坡，斑点与迷宫只出现在坡面上很窄的一条带里。
Seen from another angle the same map is easier to read: plot the coverage as height and parameter space becomes a plateau (fully saturated) plus a plain (nothing grows), separated by a steep slope running along the diagonal; spots and labyrinths appear only in a narrow strip on the face of that slope.


Code
zt <- xtabs(v_frac ~ F + k, data = ph$grayscott)
cs_ramp <- colorRamp(c("#FFFFFF", em_pal[["pale_blue"]], em_pal[["blue"]],
                       em_pal[["deep_blue"]]))
cs_cols <- rgb(cs_ramp(seq(0, 1, length.out = 9)), maxColorValue = 255)
cs_list <- lapply(seq_along(cs_cols), function(i)
  list((i - 1) / (length(cs_cols) - 1), cs_cols[i]))
plot_ly(x = as.numeric(rownames(zt)), y = as.numeric(colnames(zt)),
        z = unname(zt), type = "surface",
        colorscale = cs_list, cmin = 0, cmax = 1, showscale = FALSE,
        contours = list(z = list(show = TRUE, usecolormap = TRUE,
                                 project = list(z = TRUE)))) |>
  layout(scene = list(xaxis = list(title = "feed rate F"),
                      yaxis = list(title = "kill rate k"),
                      zaxis = list(title = "signal coverage"),
                      camera = list(eye = list(x = 1.6, y = -1.7, z = 1.1))))








Figure 13: 图 19　图 18 的三维版本（可拖动旋转）。高度与颜色都是信号覆盖率，底面投影是对应的等高线。高原是「整片饱和」，平原是「什么都不长」，中间的陡坡上有图案——坡的宽度只有一两个参数格点。 | Figure 19. Figure 18 in three dimensions (drag to rotate). Height and colour are signal coverage; the projection on the floor is the corresponding contour map. The plateau is ‘fully saturated’, the plain is ‘nothing grows’, and the patterns live on the steep slope between them, whose width is only one or two parameter cells.

section: 7. 如何判断一个系统真的发生了「涌现」？ / How Do We Know a System Truly Exhibits Emergence?
text:
7. 如何判断一个系统真的发生了「涌现」？ / How Do We Know a System Truly Exhibits Emergence?
到这里我们已经有三个模型、十来张图。现在必须回答一个不舒服的问题：凭什么说这些图代表「涌现」，而不是「画得好看」？
By now there are three models and a dozen figures. The uncomfortable question can no longer be postponed: what entitles us to call these pictures emergence rather than decoration?

7.1 五项检查 / Five checks
本文使用五项检查，每一项都对应一个可计算的量，而不是一句形容词：
This article uses five checks, each tied to a computable quantity rather than an adjective:

序参量：存在一个只在集体尺度上定义的量，并且它随控制参数系统性地变化。
Order parameter: a quantity defined only collectively, which moves systematically with a control parameter.
空间尺度：结构的关联长度显著大于个体间距（否则只是「每个细胞各自兴奋」）。
Spatial scale: the correlation length is much larger than the spacing between units (otherwise it is just “each cell excited on its own”).
稳定性：结构在若干步之后仍然存在，而不是一闪而过。
Stability: the structure survives many updates instead of flashing once.
可复现性：换随机种子、换初始条件，同类结构仍然出现。
Reproducibility: the same kind of structure appears under a different seed or initial condition.
不可还原性：无法从任何单个个体的状态读出这个量。
Irreducibility: the quantity cannot be read off any single unit.



7.2 反例：熵最高、结构最少 / The counter-example: maximum entropy, minimum structure


Code
cnt <- eca$metrics
cnt$system <- factor(cnt$system, levels = cnt$system[order(cnt$entropy)])
p1 <- ggplot(cnt, aes(entropy, system, fill = grepl("life", system))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.62) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = em_pal[["blue"]], `TRUE` = em_pal[["deep_red"]]),
                    guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "block entropy", y = NULL)
p2 <- ggplot(cnt, aes(compress, system, fill = grepl("life", system))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.62) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = em_pal[["blue"]], `TRUE` = em_pal[["deep_red"]]),
                    guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "compressed size / raw size", y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())
p1 + p2








Figure 14: 图 20　八个系统的两个宏观量。左：块熵（局部构型有多不可预测）；右：可压缩性（gzip 压缩后的体积比，越低越有规律）。iid 噪声的熵接近 1，但完全没有结构；rule 30 的熵也很高，而且逐帧毫无记忆；滑翔机的熵几乎为 0，却是一个稳定、可移动的宏观物体。熵高不等于涌现，熵低也不等于涌现。 | Figure 20. Two macroscopic quantities for eight systems. Left: block entropy (how unpredictable the local configuration is). Right: compressibility (compressed size over raw size; lower means more regular). iid noise has entropy near 1 but no structure at all; rule 30 also has high entropy and no frame-to-frame memory; the glider has almost zero entropy yet is a stable, mobile macroscopic object. High entropy is not emergence, and low entropy is not emergence either.





图 20 是全文的反例。按块熵排序，iid 噪声排在最前面（1.00），比 rule 30（0.67）和生命游戏（0.003）都高得多。如果「复杂」指的是熵，那么随机数是最复杂的系统——这显然不是我们想说的。
Figure 20 is the counter-example of the article. Sorted by block entropy, iid noise comes first (1.00), far above rule 30 (0.67) and the Game of Life (0.003). If “complex” meant entropy, random numbers would be the most complex system in the world — clearly not what we mean.
右边的可压缩性换了一个角度：iid 噪声几乎无法压缩（0.162），rule 30 稍好（0.135），rule 110 明显更规整（0.062），而滑翔机几乎是纯重复（0.003）。可压缩性度量的是「描述长度」，而熵度量的是「不确定性」，两者不是一回事：一个系统可以同时「很难预测」和「很容易描述」，也可以反过来。
Compressibility takes another angle: iid noise barely compresses (0.162), rule 30 is slightly better (0.135), rule 110 is clearly more regular (0.062), and the glider is almost pure repetition (0.003). Compressibility measures description length; entropy measures uncertainty. They are not the same thing: a system can be hard to predict and easy to describe, or the other way round.
所以判据不能只有一条。本文的结论是：只有当「序参量随参数系统性变化」+「关联长度远大于间距」+「结构能跨种子复现」同时成立时，才值得说「这个系统在这个尺度上发生了涌现」。 三项缺一，就只能说「产生了一个图案」。
So no single criterion suffices. The conclusion of this article is: only when “the order parameter moves systematically with a parameter”, “the correlation length far exceeds the spacing”, and “the structure reproduces across seeds” all hold is it worth saying that “this system is emergent at this scale”. Miss one, and all you have is “a pattern appeared”.
八个系统还只是手挑的例子。把同一套指标施加到全部 256 条基本元胞自动机上，就能看到这两个量在规则空间里怎么分布——以及为什么「复杂」不能被压成一个数。
Eight systems are still a hand-picked sample. Apply the same two metrics to all 256 elementary rules and you can see how they are distributed over rule space — and why “complex” cannot be collapsed into one number.


Code
rs <- rsp$rules
named <- subset(rs, rule %in% c(30, 90, 110, 184, 250))
named$lab <- paste("rule", named$rule)
noise_ref <- rsp$refs[grepl("iid", rsp$refs$system), ]
ggplot(rs, aes(entropy, compress)) +
  geom_point(colour = em_pal[["pale_blue"]], size = 1.1, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = named, colour = em_pal[["deep_red"]], size = 2.2) +
  geom_text(data = named, aes(label = lab), size = 2.6,
            colour = em_pal[["deep_red"]], vjust = -1, hjust = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = noise_ref, shape = 4, size = 3.4, colour = em_pal[["grey"]]) +
  geom_text(data = noise_ref, aes(label = "iid noise"), size = 2.6,
            colour = em_pal[["grey"]], vjust = -1, hjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "block entropy", y = "compressed size / raw size")








Figure 15: 图 21　把全部 256 条规则放进（块熵，可压缩性）平面，每条规则从同一随机初始行出发。浅蓝点是其余规则，红点是文中反复提到的五条，灰色叉号是一维 iid 噪声（同尺寸，可直接比较）。两个量正相关，但显然不是同一个轴：熵最高的规则是 rule 90（分形），而不是 rule 30；rule 110 与 rule 30 的熵接近，可压缩性却差一倍。 | Figure 21. All 256 rules placed in the (block entropy, compressibility) plane, each run from the same random initial row. Pale blue dots are the other rules, red dots the five discussed in the text, the grey cross is one-dimensional iid noise (same lattice size, so directly comparable). The two quantities are positively correlated, but they are clearly not the same axis: the highest-entropy rule is rule 90 (a fractal), not rule 30; rules 110 and 30 have similar entropy but their compressibility differs by a factor of two.





这张散点图补上了图 20 缺的那一半。图 20 只说明「熵高的不一定复杂」，图 21 说明「复杂」这个词在这套指标体系里至少是两个方向：横轴（熵）度量局部不可预测性，纵轴（可压缩性）度量描述长度，二者相关但不可互换。rule 90 的块熵是 256 条规则里最高的（0.794），比 rule 30 的 0.670 还高，但它的图案是一个可以写成公式的分形；rule 30 与 rule 110 的熵分别是 0.670 与 0.548，可压缩性却是 0.162 与 0.083——相差近一倍。「很难预测」和「很难描述」是两件事，而涌现属于第三件事。
This scatter fills the half that Figure 20 leaves out. Figure 20 only shows that high entropy is not complexity; Figure 21 shows that in this metric system “complex” is at least two directions: the horizontal axis (entropy) measures local unpredictability, the vertical (compressibility) measures description length, and the two are correlated but not interchangeable. Rule 90 has the highest block entropy of all 256 rules (0.794), higher even than rule 30’s 0.670, yet its pattern is a fractal that can be written as a formula. Rules 30 and 110 have entropies of 0.670 and 0.548 but compressibilities of 0.162 and 0.083 — nearly a factor of two apart. “Hard to predict” and “hard to describe” are two different things, and emergence is a third.

title: What Is Emergence?
section: 8. 涌现、进化、非线性与信息 / Emergence, Evolution, Nonlinearity, and Information
text:
8. 涌现、进化、非线性与信息 / Emergence, Evolution, Nonlinearity, and Information

8.1 非线性是必要条件，但不是充分条件 / Nonlinearity is necessary but not sufficient
三个模型里，\(F\) 都是非线性的：生命游戏是阈值函数，Vicsek 是圆周上的平均，Gray–Scott 含 \(uv^2\)。这不是巧合。若 \(F\) 是线性的，系统满足叠加原理，宏观量只是微观量的加权和，任何「新的」宏观行为都能从个体行为直接读出——按第 2 节的定义，它就不算涌现。
In all three models \(F\) is nonlinear: a threshold in the Game of Life, a circular mean in Vicsek, a \(uv^2\) term in Gray–Scott. This is no accident. If \(F\) were linear, superposition would hold, every macroscopic quantity would be a weighted sum of microscopic ones, and any “new” macroscopic behaviour could be read directly off individual behaviour — by the definition in Section 2, that is not emergence.
但非线性并不保证涌现。rule 30 高度非线性，却几乎没有可复现的宏观结构（第 7 节的反例）。非线性提供了「可能」，参数位置提供了「实现」。
But nonlinearity does not guarantee emergence. Rule 30 is strongly nonlinear and yet has almost no reproducible macroscopic structure (the counter-example of Section 7). Nonlinearity provides the possibility; the location in parameter space provides the realisation.


8.2 进化：选择作用在涌现出来的表型上 / Evolution: selection acts on emergent phenotypes
进化论里有一个容易被忽略的事实：选择从不直接作用于基因，而作用于表型；而表型几乎全是涌现量——器官的形状、组织的力学性质、群体的行为。基因层面只有碱基序列，没有「翅膀」。
One easily missed fact about evolution: selection never acts on genes directly, it acts on phenotypes — and phenotypes are almost entirely emergent quantities: organ shape, tissue mechanics, collective behaviour. At the gene level there is only a sequence of bases; there is no “wing”.
这就产生了一个回路：涌现出来的宏观结构一旦稳定，就变成新的选择单位（units of selection），反过来约束微观规则。生命游戏里的滑翔机可以相互碰撞、被破坏，这就是一个（极其简化的）选择场景：能在碰撞中保持自身结构的滑翔机「活下来」。真实的进化比这复杂得多，但机制的形状是一样的。
This closes a loop: once an emergent macroscopic structure is stable, it becomes a new unit of selection and constrains the microscopic rules in turn. Gliders in the Game of Life can collide and be destroyed — a (very simplified) selection scenario in which gliders that keep their structure through collisions “survive”. Real evolution is far more complex, but the shape of the mechanism is the same.


8.3 信息：三种不同的量 / Information: three different quantities
「信息」在这类讨论里经常被混用，至少有三件事需要分开：
“Information” is used loosely in these discussions, and at least three things must be separated:

熵（entropy）：局部构型的不确定性。iid 噪声最高，滑翔机最低。
Entropy: uncertainty of the local configuration. Highest for iid noise, lowest for a glider.
描述长度（description length）：压缩这个系统需要多少比特。它与熵相关但不等价（第 7 节）。
Description length: how many bits are needed to compress the system. Related to entropy but not identical (Section 7).
因果涌现（causal emergence）：宏观变量对未来的预测能力是否强于微观变量。Hoel 等人（2013）给出了一个可操作的度量：比较宏观与微观两种描述下的有效信息量。
Causal emergence: whether a macroscopic variable predicts the future better* than the microscopic one. Hoel et al. (2013) give an operational measure comparing effective information at the two scales.*

第三项最接近本文的问题，也最容易被夸大。它的确有严格定义，但需要先指定「宏观变量怎么粗粒化」，而粗粒化方式本身是一个建模选择——换一种粗粒化，结论可能反转。这与第 3 节的说法一致：宏观量是我们选的，不是自然给的。
The third is closest to the question of this article and the easiest to overstate. It does have a rigorous definition, but it requires specifying how the macroscopic variable is coarse-grained, and that choice is itself a modelling decision — change the coarse-graining and the conclusion can flip. This matches Section 3: macroscopic variables are chosen by us, not handed down by nature.


8.4 为什么生命系统几乎天然带有涌现 / Why living systems are almost inevitably emergent
生命的一个基本特征是多尺度：分子→细胞器→细胞→组织→器官→个体→群体。每一层都有自己的变量、自己的时间尺度、自己的守恒量。上一层不能还原为下一层的语言，不是因为「神秘」，而是因为变量集合变了。
A basic feature of life is multi-scale organisation: molecule → organelle → cell → tissue → organ → organism → group. Every level has its own variables, its own time scale, its own invariants. A level cannot be restated in the language of the level below, not because of anything mystical, but because the set of variables has changed.
第 5 节的 Vicsek 结果给了一个具体版本：「有多少邻居」和「邻居有多可靠」可以互换。在细胞层面，这对应于「细胞密度」和「信号噪声」；在组织层面，这对应于「细胞数量」和「连接强度」。同一组数学关系在不同尺度上重复出现，这正是「用简单模型研究生命」之所以可行的原因，也是它之所以危险的来源——模型对了，尺度可能错。
The Vicsek result in Section 5 gives a concrete version: “how many neighbours” and “how reliable a neighbour is” are interchangeable. At the cell level this corresponds to density and signalling noise; at the tissue level to cell number and junction strength. The same mathematical relation recurs at different scales, which is both why simple models of life work and why they are dangerous — the model can be right while the scale is wrong.

title: What Is Emergence?
section: 9. 对 AI 与「活模型」的启发 / Implications for AI and “Living Models”
text:
9. 对 AI 与「活模型」的启发 / Implications for AI and “Living Models”

9.1 涌现这个词在 AI 里被用得太松 / The word is used too loosely in AI
2022 年以来，「涌现能力（emergent abilities）」成了大模型文献里的高频词：某些能力在小模型上为零，过了某个规模突然出现（Wei et al., 2022）。但这个结论对度量方式极其敏感。Schaeffer 等人（2023）指出，很多所谓的「突然出现」来自非线性或不连续的评分指标：把精确匹配换成 token 级准确率，曲线就变成平滑上升。
Since 2022, “emergent abilities” has become a fixture of the large-model literature: some capability is zero in small models and appears abruptly past a certain scale (Wei et al., 2022). But that conclusion is extremely sensitive to the metric. Schaeffer et al. (2023) show that many such “jumps” come from nonlinear or discontinuous scoring: replace exact match by token-level accuracy and the curve becomes a smooth rise.
这与本文第 7 节的教训完全一致：没有事先声明的宏观量，就没有可检验的涌现主张。 「模型突然会做某事」和「我们的评分函数在某个区间很陡」在数据上可以完全一样。
This is exactly the lesson of Section 7: without a pre-declared macroscopic quantity there is no testable claim of emergence. “The model suddenly can do X” and “our score is steep in some range” can look identical in the data.


9.2 多智能体：局部规则的设计问题 / Multi-agent systems: designing the local rule
Vicsek 模型对多智能体系统的启示是具体的，不是修辞。假设你有一群 agent，每个只能看到少数同伴；你想让整体收敛到一致结论。第 5 节给出三件事：
The lesson of the Vicsek model for multi-agent systems is concrete rather than rhetorical. Suppose you have a population of agents, each seeing only a few peers, and you want the whole to converge on one conclusion. Section 5 gives three things:

对齐强度与噪声必须匹配：交互半径太小或噪声太大，局部平均不可靠，系统停在无序相。
Alignment strength must match noise: too small a radius or too much noise makes the local average unreliable and the system stays disordered.
密度是可以调的控制参数：增加可见同伴的数量，等价于降低噪声。
Density is a control parameter: increasing the number of visible peers is equivalent to reducing noise.
有限尺寸会骗人：小群体看起来更一致，这只是因为 \(1/\sqrt{N}\) 的涨落更大。
Finite size deceives: small groups look more consistent only because \(1/\sqrt{N}\) fluctuations are larger.

第三条在工程上尤其危险：一个 20 个 agent 的系统「表现出一致性」，不代表 2000 个 agent 也会。方向恰好相反——本文的有限尺寸实验里，规模越大，同一噪声下的有序度越低。
The third is especially dangerous in engineering: a 20-agent system that “shows consensus” does not imply that a 2000-agent system will. The direction is the opposite — in the finite-size experiment here, larger systems are less ordered at the same noise.


9.3 「活模型」需要的是规则，不是蓝图 / “Living models” need rules, not blueprints
如果要把第 4–6 节的经验压缩成一句设计原则，那就是：不要试图直接指定宏观行为，而是设计局部交互规则，并把宏观量当作需要测量的输出。
To compress Sections 4–6 into one design principle: do not specify the macroscopic behaviour directly; design the local interaction rule, and treat the macroscopic quantities as outputs to be measured.
这条原则与当前主流的「端到端监督」相反。端到端模型把宏观行为当成训练目标（例如「预测下一帧的群体状态」），于是学到了宏观相关性，但没有学到产生它的机制；一旦分布偏移，宏观相关性就失效。相反，规则型模型（元胞自动机、Vicsek、反应–扩散）在参数改变时会自己产生新的宏观行为，包括训练时从未见过的行为。
This is the opposite of mainstream end-to-end supervision. An end-to-end model treats macroscopic behaviour as a training target (say, “predict the next frame of the crowd”) and therefore learns macroscopic correlations without the mechanism that generates them; under distribution shift the correlations fail. A rule-based model (cellular automaton, Vicsek, reaction–diffusion) instead generates new macroscopic behaviour when parameters change, including behaviour never seen in training.


9.4 边界：什么不能从这些模型里学到 / The boundary: what these models cannot teach
必须说清楚三种不能。第一，这些模型没有「目标」：它们不优化任何东西，而生物体和 agent 都在优化（适应度、奖励、自由能）。第二，这些模型没有学习：规则是固定的，而真实的群体行为会随经验改变。第三，这些模型没有语义：滑翔机不「表示」任何东西，而细胞间的信号是有生物学含义的。
Three things these models cannot teach must be stated. First, they have no objective: they optimise nothing, whereas organisms and agents optimise (fitness, reward, free energy). Second, they do not learn: the rules are fixed, whereas real collective behaviour changes with experience. Third, they have no semantics: a glider “means” nothing, whereas signals between cells have biological meaning.
所以正确的说法不是「生命就是元胞自动机」，而是：元胞自动机与 Vicsek 模型给出了「从规则到结构」这一段的必要条件的下界。 生命还需要目标、学习与语义，但那三件事要另写三篇文章。
So the right statement is not “life is a cellular automaton” but: cellular automata and the Vicsek model give a lower bound on the necessary conditions for the step from rules to structure. Life also needs objectives, learning and semantics — three other articles.


9.5 没有中央控制器，谁来保证「一致到正确」？ / Without a controller, who guarantees that consensus is correct?
Vicsek 模型的成功容易被误读成「去中心化一定更好」。模型里只有一件事被保证了：粒子会收敛到一个共同方向。它没有保证这个方向是我们想要的方向——把初始朝向整体旋转 \(180^\circ\)，系统照样会收敛，只是收敛到反方向。对齐是一个关于一致性的机制，不是一个关于正确性的机制。
The success of the Vicsek model is easily misread as “decentralised is always better”. Only one thing is guaranteed: the particles converge on a common heading. Nothing guarantees that this heading is the one we want — rotate every initial heading by \(180^\circ\) and the system converges just as happily, to the opposite direction. Alignment is a mechanism for consensus, not for correctness.
这一点对多智能体系统是致命的。如果每个 agent 都把自己的判断向邻居的平均值调整，那么一个足够大的初始偏差只要没有被噪声抹掉，就会被放大成共识，而不是被纠正。系统越对齐，纠错能力越弱，因为偏离共识的个体在局部平均里权重越来越小。本文的模型里没有任何「事实核查」项，所以它无法区分「大家都同意」和「大家都对」。
This is fatal for multi-agent systems. If every agent pulls its judgement towards the mean of its neighbours, a sufficiently large initial bias is amplified into consensus rather than corrected, as long as the noise does not erase it. The more aligned the system, the weaker its error correction, because a deviating individual carries less and less weight in the local average. Nothing in the model here checks facts, so it cannot distinguish “everyone agrees” from “everyone is right”.
要让集体行为既有涌现又可靠，至少需要两样东西：异质性（不是所有个体都只用同一条规则）和与外部世界的接触（至少有一部分个体的更新依赖可验证的信号，而不是只依赖邻居）。这两样都不在本文的模型里，而它们恰好是生物群体与工程系统的关键差别：鸟群会撞到障碍物，细胞会死，而一个纯粹相互模仿的 agent 群体不会受到任何惩罚。
Making collective behaviour both emergent and reliable needs at least two things: heterogeneity (not every unit follows the same rule) and contact with the world (at least some units update from verifiable signals rather than from neighbours alone). Neither is in the models here, and they are precisely the difference between biological groups and engineered ones: a flock hits obstacles, a cell dies, whereas a population of purely imitating agents pays no price at all.

title: What Is Emergence?
section: 10. 结论：复杂性不是被写进去的，而是被组织出来的 / Conclusion: Complexity Is Not Merely Written In, but Organized Out
text:
10. 结论：复杂性不是被写进去的，而是被组织出来的 / Conclusion: Complexity Is Not Merely Written In, but Organized Out


Code
ladder <- data.frame(
  x = 1:4,
  label = c("local rule\n(no global variable)",
            "interaction\n(overlapping neighbourhoods)",
            "macroscopic order\n(order parameter, scale)",
            "function\n(intervention, repair)"),
  caveat = c("a rule alone produces nothing\nby itself",
             "interaction without a control parameter\nmay stay disordered",
             "an order parameter does not imply\na function",
             "function needs objectives\nand learning")
)
ggplot(ladder) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1.35, xend = 3.95, y = 0.5, yend = 0.5),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(3, "mm")), colour = em_pal[["grey"]],
               linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x, y = 0.5, colour = x <= 3), size = 5) +
  geom_text(aes(x, y = 0.78, label = label), size = 3.1, lineheight = 0.95) +
  geom_text(aes(x, y = 0.18, label = caveat), size = 2.5, colour = em_pal[["grey"]],
            lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = em_pal[["deep_red"]],
                                 `TRUE` = em_pal[["deep_blue"]]),
                      guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.6, 4.4), ylim = c(0.05, 0.95)) +
  theme_void()








Figure 16: 图 22　全文的一张总图。从左到右四层：局部规则、交互结构、宏观量（这三层由本文的实验覆盖，蓝点），以及功能与干预（需要目标与学习，超出本文范围，红点）。每个点下方写的是这一层不能保证的东西。 | Figure 22. The whole article in one picture. Four layers from left to right: local rule, interaction structure, macroscopic quantities (the three covered by the experiments here, blue dots), and function / intervention (which needs objectives and learning and lies outside this article, red dot). Under each dot is what that layer does not guarantee.





把全文压缩成四句话：
The whole article in four sentences:

局部规则决定「可能发生什么」。规则里没有的宏观行为，不会自己出现。
The local rule decides what can happen. A macroscopic behaviour absent from the rule will not appear by itself.
交互结构决定「信息能传多远」。邻域重叠是长程关联的唯一来源。
The interaction structure decides how far information travels. Overlapping neighbourhoods are the only source of long-range correlation.
尺度提升决定「什么算一个量」。序参量、关联长度、连通块都是在这个步骤被定义的。
The change of scale decides what counts as a quantity. Order parameters, correlation lengths and components are defined at this step.
测量决定「我们有没有资格说它存在」。没有事先声明的宏观量，就没有可检验的涌现主张。
Measurement decides whether we are entitled to say it exists. Without a pre-declared macroscopic quantity there is no testable claim of emergence.


10.1 一份最小的报告清单 / A minimal reporting checklist
如果读者要在自己的系统上主张「这里发生了涌现」，本文的实验流程可以压缩成五条。每一条都对应本文章节里的一个具体做法，而不是抽象原则：
If a reader wants to claim emergence in their own system, the workflow here compresses into five items. Each maps to a concrete practice in this article rather than to an abstract principle:

写下规则：\(F\)、邻域、更新顺序，以及边界条件。
Write the rule down: \(F\), the neighbourhood, the update order, the boundary conditions.
写下宏观量的公式，并说明它为什么是对称的、为什么不能从个体读出。
Write the formula for the macroscopic quantity, and say why it is symmetric and why it cannot be read off individuals.
扫描参数并报告范围，包括「什么都不发生」的那一端——负对照。
Sweep the parameter and report the range, including the end where nothing happens: the negative control.
报告系统尺寸与种子数，并把有限尺寸效应单独画出来，最好按 \(1/\sqrt{N}\) 检验一次。
Report system size and the number of seeds, plot the finite-size effect separately, and if possible test it against \(1/\sqrt{N}\).
给出一个反例：一个看起来同样复杂、但宏观量不支持涌现的系统。
Give a counter-example: a system that looks equally complex but whose macroscopic quantities do not support emergence.

这五条都不需要复杂的技术，但它们能挡住绝大多数「看图说话」的结论。本文的第 7 节就是按这份清单组织的：五项检查（7.1）、反例（7.2）、以及把两者放在一起的对比图（图 20、图 21）。
None of the five needs sophisticated technique, but together they block most “it looks complex, therefore it is emergent” conclusions. Section 7 of this article is organised exactly this way: the five checks (7.1), the counter-example (7.2), and the comparison figures that put them side by side (Figures 20 and 21).
回到开头的问题：我们看到的复杂性，究竟是由规则本身决定的，还是由交互、尺度和组织方式共同塑造的？ 本文的实验给出的答案是后者，但有一个重要的限定：规则决定了可能性的边界。Vicsek 模型无论怎么调参数都不会产生条纹；Gray–Scott 模型无论怎么调参数都不会产生会移动的滑翔机。规则划定可能性，交互与尺度决定在可能性里停在哪里。
Back to the opening question: is the complexity we see determined by the rules themselves, or shaped jointly by interaction, scale and organisation? The experiments here answer “the latter”, with one important qualification: the rule sets the boundary of what is possible. No parameter choice makes the Vicsek model produce stripes, and none makes Gray–Scott produce a moving glider. Rules delimit possibility; interaction and scale decide where inside that possibility the system comes to rest.
最后一句留给方法：涌现不是「神秘地突然出现」，而是大量局部相互作用在特定约束下形成了新的、稳定的、可测量的宏观组织。这句话里每一个形容词都是可检验的：新的（不能从个体读出）、稳定的（跨时间保持）、可测量的（有数值）、组织（有尺度）。少了任何一个，「涌现」就退化成一句赞美。
A final sentence for method: emergence is not “a mysterious sudden appearance” but many local interactions forming a new, stable, measurable macroscopic organisation under specific constraints. Every adjective in that sentence is testable: new (not readable from individuals), stable (kept over time), measurable (has a number), organisation (has a scale). Remove any one and “emergence” collapses back into a compliment.

objectID: posts/2026-11-01 Machine Learning in R Algorithms and Packages/index.html#r-到底能不能做机器学习-can-r-actually-do-machine-learning
href: posts/2026-11-01 Machine Learning in R Algorithms and Packages/index.html#r-到底能不能做机器学习-can-r-actually-do-machine-learning
title: Machine Learning in R: Algorithms, Mathematics and Packages
section: 1. R 到底能不能做机器学习？ / Can R actually do machine learning?
text:
1. R 到底能不能做机器学习？ / Can R actually do machine learning?
能，而且它缺的从来不是算法，是工程。R 的 stats 包里就躺着最小二乘、广义线性模型、K-means、层次聚类和 PCA，这些函数比大多数 Python 库出现得都早。真正被诟病的是另一件事：把数据切分、预处理、调参、评估串成一条不会出错的流水线，在 R 里曾经很笨重。
Yes — and what R has always lacked is not algorithms but plumbing. Base stats ships least squares, generalised linear models, k-means, hierarchical clustering and PCA; most of those functions predate the Python libraries. The real complaint is different: stringing splitting, preprocessing, tuning and evaluation into a pipeline that cannot silently go wrong used to be clumsy in R.
这十年这件事被补上了，而且补出了两套风格不同的方案。下图是现在 R 机器学习生态的分层：底下是算法实现，中间是统一接口，上面是工作流。
That gap has been closed over the last decade, in two quite different styles. The figure below layers the current R machine-learning stack: algorithms at the bottom, unified interfaces in the middle, workflows on top.


Code
lay <- data.frame(
  y = 4:1,
  head = c("工作流  workflow", "领域模型  domain models", "算法实现  algorithms", "底座  runtime"),
  body = c("tidymodels · mlr3 · caret",
           "survival · Bioconductor (limma, DESeq2) · forecast",
           "glmnet · rpart · ranger · xgboost · e1071 · kernlab · uwot · mclust",
           "stats · Matrix · Rcpp · torch · keras3"),
  fill = c("#FDF0D8", "#FBE3D9", "#D8EDE7", "#EAF0F5"),
  bar  = c(ml_pal[["orange"]], ml_pal[["coral"]], ml_pal[["teal"]], ml_pal[["grey"]])
)

ggplot(lay) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 11, ymin = y - 0.40, ymax = y + 0.40), fill = lay$fill) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 0.16, ymin = y - 0.40, ymax = y + 0.40),
            fill = lay$bar, colour = NA) +
  geom_text(aes(0.45, y + 0.13, label = head), hjust = 0, size = 3.1,
            fontface = "bold", colour = ml_pal[["ink"]]) +
  geom_text(aes(0.45, y - 0.16, label = body), hjust = 0, size = 2.6,
            colour = ml_pal[["blue"]]) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 11.2), ylim = c(0.45, 4.55)) +
  plain








Figure 1: R 机器学习生态的四层。本文用到的包在第三层，工作流框架在第四层；第一层是几乎所有包都依赖的底座。分层不是为了排名，而是为了说明：同一个算法可以有三种调用方式，选哪一种取决于你要跑一个模型还是一百个。 | Four layers of the R machine-learning stack. The packages used here sit in layer 3, workflow frameworks in layer 4, and everything rests on layer 1. The layering is not a ranking: it shows that one algorithm can be called three ways, and which you choose depends on whether you need one model or a hundred.





一个具体的对比能说明”分层”的实际意义。同一件事——在 Pima 糖尿病数据上做五折交叉验证的随机森林——在三种框架里长得完全不一样：
A concrete comparison shows what the layering means in practice. The same job — five-fold cross-validated random forest on the Pima diabetes data — looks completely different in the three frameworks:


Code
# tidymodels: declare, then fit a workflow
rf_spec <- rand_forest(trees = 500) |>
  set_engine("ranger") |>
  set_mode("classification")

rf_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_formula(type ~ .) |>
  add_model(rf_spec)

rf_res <- fit_resamples(rf_wf, folds = vfold_cv(Pima.tr, v = 5),
                        metrics = metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy))
collect_metrics(rf_res)




Code
# mlr3: build a task, a learner, then resample
task <- as_task_classif(Pima.tr, target = "type")
learner <- lrn("classif.ranger", num.trees = 500, predict_type = "prob")
rr <- resample(task, learner, rsmp("cv", folds = 5))
rr$aggregate(msr("classif.auc"))




Code
# caret: one call, many models
ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5,
                     summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
                     classProbs = TRUE)
train(type ~ ., data = Pima.tr, method = "ranger",
      trControl = ctrl, metric = "ROC")


三段代码做的事完全一样。区别在于：tidymodels 把”模型”和”预处理”拆成可组合的对象，最适合需要严格记录每一步的流程；mlr3 用面向对象的 task/learner/measure 三件套，最适合在几十个数据集上批量跑 benchmark；caret 用一次 train() 调用包办调参与重采样，最适合”我只想赶紧得到一个能用的模型”。第 7 章会把这条比较做完整。
All three do the same thing. The difference is style: tidymodels splits model and preprocessing into composable objects, which suits pipelines that must record every step; mlr3’s task/learner/measure triple suits running benchmarks over dozens of datasets; caret’s single train() call handles tuning and resampling together, which suits “I just need a working model now”. Section 7 completes this comparison.

1.1 本文的例子用什么数据 / What data the examples use
两套数据，一套通用一套生物学，避免”只有生物学家看得懂”和”举的例子和自己无关”这两种失败：
Two datasets, one general and one biological, to avoid both failure modes — examples nobody outside biology understands, and examples unrelated to the reader’s own work:

Pima 糖尿病数据（MASS::Pima.tr / Pima.te）：200 个训练样本、332 个测试样本，7 个临床指标，预测是否为糖尿病。用来演示分类与集成方法。
Pima diabetes data (MASS::Pima.tr / Pima.te): 200 training and 332 test cases, seven clinical variables, predict diabetes. Used for classification and ensembles.
模拟表达矩阵：80 个样本 × 500 个基因，只有 8 个基因与结局真正相关。用来演示高维正则化与特征选择——这是生信里最典型的”p 远大于 n”场景，而且因为真值已知，可以验证方法有没有找回正确的基因。
A simulated expression matrix: 80 samples × 500 genes, of which 8 are truly associated. Used for high-dimensional penalisation and feature selection — the classic p ≫ n case in bioinformatics, and because the truth is known, we can check whether the method recovers the right genes.

模拟数据的好处是知道正确答案。真实数据上你只能比较预测误差，模拟数据上还能问”选出来的基因对不对”，这两个问题是不同的。
The advantage of simulation is that you know the right answer. On real data you can only compare predictive error; on simulated data you can also ask whether the selected genes are the right ones — two different questions.

title: Machine Learning in R: Algorithms, Mathematics and Packages
section: 2. 一个视角看穿所有监督学习 / One lens for all supervised learning
text:
2. 一个视角看穿所有监督学习 / One lens for all supervised learning
在写代码之前先建立这个视角，后面每一节都会回到它。几乎所有监督学习都在解同一个问题：
Build this lens before any code; every later section returns to it. Almost all supervised learning solves one problem:
\[\hat f=\arg\min_{f\in\mathcal{F}}\ \underbrace{\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}L\big(y_i,f(x_i)\big)}_{\text{拟合数据 / fit the data}}+\ \underbrace{\lambda\,\Omega(f)}_{\text{别太复杂 / stay simple}}\]
三项各有分工：\(L\) 决定”错多少算错”，\(\Omega\) 决定”多复杂算复杂”，\(\lambda\) 决定两者怎么妥协。\(f\) 的取值范围 \(\mathcal{F}\) 就是模型族——线性函数、分段常数、树的和、神经网络的函数类。
Each term has a job: \(L\) says how wrong is wrong, \(\Omega\) says how complex is complex, and \(\lambda\) arbitrates. The set \(\mathcal{F}\) is the model family — linear functions, piecewise constants, sums of trees, the function class of a neural network.


Code
box <- data.frame(
  x = c(1.1, 3.0, 4.9, 6.8),
  head = c("模型族  F", "损失  L", "正则  Ω", "求解器"),
  body = c("线性 / 树 / 核 / 网络",
           "平方 / 对数 / hinge",
           "L1 / L2 / 深度惩罚",
           "闭式解 / 坐标下降 / SGD"),
  ex = c("y = Xβ", "(y - f)^2", "λ‖β‖₁", "argmin"),
  fill = c("#DCE8F5", "#FDF0D8", "#FBE3D9", "#D8EDE7")
)

ggplot(box) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = x - 0.78, xmax = x + 0.78, ymin = 0.55, ymax = 1.95),
            fill = box$fill, colour = ml_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(aes(x, 1.72, label = head), size = 3.2, fontface = "bold",
            colour = ml_pal[["blue"]]) +
  geom_text(aes(x, 1.28, label = body), size = 2.4, lineheight = 1.1,
            colour = ml_pal[["ink"]]) +
  geom_text(aes(x, 0.86, label = ex), size = 2.6, colour = ml_pal[["coral"]]) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1.92, xend = 2.18, y = 1.25, yend = 1.25,
           arrow = arrow_ml, colour = ml_pal[["grey"]], linewidth = 0.45) +
  annotate("segment", x = 3.82, xend = 4.08, y = 1.25, yend = 1.25,
           arrow = arrow_ml, colour = ml_pal[["grey"]], linewidth = 0.45) +
  annotate("segment", x = 5.72, xend = 5.98, y = 1.25, yend = 1.25,
           arrow = arrow_ml, colour = ml_pal[["grey"]], linewidth = 0.45) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.2, 7.9), ylim = c(0.4, 2.1)) +
  plain








Figure 2: 所有监督学习共用的一条流水线：模型族决定候选函数，损失函数决定怎么打分，正则项决定偏好哪一类解，优化算法负责把最小值找出来。换算法往往只是换了其中一格。 | Every supervised method shares one pipeline: the model family says which functions are candidates, the loss says how to score them, the penalty says which solutions to prefer, and the optimiser finds the minimum. Swapping algorithms usually swaps one cell.

有了这张表，“算法”这个词就不再神秘：换算法就是换其中一格，而”调参”多数时候是在调第三格（正则强度）。下一篇（如果写）讲深度学习时你会发现，神经网络唯一真正新的是 \(\mathcal{F}\) 变大了，其他三格原封不动。
With this table, “algorithm” stops being mysterious: switching algorithms means switching one cell, and “tuning” is mostly tuning the third cell. In deep learning the only genuinely new thing is that \(\mathcal{F}\) becomes much larger; the other three cells are unchanged.

2.1 为什么需要正则：偏差与方差的真实形状 / Why regularise: the actual shape of bias and variance
\(\Omega\) 不是装饰。下面这个模拟把”偏差-方差权衡”算了出来，而不是画一条示意图：固定真函数 \(f(x)=\sin(2\pi x)\)，用多项式回归拟合，改变阶数，重复 300 次抽样，在测试点上分别估计偏差的平方与方差。
\(\Omega\) is not decoration. The simulation below computes the bias–variance trade-off instead of sketching it: fix the truth \(f(x)=\sin(2\pi x)\), fit polynomials of increasing degree, repeat the sampling 300 times, and estimate squared bias and variance at the test points.


Code
truth <- function(x) sin(2 * pi * x)
xgrid <- seq(0.05, 0.95, length.out = 40)
deg   <- 1:12
R     <- 300
noise <- 0.25

bias2 <- numeric(length(deg)); vari <- numeric(length(deg)); mse <- numeric(length(deg))
for (k in seq_along(deg)) {
  preds <- matrix(NA_real_, R, length(xgrid))
  for (r in seq_len(R)) {
    x  <- runif(45)
    y  <- truth(x) + rnorm(45, 0, noise)
    fit <- lm(y ~ poly(x, deg[k], raw = TRUE))
    preds[r, ] <- predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = xgrid))
  }
  m  <- colMeans(preds)
  bias2[k] <- mean((m - truth(xgrid))^2)
  vari[k]  <- mean(apply(preds, 2, var))
  mse[k]   <- mean(apply(preds, 2, function(v) mean((v - truth(xgrid))^2)))
}

bv <- rbind(
  data.frame(deg = deg, value = bias2, term = "bias^2"),
  data.frame(deg = deg, value = vari,  term = "variance"),
  data.frame(deg = deg, value = mse,   term = "bias^2 + variance"),
  data.frame(deg = deg, value = rep(noise^2, length(deg)), term = "irreducible")
)
bv$term <- factor(bv$term, levels = c("bias^2", "variance", "bias^2 + variance", "irreducible"))

ggplot(bv, aes(deg, value, colour = term, linetype = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = subset(bv, term != "irreducible"), size = 1.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("bias^2" = ml_pal[["blue"]], "variance" = ml_pal[["coral"]],
                                 "bias^2 + variance" = ml_pal[["ink"]],
                                 "irreducible" = ml_pal[["grey"]]), name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("bias^2" = "solid", "variance" = "solid",
                                   "bias^2 + variance" = "22", "irreducible" = "dotted"),
                        name = NULL) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "polynomial degree", y = "error at test points (log scale)") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 8))








Figure 3: 偏差-方差的真实分解。阶数从 1 增到 12：偏差平方单调下降（模型更灵活），方差单调上升（对训练集更敏感），两者相加在 4 阶附近最低。纵轴是对数刻度。 | A computed bias–variance decomposition. As the degree goes from 1 to 12, squared bias falls monotonically (more flexible) and variance rises monotonically (more sensitive to the training set); their sum is lowest near degree 4. The vertical axis is logarithmic.





三件事值得记住。第一，虚线（总误差）有一个明确的最低点，位置不在两端——这就是”模型不能太简单也不能太复杂”的定量版本。第二，方差随阶数指数式上升（注意纵轴是对数刻度），而偏差下降得越来越慢，所以过了最优点之后，误差上升得比下降时快。第三，噪声水平（点线）是一条地板，任何模型都跨不过去——它决定了你的问题本身的难度上限。
Three things to keep. First, the dashed total has a clear minimum, not at either end — the quantitative version of “not too simple, not too complex”. Second, variance grows roughly exponentially with degree (note the log axis) while bias falls ever more slowly, so past the optimum the error rises faster than it fell. Third, the noise floor (dotted) is a floor no model crosses — it sets the difficulty ceiling of the problem itself.
后面每种方法的”超参数”——多项式的阶数、KNN 的 \(k\)、树的深度、正则的 \(\lambda\)——本质上都在同一个轴上移动：往左加偏差减方差，往右加方差减偏差。所谓调参，就是在这条曲线上找最低点，而找的方法几乎只有一种：留出一部分数据不参与拟合。
Every later “hyperparameter” — polynomial degree, KNN’s \(k\), tree depth, the penalty \(\lambda\) — moves along the same axis: left adds bias and removes variance, right does the reverse. Tuning is finding the minimum of that curve, and there is essentially one way to find it: hold out data that never takes part in fitting.

section: 3. 线性模型与正则化：从最小二乘到 LASSO / Linear models and penalisation
text:
3. 线性模型与正则化：从最小二乘到 LASSO / Linear models and penalisation

3.1 最小二乘的解，以及它什么时候会崩 / The least-squares solution, and when it collapses
线性模型假设 \(f(x)=x^\top\beta\)，平方损失下目标函数是
A linear model assumes \(f(x)=x^\top\beta\); with squared loss the objective is
\[\hat\beta=\arg\min_\beta\ \|y-X\beta\|_2^2 .\]
对 \(\beta\) 求导令其为零，得到正规方程 \(X^\top X\beta=X^\top y\)，解是 \(\hat\beta=(X^\top X)^{-1}X^\top y\)。这个式子漂亮，但有一个致命条件：\(X^\top X\) 必须可逆，也就是 \(p\) 个特征必须线性无关且 \(n\ge p\)。
Differentiate with respect to \(\beta\), set to zero, and the normal equations \(X^\top X\beta=X^\top y\) give \(\hat\beta=(X^\top X)^{-1}X^\top y\). Elegant — but it needs \(X^\top X\) to be invertible: the \(p\) features must be linearly independent and \(n\ge p\).
生信数据几乎从不满足这个条件。500 个基因、80 个样本时 \(X^\top X\) 是 500×500 的矩阵但秩最多 80，它有无穷多零空间方向；解不唯一，而教科书式的解会把权重摊到所有基因上，方差大到无法解释。这不是数值问题，是问题本身没有唯一答案——正则项的作用正是从这里开始：在无穷多个”拟合得一样好”的解里挑一个。
Bioinformatics data almost never satisfies that. With 500 genes and 80 samples, \(X^\top X\) is 500×500 but has rank at most 80, so it has infinitely many null directions; the solution is not unique, and the textbook one spreads weight over all genes with unusable variance. This is not a numerical nuisance — the problem has no unique answer. The penalty starts exactly here: among infinitely many equally good fits, pick one.


3.2 岭回归：给解加一条最小范数的偏好 / Ridge: prefer the smallest norm
\[\hat\beta_{\text{ridge}}=\arg\min_\beta\ \|y-X\beta\|_2^2+\lambda\|\beta\|_2^2
=\big(X^\top X+\lambda I\big)^{-1}X^\top y\]
加 \(\lambda I\) 让矩阵一定可逆，这是它数值稳定的原因。统计上它做的是收缩：所有系数按比例向零压，但不会压到恰好为零。\(\lambda\to0\) 退回最小二乘，\(\lambda\to\infty\) 全部归零。
Adding \(\lambda I\) makes the matrix invertible, which is why it is numerically stable. Statistically it shrinks: every coefficient is pulled toward zero proportionally, but never exactly to zero. As \(\lambda\to0\) it returns to least squares; as \(\lambda\to\infty\) everything goes to zero.


3.3 LASSO：让没用的变量变成精确的零 / LASSO: useless variables become exact zeros
\[\hat\beta_{\text{lasso}}=\arg\min_\beta\ \|y-X\beta\|_2^2+\lambda\|\beta\|_1,
\qquad \|\beta\|_1=\sum_j|\beta_j|\]
只把 \(L_2\) 换成 \(L_1\)，解的性质就完全变了：\(\hat\beta\) 会稀疏，很多分量恰好是 0。原因在几何上：\(L_1\) 球的”角”落在坐标轴上，而损失函数的等高线是椭圆——椭圆从外面撞上菱形时，最先接触的往往是角点。
Swapping \(L_2\) for \(L_1\) changes the solution completely: \(\hat\beta\) becomes sparse, with many components exactly zero. The reason is geometric — the \(L_1\) ball has corners on the axes, and an expanding elliptical loss contour usually touches a corner first.


Code
set.seed(20261101)
Xg <- matrix(rnorm(200 * 2), 200, 2) %*% matrix(c(1, 0.5, 0.5, 1), 2, 2)
Xg <- scale(Xg)
yg <- as.vector(Xg %*% c(2.2, 0.4)) + rnorm(200, 0, 0.55)
b_ols <- solve(crossprod(Xg), crossprod(Xg, yg))
XtX <- crossprod(Xg)

g <- expand.grid(b1 = seq(-1.7, 3.4, length.out = 200),
                 b2 = seq(-1.7, 2.2, length.out = 200))
d1 <- g$b1 - b_ols[1]; d2 <- g$b2 - b_ols[2]
g$rss <- XtX[1, 1] * d1^2 + 2 * XtX[1, 2] * d1 * d2 + XtX[2, 2] * d2^2

tt <- 1.5
in_l2 <- g$b1^2 + g$b2^2 <= tt^2
in_l1 <- abs(g$b1) + abs(g$b2) <= tt
sol_l2 <- g[in_l2, ][which.min(g$rss[in_l2]), c("b1", "b2")]
sol_l1 <- g[in_l1, ][which.min(g$rss[in_l1]), c("b1", "b2")]

th <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 300)
ball_l2 <- data.frame(b1 = tt * cos(th), b2 = tt * sin(th))
ball_l1 <- data.frame(b1 = c(tt, 0, -tt, 0, tt), b2 = c(0, tt, 0, -tt, 0))

mk_panel <- function(ball, sol, title) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_contour(data = g, aes(b1, b2, z = rss), colour = ml_pal[["grey"]],
                 linewidth = 0.32, bins = 9, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_path(data = ball, aes(b1, b2), linetype = "22",
              colour = ml_pal[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(data = sol, aes(b1, b2), colour = ml_pal[["orange"]], size = 3) +
    geom_point(aes(x = b_ols[1], y = b_ols[2]), shape = 4, size = 2.2,
               colour = ml_pal[["ink"]], stroke = 0.6) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.7, 3.4), ylim = c(-1.7, 2.2)) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 7.5))
}
mk_panel(ball_l2, sol_l2, "L2: round, both non-zero") +
  mk_panel(ball_l1, sol_l1, "L1: corners, one exact zero")








Figure 4: 两种约束的几何。灰色同心椭圆是残差平方和的等高线，虚线是可行域边界，橙点是数值上找到的最优解，叉号是最小二乘解。左：\(L_2\) 球是圆的，切点一般不在坐标轴上，两个系数都非零。右：\(L_1\) 球是菱形，切点落在角上，于是有一个系数恰好为 0。这就是 LASSO 稀疏的全部来源。 | Geometry of the two constraints. Grey contours are residual sum of squares, the dashed outline is the feasible region, the orange dot the numerically located optimum and the cross the least-squares solution. Left: the \(L_2\) ball is round, the contact is generically off-axis and both coefficients are non-zero. Right: the \(L_1\) ball is a diamond, the contact lands on a corner, so one coefficient is exactly zero. That is the whole origin of LASSO sparsity.





叉号是最小二乘解（约 \((2.20,0.40)\)），橙点是加约束后的最优解。左图两个系数都被压小但都不为零；右图第二个系数被压到坐标轴上——这就是”变量选择”的来源。这不是玄学：\(|\beta_j|\) 在 0 点的导数是跳变的，损失函数在这一点无法用一个平滑方向把它推离零，所以只要约束足够紧，它就会停在零。
The cross is the least-squares solution (about \((2.20,0.40)\)) and the orange dot the constrained optimum. In the left panel both coefficients shrink but neither vanishes; in the right the second coefficient is pinned to an axis — that is where variable selection comes from. Not mysticism: the derivative of \(|\beta_j|\) jumps at zero, so no smooth direction can push the loss off that point once the constraint is tight enough.
实际求解不靠网格搜索。glmnet 用坐标下降：一次只优化一个系数、其余固定，这时有闭式解（软阈值），扫完一轮再扫下一轮，通常十几轮收敛。因为每个子问题便宜，且能用上一轮的解热启动，整条 \(\lambda\) 路径（从大到小）算下来反而比单个最小二乘还快。
Real solvers do not use a grid. glmnet uses coordinate descent: optimise one coefficient at a time with the rest fixed, which has a closed form (soft thresholding), sweep repeatedly, and it converges in a dozen passes. Because each subproblem is cheap and warm-starts from the previous solution, the whole \(\lambda\) path from large to small is often faster than one least-squares fit.


3.4 正则路径：把 λ 从大到小走一遍 / The regularisation path
把 \(\lambda\) 当作自变量，画出每个系数随它的变化，能一眼看出”哪些变量先进入模型”。
Plot each coefficient against \(\lambda\) and you see at a glance which variables enter the model first.


Code
data(BostonHousing, package = "mlbench")
bh <- BostonHousing
Xb <- model.matrix(medv ~ ., data = bh)[, -1]
yb <- bh$medv
fit_path <- glmnet::glmnet(Xb, yb, alpha = 1)

B <- as.matrix(fit_path$beta)
path <- data.frame(
  loglam = rep(log(fit_path$lambda), each = nrow(B)),
  var    = rep(rownames(B), times = ncol(B)),
  coef   = as.vector(B)
)
final <- B[, ncol(B)]
path$grp <- ifelse(abs(final[path$var]) == 0, "never selected",
                   ifelse(final[path$var] > 0, "positive at end", "negative at end"))
path$grp <- factor(path$grp,
                   levels = c("positive at end", "negative at end", "never selected"))

ggplot(path, aes(loglam, coef, group = var, colour = grp)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = ml_pal[["grey"]], linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.55, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("positive at end" = ml_pal[["blue"]],
                                 "negative at end" = ml_pal[["coral"]],
                                 "never selected" = ml_pal[["grey"]]), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = expression(log(lambda)), y = "coefficient") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 8))








Figure 5: 波士顿房价数据上的 LASSO 路径。横轴是 \(\log\lambda\)，从左往右正则越来越强；每条曲线是一个预测变量。右端所有系数归零，说明正则足够强时模型退化成只预测均值。落在零线上的灰线是全程都没被选中的变量。 | LASSO path on the Boston housing data. The horizontal axis is \(\log\lambda\), increasing left to right; each curve is one predictor. At the right every coefficient is zero, so a strong enough penalty reduces the model to predicting the mean. Grey lines lying on zero are variables never selected.





读这张图有三个层次。第一，右端全部为零。第二，每条曲线离开零的位置不同：越靠右离开的变量在更强正则下依然值得保留，通常也越重要。第三，曲线会互相挤压——LASSO 在高度相关的变量之间倾向于只留一个，换一批样本留下的可能是另一个。这种不稳定性是弹性网存在的直接理由。
Read it at three levels. First, everything is zero at the right end. Second, each curve leaves zero at a different point: variables leaving further right survive stronger penalties and are usually more important. Third, the curves push against each other — LASSO tends to keep only one of a highly correlated pair, and a different sample may keep the other. That instability is the direct reason the elastic net exists.


3.5 弹性网：两个惩罚项一起用 / Elastic net: both penalties at once
\[\hat\beta=\arg\min_\beta\ \|y-X\beta\|_2^2+\lambda\Big(\alpha\|\beta\|_1+\tfrac{1-\alpha}{2}\|\beta\|_2^2\Big)\]
\(\alpha=1\) 是 LASSO，\(\alpha=0\) 是岭回归。中间值同时具备”能选出变量”和”相关变量一起进出”两个性质。生信里这几乎是默认选择：基因按通路成组相关，纯 LASSO 会在一组里随机挑一个，解释性很差。
\(\alpha=1\) is LASSO and \(\alpha=0\) is ridge. Intermediate values both select variables and let correlated ones enter together. In bioinformatics this is nearly the default: genes are correlated within pathways, and pure LASSO picks one at random from each group, which reads badly.


3.6 高维案例：从 500 个基因里找回 8 个 / A p ≫ n case: recovering 8 genes out of 500
现在做那个真正的问题：80 个样本、500 个基因，只有 8 个基因与结局相关，其余是纯噪声。
Now the real question: 80 samples, 500 genes, only 8 associated with the outcome, the rest pure noise.


Code
set.seed(20261101)
n_g <- 80; p_g <- 500
Xg2 <- matrix(rnorm(n_g * p_g), n_g, p_g)
Xg2[, 11:25] <- Xg2[, 11:25] + matrix(rnorm(n_g), n_g, 1) %*% rep(0.8, 15)
Xg2 <- scale(Xg2)
truth_idx <- c(7, 43, 88, 120, 201, 305, 410, 488)
beta_true <- c(1.15, -0.95, 0.85, 0.75, -0.65, 0.55, -0.50, 0.45)
yg2 <- as.vector(Xg2[, truth_idx] %*% beta_true) + rnorm(n_g, 0, 0.8)

cvfit <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(Xg2, yg2, alpha = 1, nfolds = 5)
b_hat <- as.vector(coef(cvfit, s = "lambda.min"))[-1]
names(b_hat) <- paste0("g", seq_len(p_g))
sel <- which(b_hat != 0)
tp <- sum(sel %in% truth_idx); fp <- sum(!(sel %in% truth_idx))
fn <- length(truth_idx) - tp

b_1se <- as.vector(coef(cvfit, s = "lambda.1se"))[-1]
sel1 <- which(b_1se != 0)
tp1 <- sum(sel1 %in% truth_idx); fp1 <- sum(!(sel1 %in% truth_idx))

cvdf <- data.frame(loglam = log(cvfit$lambda), cvm = cvfit$cvm, cvsd = cvfit$cvsd)
p_cv <- ggplot(cvdf, aes(loglam, cvm)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = cvm - cvsd, ymax = cvm + cvsd), width = 0.06,
                colour = ml_pal[["grey"]], linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 1.1, colour = ml_pal[["blue"]]) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log(cvfit$lambda.min), linetype = "22",
             colour = ml_pal[["orange"]], linewidth = 0.55) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log(cvfit$lambda.1se), linetype = "dotted",
             colour = ml_pal[["teal"]], linewidth = 0.55) +
  labs(x = expression(log(lambda)), y = "CV error",
       title = sprintf("min at %.2f, 1se at %.2f",
                       log(cvfit$lambda.min), log(cvfit$lambda.1se))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 7.5))

seldf <- data.frame(gene = names(b_hat)[sel], coef = b_hat[sel],
                    kind = ifelse(sel %in% truth_idx, "true signal", "false positive"))
seldf$gene <- factor(seldf$gene, levels = seldf$gene[order(seldf$coef)])
p_sel <- ggplot(seldf, aes(coef, gene, fill = kind)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = ml_pal[["grey"]], linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("true signal" = ml_pal[["orange"]],
                               "false positive" = ml_pal[["grey"]]), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "coefficient at lambda.min", y = NULL,
       title = sprintf("%d selected: %d true, %d false", length(sel), tp, fp)) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5), legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8))

p_cv + p_sel + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.05))








Figure 6: 高维情形下的交叉验证与变量选择。左：五折交叉验证曲线，虚线是最优 \(\lambda\)。右：该 \(\lambda\) 下系数非零的基因，橙色是真正有效的 8 个，灰色是被误选的。稀疏方法在相关设计下的典型表现是找回大部分真信号、同时带进少量假阳性。 | Cross-validation and selection in the p ≫ n case. Left: the five-fold CV curve with the optimal \(\lambda\) marked. Right: genes with non-zero coefficients at that \(\lambda\); orange are the 8 truly associated, grey are false positives. Sparse methods under correlated designs typically recover most of the signal and admit a few false positives.





结果是：在 \(\lambda_{\min}\) 处选出 26 个基因，其中 8 个是真正的信号、18 个是假阳性、漏掉 0 个。改用”一倍标准误”规则（\(\lambda_{1se}\)，图里那条点线）后，选出的基因降到 12 个，仍然包含 8 个真信号。这三组数字放在一起，正好说明后面的三点。
The result: at \(\lambda_{\min}\), 26 genes are selected — 8 true, 18 false positives, 0 missed. Switching to the one-standard-error rule (\(\lambda_{1se}\), the dotted line) shrinks the set to 12 genes, still containing 8 of the true ones. Those numbers set up the three points below.
第一，假阳性不是 bug。LASSO 的理论保证是在预测意义上（\(\lambda\) 选得好时预测误差接近最优），不是”选出的集合等于真实集合”。后者需要更强的条件（不可表示条件、信号足够强）和更专门的方法（stability selection、knockoff）。第二，\(\lambda\) 的取法直接决定结论：lambda.min 优化的是预测误差，因此倾向多留变量；lambda.1se 选的是”误差在最小值一个标准误以内最简洁的模型”，通常更少、更稳。两者都对，取决于你要预测还是要解释。第三，最重要的一点——真实数据里没有真值可比，所以应该报告”选出的基因是否富集在已知通路”，而不是宣称找回了”正确的”基因。
First, false positives are not a bug. LASSO’s guarantee is about prediction error (near-optimal when \(\lambda\) is chosen well), not “the selected set equals the true set”. The latter needs stronger conditions and dedicated machinery (stability selection, knockoffs). Second, how you pick \(\lambda\) decides the conclusion: lambda.min optimises prediction error and therefore keeps more variables; lambda.1se picks the simplest model within one standard error of the minimum, which is usually smaller and more stable. Both are right — it depends on whether you want prediction or explanation. Third, and most important, real data give you no ground truth — so report whether the selected genes enrich for known pathways instead of claiming to have found “the right” ones.
对应到包：lm() 与 glm() 是不带惩罚的基线；glmnet 覆盖岭、LASSO、弹性网及其广义线性版本（family = "binomial" 就是惩罚逻辑回归）；ncvreg、grpreg 处理非凸惩罚与分组结构。日常一个 glmnet 就够。
The package mapping: lm() and glm() are the unpenalised baselines; glmnet covers ridge, LASSO, elastic net and their generalised-linear versions (family = "binomial" gives penalised logistic regression); ncvreg and grpreg handle non-convex penalties and group structure. In daily work glmnet alone is enough.
